items.title_zh: FAST-LIO2：快速直接的 LiDAR-惯性里程计
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 FAST-LIO2：一个快速、鲁棒且通用的 LiDAR-惯性里程计框架。它基于高效的紧耦合迭代卡尔曼滤波，有两个关键创新。其一，直接将原始点云配准到地图（并随之更新地图，即建图），无需提取特征，从而能利用环境中的细微特征提高精度；去掉人工设计的特征提取模块也使其天然适配不同扫描模式的新型 LiDAR。其二，用增量式 k-d 树（ikd-Tree）维护地图，支持增量更新（插入、删除）与动态重平衡；与八叉树、R*-tree、nanoflann k-d 树等动态结构相比，ikd-Tree 综合性能更优，且天然支持在树上降采样。在多个公开 LiDAR 数据集的 19 个序列上进行穷举式基准比较，FAST-LIO2 以更低计算量获得一致更高的精度。还在小视场固态 LiDAR 上开展多项真实实验。总体而言，FAST-LIO2 计算高效（大型室外场景可达 100 Hz 里程计与建图）、鲁棒（杂乱室内环境中旋转达 1000 deg/s 仍可靠估计位姿）、通用（适用于多线旋转与固态 LiDAR、无人机与手持平台、Intel 与 ARM 处理器），且精度高于现有方法。
items.highlight_zh: 直接配准原始点云并用增量 k-d 树建图，又快又准且通用于固态 LiDAR
items.digest_zh:
① 研究问题：LiDAR 与 IMU 融合的里程计是机器人、自动驾驶定位与建图的核心模块。传统方法通常先从点云中提取边缘、平面等特征再做配准；特征提取既依赖人工设计，又会丢掉环境中的细微结构，而且不同扫描模式的 LiDAR（机械旋转式、固态）往往需要重新调参。
② 方法：FAST-LIO2 建立在高效的紧耦合迭代卡尔曼滤波之上，有两个关键创新。第一，跳过特征提取，把原始点直接配准到地图上，并同步更新地图（即建图）——这样能利用环境中的细微特征提高精度，也天然适配各种新型 LiDAR。第二，用自研的增量式 k-d 树（ikd-Tree）维护地图，支持增量插入、删除与动态重平衡，还能在树上直接做降采样；相比八叉树、R*-tree、nanoflann k-d 树，综合性能更优。
③ 结果：在多个公开 LiDAR 数据集的 19 个序列上做穷举式基准比较，FAST-LIO2 精度一致更高而计算量低得多；在小视场固态 LiDAR、无人机与手持平台、Intel 与 ARM 处理器上都验证可用。它能在大型室外场景达到最高 100 Hz 的里程计与建图，在旋转角速度高达 1000 deg/s 的杂乱室内环境中仍能可靠估计位姿。
④ 为何重要：这项工作同时做到“快”和“准”，并去掉了对特征提取的依赖，使同一系统通用于多线旋转与固态 LiDAR，成为该领域被广泛采用的开源基线。

items.title_en: 3AGameFactory-Motion: Agentic Rigging and Reliable Complex Motion Generation for Diverse 3D Assets
items.title_zh: 3AGameFactory-Motion：面向多样化3D资产的智能体化绑定与可靠复杂运动生成
items.abstract_en: Animating arbitrary 3D assets from instructions requires both structural inference and motion control, yet existing motion benchmarks mostly cover conventional human or animal skeletons with simple instructions. We introduce DivDynBench, which evaluates rigging and motion generation across six morphology categories, with instructions requiring multi-phase part coordination and explicit timing, angle, repetition, and trajectory constraints. With large language models, we systematically compare three common paradigms: specialized motion generation, video generation followed by motion recovery, and direct agent-driven generation. We analyze their control capabilities, cross-morphology adaptability, and generation costs. Guided by this comparison, we propose an Agentic Motion Framework in which an agent writes compact parametric skeleton and motion programs, and a deterministic executor performs rigging, kinematic solving, and geometric correction. Compact parameter control reduces generation overhead and improves rigging reliability and motion-control accuracy, providing practical guidance for deploying complex 3D motion generation.
items.abstract_zh: 根据指令为任意3D资产制作动画，既需要结构推断，也需要运动控制，但现有运动基准大多只涵盖常规人类或动物骨骼，且指令较为简单。我们提出DivDynBench，它在六种形态类别上评估绑定与运动生成，其指令要求多阶段部件协调，并包含明确的时间、角度、重复次数和轨迹约束。借助大语言模型，我们系统比较了三种常见范式：专用运动生成、先生成视频再恢复运动，以及直接由智能体驱动的生成。我们分析了它们的控制能力、跨形态适应性和生成成本。基于这一比较，我们提出智能体运动框架（Agentic Motion Framework）：由智能体编写紧凑的参数化骨骼与运动程序，确定性执行器负责绑定、运动学求解和几何校正。紧凑参数控制降低了生成开销，并提升了绑定可靠性和运动控制精度，为部署复杂3D运动生成提供了实践指导。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Active sensing as control over sensory acquisition
items.title_zh: 主动感知作为对感觉获取的控制
items.abstract_en: The term "active sensing" is used across neuroscience and engineering to describe a wide range of sensing behaviors, but there is no consensus on what makes sensing "active." We propose that the behaviors grouped under this label are better understood as forms of control over sensory acquisition and develop a framework that distinguishes three interacting forms of control. Mechanistic control physically structures sensory input, strategic control modulates sensing in closed loop through adaptive and attentional processes, and agentic control concerns the sensing policies available to an agent and its authority to choose among them. These forms of control can occur separately or in combination, and have distinct consequences for sensory input, perception, behavior, and performance. The framework clarifies active-passive comparisons and provides a common basis for analyzing biological, engineered, and hybrid sensing systems by asking what is controlled, how, and by whom.
items.abstract_zh: “主动感知”一词在神经科学和工程学中被用来描述广泛的感知行为，但对于什么使感知成为“主动的”，尚无共识。我们提出，归入这一标签下的行为更适合被理解为对感觉获取的控制形式，并构建了一个区分三种相互作用控制形式的框架。机制性控制在物理上构造感觉输入；策略性控制通过自适应和注意过程，以闭环方式调制感知；智能体性控制则涉及智能体可用的感知策略及其在这些策略中进行选择的权限。这些控制形式可以单独出现，也可以组合出现，并对感觉输入、知觉、行为和性能产生不同后果。该框架澄清了主动—被动比较，并通过追问控制什么、如何控制以及由谁控制，为分析生物、工程和混合感知系统提供了共同基础。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Polarization switching of double azimuthal backflow in two transverse orbital angular momentum superpositions
items.title_zh: 两个横向轨道角动量叠加中双重方位角回流的偏振切换
items.abstract_en: Optical backflow in the azimuthal direction can be generated by the interference of two rotating-wave structured light beams with distinct transverse topological charges and equal intensity. Here we show that the interference reverses both azimuthal components of the Poynting and the canonical momenta. Although these two momenta are not generally tied, they reverse jointly here: both acquire azimuthal backflow in a common angular sector, while their radial intervals can differ. The double backflow is switched solely by the polarizations of the two beams, without amplitude tuning. A single polarization overlap enters the interference terms of both momenta but not the single-beam terms of either, so that matched polarizations switch the double backflow on whereas mismatched ones switch it off. The double backflow is periodic in the azimuthal direction, with its angular period locked to the topological charge difference and independent of the individual charges. Our results establish a vectorial mechanism for polarization-gated azimuthal backflow, with potential applications in polarization-switchable optical manipulation.
items.abstract_zh: 方位角方向上的光学回流可由两束具有不同横向拓扑电荷且强度相等的旋转波结构光束干涉产生。在此我们表明，这种干涉会反转坡印廷动量和正则动量的两个方位角分量。尽管这两种动量通常并不绑定，但在此处它们会共同反转：二者都在一个共同的角扇区内获得方位角回流，而它们的径向间隔可以不同。双重回流仅由两束光的偏振切换，无需调节振幅。单一偏振重叠会进入两种动量的干涉项，但不进入任一光束的单束项，因此偏振匹配时双重回流开启，偏振不匹配时则关闭。双重回流在方位角方向上具有周期性，其角周期锁定于拓扑电荷差，而与各单独电荷无关。我们的结果建立了一种用于偏振门控方位角回流的矢量机制，并可能在偏振可切换的光学操控中得到应用。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: How Far Can Linear Go? BiPert, a Unified Framework for Single-Cell Perturbation Modelling
items.title_zh: 线性方法能走多远？BiPert：单细胞扰动建模的统一框架
items.abstract_en: Understanding how genetic perturbations affect cellular behaviour is essential for studying gene function and regulatory mechanisms. Large-scale CRISPR screens measure these effects across thousands of genes, but cover relatively few cellular contexts. Predicting perturbation responses in unseen cell types and identifying perturbed genes from their transcriptional effects therefore remain challenging. Here, we show that both tasks can be addressed through a common linear decomposition of transcriptional responses into shared and perturbation-specific components. Building on this principle, we introduce BiPert, a simple linear framework for both forward perturbation prediction and inverse identification. For forward prediction, BiPert outperforms existing methods that use no external biological knowledge when predicting gene expression changes in unseen cell lines. Its few-shot extension, BiPert-FS, adapts to new cell lines using as few as ten measured perturbations. For inverse identification, BiPert-ID identifies perturbed genes from single-cell expression profiles, outperforming deep-learning methods in unseen cell lines and donors. We further show that perturbations whose effects transfer more consistently across cellular contexts are also easier to identify, even after controlling for perturbation effect size. Together, these results establish a connection between perturbation transfer and identification, and demonstrate that simple linear models provide strong, interpretable baselines for both tasks.
items.abstract_zh: 理解遗传扰动如何影响细胞行为，对于研究基因功能和调控机制至关重要。大规模CRISPR筛选可在数千个基因上测量这些效应，但覆盖的细胞背景相对较少。因此，在未见细胞类型中预测扰动响应，以及从其转录效应中识别被扰动基因，仍然具有挑战性。在此我们表明，这两项任务都可以通过一种共同的线性分解来处理，即将转录响应分解为共享成分和扰动特异性成分。基于这一原理，我们提出BiPert，一个用于正向扰动预测和逆向识别的简单线性框架。在正向预测中，BiPert在预测未见细胞系中的基因表达变化时，优于不使用外部生物学知识的现有方法。其少样本扩展版本BiPert-FS仅使用少至十个已测量扰动即可适应新的细胞系。在逆向识别中，BiPert-ID从单细胞表达谱中识别被扰动基因，在未见细胞系和供体中优于深度学习方法。我们进一步表明，即使在控制扰动效应量之后，其效应在细胞背景间传递得更一致的扰动也更容易被识别。总之，这些结果建立了扰动传递与识别之间的联系，并证明简单线性模型可为这两项任务提供强大且可解释的基线。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: What Helps Language-Model Agents Review Violent Video? A Controlled Comparison with a Human Evidence Reference
items.title_zh: 什么有助于语言模型智能体审阅暴力视频？与人类证据参照的受控比较
items.abstract_en: Systems that flag violent video for a human operator can now be built from language models without training, by combining perception models and letting a language model decide. We ask how the observations of the perception models should reach the decision, and which evidence matters. On the XD-Violence test set (799 clips) we fix one set of perception agents (video description, object detection, sound tagging, speech recognition and speech tagging) and one reasoning model, and compare three interfaces: messages between agents, a typed evidence graph explored with tools, and flat text read in one pass; and a single audio-visual model given the raw clip. Two annotators provide a human reference that records the decision, the incident segments and whether they relied on sight, sound or speech. Flat text matches the single model (F1 0.967 against 0.968), while the graph agent and message passing are less accurate; a variant of the graph agent developed on a separate set did not close the gap, and both graph summaries and multi-turn tool use lowered accuracy. These results hold with reworded prompts and with a larger reasoning model, except that the larger model weakens message passing enough for the graph agent to beat it. Sound events improve F1 by +0.012 [+0.004, +0.021], in line with the annotators, who used sound or speech on most violent clips. Citations of stored observations are faithful, changing about half of the decisions when removed, but no more so with the graph than with flat text, and the agent pipeline costs about 3 times the GPU time of the single model. We also report two artefacts of vision-language describers that mislead pipelines built on them.
items.abstract_zh: 无需训练，把感知模型与语言模型组合起来即可构建为人工操作员标记暴力视频的系统。我们研究感知模型的观测应以何种方式进入决策，以及哪类证据更重要。在 XD-Violence 测试集（799 段）上固定一组感知智能体（视频描述、目标检测、声音标注、语音识别与语音标注）和一个推理模型，比较三种接口：智能体间消息传递、借助工具探索的类型化证据图、一次性读入的纯文本，并另设一个直接输入原始视频的音视频模型。两位标注者提供人类参照，记录决策、事件片段及是否依赖视觉、声音或语音。纯文本与单一模型表现相当（F1 0.967 对 0.968），证据图与消息传递更差；在另一数据集上改进的图智能体也未缩小差距，且多轮工具调用会降低准确率。改写提示或换用更大推理模型后结论基本成立（更大模型使消息传递变差，从而被图智能体反超）。声音事件带来 +0.012 的 F1 提升，与标注者大多依赖声音或语音一致。观测引用是忠实的，移除后约半数决策改变；但智能体流水线的 GPU 时间约为单一模型的 3 倍。我们还报告了视觉-语言描述器两类会误导流水线的假象。
items.highlight_zh: 复杂智能体接口未必更好，朴素纯文本输入准确率高且更省 GPU
items.digest_zh:
① 研究问题：为人工审核员标记暴力视频的系统，如今可以完全不训练——把若干现成感知模型（描述画面、检测物体、识别声音、语音转写等）拼起来，再让一个语言模型综合判断即可。但“怎么把观测喂给决策者”这个接口设计问题此前缺少系统比较；哪些证据（画面、声音、语音）真正有用也不清楚。
② 方法：作者在 XD-Violence 测试集（799 段视频）上做受控实验：固定同一组感知智能体和同一个推理模型，只改变接口——智能体之间互相发消息；用工具探索的类型化证据图；一次性读入的纯文本。另加一个直接看原始视频的音视频模型作对照。两位标注者建立人类参照，记录判断结果、事件片段，以及他们依据的是画面、声音还是语音。
③ 结果：纯文本最简单，效果却与单一音视频模型持平（F1 0.967 对 0.968）；证据图智能体和多轮消息传递反而更差，在另一份数据上专门改进的图智能体版本也没能追平；把证据图摘要化、或增加多轮工具调用，都会降低准确率。换措辞、换更强的推理模型后结论基本成立（唯一例外是更强的模型让消息传递退步，反而被图智能体反超）。声音事件带来约 +0.012 的小幅提升，与人类标注者大多依赖声音或语音相符。此外，智能体流水线的 GPU 时间约为单一模型的 3 倍。作者还指出视觉-语言描述器的两类系统性“假象”会误导基于它们搭建的流水线。
④ 为何重要：它提醒工程实践者，这类任务上“更复杂的智能体架构”未必更好——朴素的一次性文本输入，加上可靠的感知与声音证据，可能是性价比最高的方案；同时也量化了多智能体编排的成本与风险。

items.title_en: RUIBench: What Makes a Good Robot-Use Interface?
items.title_zh: RUIBench：什么造就了好的机器人使用接口？
items.abstract_en: Foundation models can reason about complex physical tasks, yet translating this intelligence into reliable robot execution remains challenging. We argue that a critical, often overlooked factor is the robot-use interface (RUI), which determines how agents express and execute physical actions. To systematically study its impact, we introduce RUIBench, comprising 30 manipulation tasks across five suites spanning world knowledge, in-context learning, discovery, dynamic interaction, and contact-rich manipulation. We further develop RUIKit, a unified framework that crosses six action abstractions with two interaction forms, yielding 13 interfaces under shared perception and control. In simulation, changing only the RUI shifts a frontier agent's success rate from 45% to 81%, and that of a fine-tuned 4B model from 13% to 47%. Our analysis reveals that effective interfaces reduce unnecessary decisions while preserving essential feedback, with their benefits shaped by agent behavior and physical uncertainty. We further uncover a verification gap, where agents frequently declare success despite observable failures, revealing the need for task-level verification beyond individual actions. Together, these findings establish RUI design as a critical factor in embodied agent reliability.
items.abstract_zh: 基础模型能够对复杂物理任务进行推理，但将这种智能转化为可靠的机器人执行仍然具有挑战性。我们认为，一个关键但常被忽视的因素是机器人使用接口（RUI），它决定了智能体如何表达和执行物理动作。为系统研究其影响，我们提出RUIBench，包含跨越五个任务套件的30个操作任务，覆盖世界知识、上下文学习、发现、动态交互和接触丰富操作。我们进一步开发了RUIKit，一个统一框架，将六种动作抽象与两种交互形式交叉组合，在共享感知与控制下产生13种接口。在仿真中，仅改变RUI即可使前沿智能体的成功率从45%提升到81%，并使微调的4B模型从13%提升到47%。我们的分析表明，有效接口可减少不必要的决策，同时保留关键反馈，其收益受智能体行为和物理不确定性影响。我们进一步揭示了一个验证缺口：智能体常常在存在可观察失败的情况下宣称成功，这表明需要在单个动作之外进行任务级验证。总之，这些发现确立了RUI设计是具身智能体可靠性的关键因素。

items.title_en: One Prior, Two Dynamics: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Self-Supervised Latent Action Learning
items.title_zh: 一个先验，两种动力学：复用视频扩散Transformer进行自监督潜在动作学习
items.abstract_en: Videos reveal how the world changes, but rarely the actions that cause those changes. Latent action learning recovers such supervision from visual transitions, yet often learns the underlying dynamics largely from scratch. We ask whether a pretrained video generator can instead provide the prior for both inverse and forward dynamics. We introduce O$^{2}$LaF, built on a simple principle: one prior, two dynamics. We initialize both models from the same pretrained video DiT and adapt them to their distinct roles: a feed-forward transition encoder with learnable action queries for inverse dynamics, and a causal, action-conditioned video generator for forward dynamics. By controlling information access and optimizing both dynamics end-to-end through a compact bottleneck, O$^{2}$LaF learns transferable actions from unlabeled videos. Across navigation and robotic manipulation, O$^{2}$LaF sets a new state of the art in few-shot action probing and enables stronger zero-shot action transfer across visual contexts and embodiments. Beyond generative video priors, we further extend our framework to predictive representation priors such as V-JEPA2, achieving competitive performance. Our findings suggest a broader paradigm for latent-action learning: repurposing pretrained video models to discover transferable actions and predict their consequences.
items.abstract_zh: 视频揭示世界如何变化，但很少揭示导致这些变化的动作。潜在动作学习从视觉变化中恢复此类监督，但通常仍主要从头学习底层动力学。我们探究预训练视频生成器能否转而同时为逆向动力学和正向动力学提供先验。我们提出O$^{2}$LaF，其基于一个简单原则：一个先验，两种动力学。我们从同一个预训练视频DiT初始化两个模型，并使它们适应各自不同的角色：一个带有可学习动作查询的前馈转移编码器用于逆向动力学，以及一个因果的、以动作为条件的视频生成器用于正向动力学。通过控制信息访问并通过紧凑瓶颈端到端优化两种动力学，O$^{2}$LaF从无标注视频中学习可迁移动作。在导航和机器人操作中，O$^{2}$LaF在少样本动作探测上设定了新的最先进水平，并实现了跨视觉上下文和具身形态更强的零样本动作迁移。除生成式视频先验之外，我们进一步将框架扩展到V-JEPA2等预测式表示先验，取得了有竞争力的性能。我们的发现提示了一种更广泛的潜在动作学习范式：复用预训练视频模型来发现可迁移动作并预测其后果。

items.title_en: Infrared Relaxation Modes and the Emergence of Collective Order in Neural Dynamics
items.title_zh: 红外弛豫模式与神经动力学中集体秩序的出现
items.abstract_en: We develop a microscopic field theory of collective order formation in interacting nonlinear neural systems. Integrating out microscopic neural degrees of freedom yields an effective action whose quadratic kernel determines the ordering threshold, while higher-order connected responses govern nonlinear stabilization. Spectral decomposition reveals that relaxation rates and collective-mode overlaps control collective instability and memory dynamics. Enhanced infrared spectral weight lowers the critical coupling and generates long-time memory, revealing a common spectral origin of collective ordering and persistent dynamics. Controlled numerical constructions verify the spectral dependence of collective instability and response, while nonlinear mean-field scaling follows from the microscopic Landau expansion. Transformer Jacobian spectra further reveal learning-induced infrared organization and transient memory enhancement consistent with critical-like response. Our results establish a microscopic framework linking neural interactions, collective order, and long-time memory.
items.abstract_zh: 我们为相互作用的非线性神经系统中集体秩序的形成建立了一个微观场论。积掉微观神经自由度可得到一个有效作用量，其二次核决定有序化阈值，而高阶连通响应支配非线性稳定化。谱分解表明，弛豫率和集体模式重叠控制集体不稳定性与记忆动力学。增强的红外谱权重降低临界耦合并产生长时记忆，揭示了集体有序化与持续动力学的共同谱起源。受控数值构造验证了集体不稳定性和响应的谱依赖性，而非线性平均场标度则可由微观朗道展开得到。Transformer雅可比谱进一步揭示了学习诱导的红外组织以及瞬态记忆增强，这与类临界响应一致。我们的结果建立了一个将神经相互作用、集体秩序和长时记忆联系起来的微观框架。

items.title_en: Designing Incoherent Multispectral Diffractive Optical Networks for Satellite Image Classification
items.title_zh: 设计用于卫星图像分类的非相干多光谱衍射光学网络
items.abstract_en: Optical neural networks and diffractive optical computing provide a promising route for performing task-specific inference with high parallelism and lightweight electronic post-processing. These advantages are especially attractive for multispectral satellite imaging, where conventional workflows rely on transmitting high-dimensional image cubes to the ground for downstream electronic analysis. Here, we introduce a computationally efficient surrogate model-guided framework for designing incoherent multispectral diffractive optical networks that directly output class probabilities onboard, eliminating the need to capture and transfer the full multispectral data cube for ground-side inference. We first train a physically compatible surrogate model, represented by a non-negative fully connected model that accommodates a generalized detector readout, yielding a task-specific non-negative multispectral intensity transformation that can be transferred to an optical processor. We then synthesize its diffractive counterpart through data-free point-spread-function-based optimization under spatially incoherent illumination. Using this approach, we numerically demonstrate a six-spectral-channel diffractive classifier for tri-class satellite-scene recognition, achieving a blind-testing accuracy of 79.8% for artificial surface, water body, and vegetated land images, closely approaching the 81.8% accuracy of its surrogate. We further demonstrate a more compact three-spectral-channel design that numerically achieves 72.7% blind-testing accuracy, compared with 75.1% for its corresponding surrogate model. This surrogate model-guided strategy provides a practical pathway for designing compact, task-specific incoherent multispectral optical processors for resource-constrained remote-sensing inference.
items.abstract_zh: 光学神经网络和衍射光学计算为以高并行度和轻量电子后处理执行任务特定推理提供了一条有前景的途径。这些优势对多光谱卫星成像尤其有吸引力，因为传统工作流程依赖将高维图像立方体传输到地面进行下游电子分析。在此，我们引入一种计算高效的代理模型引导框架，用于设计非相干多光谱衍射光学网络，该网络直接在星上输出类别概率，从而无需捕获和传输完整多光谱数据立方体以进行地面侧推理。我们首先训练一个物理兼容的代理模型，该模型由非负全连接模型表示，可容纳广义探测器读出，产生任务特定的非负多光谱强度变换，可转移到光学处理器。然后，我们在空间非相干照明下通过无数据点扩散函数优化合成其衍射对应物。使用该方法，我们数值演示了一个用于三分类卫星场景识别的六光谱通道衍射分类器，在人工地表、水体、植被土地图像上达到79.8%的盲测准确率，接近其代理模型的81.8%准确率。我们进一步演示了一个更紧凑的三光谱通道设计，数值上达到72.7%盲测准确率，而相应代理模型为75.1%。这种代理模型引导策略为设计用于资源受限遥感推理的紧凑、任务特定非相干多光谱光学处理器提供了一条实用途径。

items.title_en: Agentic AI for Intent Management and Control in Autonomous Communication Networks
items.title_zh: 面向自主通信网络中意图管理与控制的智能体AI
items.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI)-driven automation will help future mobile networks translate high-level network intents into concrete network optimization or control actions. However, existing approaches often focus on intent management and orchestration, leaving the adaptation of underlying network optimization and control functions largely unaddressed. This article proposes a triadic agentic AI framework that co-designs intent management and intent fulfillment through three agents: an interpreter, powered by a language model, that translates and refines intents into machine-readable optimization templates; an optimizer that adapts controller policies to intent specifications; and a controller that performs fast decision-making. We discuss the design space of each agent and how the workflow can be embedded across network architectural domains. Finally, we develop a concrete realization combining a language-model interpreter with Bayesian optimization for the optimizer and multi-objective reinforcement learning for the controller, and evaluate it in a radio resource management case study for differentiated connectivity. Results demonstrate how the agentic AI framework can connect high-level intents with runtime network control, showing adaptability of intent specifications and control policies to service requirements and changing network conditions.
items.abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）驱动的自动化将帮助未来移动网络将高层网络意图转化为具体的网络优化或控制动作。然而，现有方法通常侧重意图管理与编排，基本未处理底层网络优化与控制功能的适配问题。本文提出一个三元智能体AI框架，通过三个智能体协同设计意图管理与意图履行：一个由语言模型驱动的解释器，将意图翻译并细化为机器可读的优化模板；一个优化器，使控制器策略适配意图规范；以及一个执行快速决策的控制器。我们讨论每个智能体的设计空间，以及该工作流如何嵌入跨网络架构域。最后，我们开发一个具体实现，将语言模型解释器与用于优化器的贝叶斯优化、用于控制器的多目标强化学习相结合，并在面向差异化连接的无线电资源管理案例研究中对其进行评估。结果表明，该智能体AI框架如何将高层意图与运行时网络控制连接起来，展示意图规范和控制策略对服务需求和变化网络条件的适应性。

items.title_en: SheetAlign: Grounded Interaction and Stage-Isolated Learning for Spreadsheet Agents
items.title_zh: SheetAlign：面向电子表格智能体的接地交互与阶段隔离学习
items.abstract_en: Spreadsheets are widely used for data analysis and supporting decision-making. Automating spreadsheet analysis while protecting sensitive data and controlling deployment costs motivates locally deployed open-weight large language models (LLMs). Meanwhile, complex spreadsheet tasks require both task reasoning and workbook understanding, while predefined operation interfaces impose additional tool-selection and invocation demands. We introduce SheetAlign, a spreadsheet manipulation framework with stage-isolated policy learning, organized around where to operate, what to change, and how to implement transformations. Task-guided inspection and API grounding anchor code generation in workbook observations and available operations, while stage-isolated learning optimizes program generation and review using edit-progress rewards. At inference, execution consistency selects programs through agreement among workbook states. On SpreadsheetBench, our grounded task interface improves Qwen3-4B's accuracy from 13.5% to 29.2% on average without training. With learning and execution consistency, SheetAlign achieves 32.8% accuracy on average on SpreadsheetBench and 30.1% on Domain-Spreadsheet, outperforming comparable baselines. The code will be made publicly available upon publication.
items.abstract_zh: 电子表格广泛用于数据分析与决策。为保护敏感数据并控制部署成本，本地部署的开源大模型成为自动化表格分析的选择。复杂表格任务既需任务推理又需理解工作簿，预定义操作接口还带来工具选择与调用负担。我们提出 SheetAlign 框架，以阶段隔离策略学习围绕“在哪里操作、改什么、如何实现变换”组织流程：任务引导的检查与 API 接地把代码生成锚定在工作簿观察和可用操作上，阶段隔离学习用编辑进度奖励优化程序生成与审查，推理时以工作簿状态间的一致性筛选程序。无需训练，接地任务接口就把 Qwen3-4B 在 SpreadsheetBench 上的平均准确率从 13.5% 提升到 29.2%；加入学习与执行一致性后平均达 32.8%，在 Domain-Spreadsheet 上达 30.1%，优于同类基线。
items.highlight_zh: 阶段隔离学习让 4B 小模型表格操作准确率翻倍
items.digest_zh:
• 问题：让 AI 自动改电子表格（改单元格、写公式、做汇总）很难，模型既要懂任务意图，又要读懂工作簿结构，还得在有限的操作接口里选对工具；出于数据隐私与成本考虑，最好用本地部署的开源小模型，但小模型直接上手准确率很低。
• 方法：SheetAlign 把任务拆成三问——在哪里操作、改什么、怎么改。它先让模型主动检查工作簿，并把真实可用的 API“接地”进提示；再分阶段训练，程序生成与程序审查各自单独优化，奖励来自编辑是否让表格朝目标推进；推理时让模型生成多份程序，按执行后工作簿状态是否一致来挑选。
• 结果：仅靠接地接口、不训练，Qwen3-4B 在 SpreadsheetBench 上就从 13.5% 提升到 29.2%；加上分阶段学习和执行一致性后平均 32.8%，跨领域数据集 30.1%，超过同类基线。
• 意义：说明小模型不必靠蛮力，只要把观察、可用接口和训练目标对齐，也能在真实办公任务上达到可用水平，并可本地部署、保护敏感数据。

items.title_en: AgentMoT: An Agentic Mixture-of-Transformers for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: AgentMoT：面向端到端自动驾驶的智能体混合Transformer
items.abstract_en: Driving models need to choose which capabilities to use and when to reconsider their decisions. We introduce AgentMoT, a Mixture-of-Transformers with built-in agent reasoning and system scheduling. Combinations of agent, world, and action experts form three jointly trained pathways for direct-action, vision-language-action, and world-action computation. The Router selects a native pathway, while the agent expert supplies reasoning and selects skills. Execution feedback raises wake-up requests, and the agent self-scheduler learns whether to reconsider the task decision or keep it. Mandatory requests invoke the agent directly. The relative-capability principle guides these choices by relating the benefit of additional computation or intervention to its cost. After open-loop initialization, dual-loop evolution trains the Router, agent, and self-scheduler from closed-loop experience while failure-driven updates refine skills and execution feedback. AgentMoT achieves state-of-the-art results on Bench2Drive v0.0.3 and v0.0.4, with 94.48/92.33 driving score and 85.45/82.73% success rate, respectively. With skills disabled, learned routing improves over the strongest fixed pathway by 1.79 driving-score points and 4.09 percentage points of success rate on v0.0.3. Ablation studies further show gains from closed-loop agent learning, two-view queries, and event-triggered wake-up.
items.abstract_zh: 驾驶模型需要选择使用哪些能力以及何时重新考虑其决策。我们提出 AgentMoT，一种内置智能体推理和系统调度的 Transformer 混合架构。智能体、世界和动作专家的组合形成三条联合训练的路径，分别用于直接动作、视觉-语言-动作和世界-动作计算。Router 选择一条原生路径，而智能体专家提供推理并选择技能。执行反馈会触发唤醒请求，智能体自调度器学习是重新考虑任务决策还是保持该决策。强制请求会直接调用智能体。相对能力原则通过将额外计算或干预的收益与其成本相关联来指导这些选择。在开环初始化之后，双循环演化利用闭环经验训练 Router、智能体和自调度器，同时失败驱动的更新会改进技能和执行反馈。AgentMoT 在 Bench2Drive v0.0.3 和 v0.0.4 上取得最先进结果，驾驶得分分别为 94.48/92.33，成功率为 85.45/82.73%。在禁用技能的情况下，学习到的路由在 v0.0.3 上比最强的固定路径提高 1.79 个驾驶得分点和 4.09 个百分点的成功率。消融研究进一步表明来自闭环智能体学习、双视图查询和事件触发唤醒的增益。

items.title_en: WildAnySplat: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting in the Wild
items.title_zh: WildAnySplat：野外场景中的前馈式3D高斯泼溅
items.abstract_en: We present WildAnySplat, a feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that enables robust novel-view synthesis from in-the-wild multi-view images. Unlike controlled captures, real-world images often contain multi-view inconsistencies caused by transient occluders, illumination changes, and camera ISP, which degrade the quality of existing feed-forward reconstruction methods. To address this challenge, we introduce a student-teacher framework that learns transient-robust and appearance-consistent 3D representations. A teacher network operates on clean images, while a student processes the corresponding in-the-wild inputs. The teacher provides clean supervision to guide the student toward a consistent canonical representation. Since paired clean and in-the-wild data are scarce, we use a hybrid data strategy, combining real paired captures, synthetic augmentations, and pseudo-clean labels generated from optimization-based reconstructions, bridging the domain gap between synthetic and real-world data. We adopt a transformer architecture with dedicated DPT heads for camera pose, depth, and Gaussian prediction. We additionally predict per-view transient masks to reweight photometric supervision and suppress unreliable Gaussians. To account for cross-view appearance variation, we incorporate a bilateral grid module that models per-image color transformations and enables recovery of a canonical radiance representation. Experiments on challenging in-the-wild benchmarks show that WildAnySplat improves robustness to transient occlusions and appearance variation while retaining the fast inference of feed-forward Gaussian Splatting.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 WildAnySplat，一种前馈式 3D 高斯泼溅框架，能够从野外多视图图像中进行稳健的新视图合成。与受控拍摄不同，真实世界图像通常包含由瞬态遮挡物、光照变化和相机 ISP 引起的多视图不一致，这会降低现有前馈重建方法的质量。为应对这一挑战，我们引入一个学生-教师框架，学习对瞬态鲁棒且外观一致的 3D 表示。教师网络在干净图像上运行，而学生网络处理相应的野外输入。教师提供干净监督，引导学生朝向一致的规范表示。由于配对的干净和野外数据稀缺，我们采用混合数据策略，结合真实配对拍摄、合成增强以及由基于优化的重建生成的伪干净标签，弥合合成数据与真实世界数据之间的域差距。我们采用 Transformer 架构，并配备专用 DPT 头用于相机姿态、深度和高斯预测。我们额外预测每视图瞬态掩码，以重新加权光度监督并抑制不可靠高斯。为考虑跨视图外观变化，我们引入双边网格模块，对每张图像的颜色变换建模，并能够恢复规范辐射表示。在具有挑战性的野外基准上的实验表明，WildAnySplat 在保持前馈高斯泼溅快速推理的同时，提高了对瞬态遮挡和外观变化的鲁棒性。

items.title_en: cloneXplorer: A high-throughput clone discovery platform based on conical microwell arrays
items.title_zh: cloneXplorer：基于锥形微孔阵列的高通量克隆发现平台
items.abstract_en: Monoclonal, antigen-specific T cell populations are of great value for studying immune recognition but tedious to generate by limiting dilution or genetic manipulation. Here, we develop a streamlined approach to generate antigen-specific single cell-derived T cell populations directly from peripheral blood using the cloneXplorer, a live-cell analysis and clone isolation platform based on an open format 96-well plate of conical microwell arrays. This platform continuously monitors cell proliferation, cytokine secretion, and surface markers in up to 100,000 single cell co-cultures, enabling the identification of rare, functionally defined T cells, which can be recovered for clonal expansion or sequence analysis. We benchmark the platform by performing several key demonstrations. First, we show that this platform can efficiently generate monoclonal cell populations from cell lines and human T cells. Next, we demonstrate that antigen-specificity can be identified at single cell resolution using a Jurkat cell model that expresses NFAT-GFP, CD8, and a T cell receptor recognizing a specific antigen in a peptide library expressed by K562 antigen presenting cells. Thereafter, we show that immune activation in mouse and human primary samples can be monitored by time lapse analysis of IFN-{gamma} secretion in individual microwell co-cultures using a fluorescent sandwich assay. Finally, we combine these capabilities in a proof-of-concept demonstration, which uses IFN-{gamma} secretion and the presence of CD8 surface markers as hierarchical gates to isolate and expand antigen-specific T cells from human peripheral blood, and we verify their specificity by tetramer staining. Together, these results showcase potential applications of the cloneXplorer platform in cell line development, and in screening and validating immune receptor interactions with specific antigens.
items.abstract_zh: 单克隆、抗原特异性T细胞群体对于研究免疫识别具有重要价值，但通过有限稀释或遗传操作生成十分繁琐。在此，我们开发一种简化方法，利用 cloneXplorer 直接从外周血生成抗原特异性单细胞来源的T细胞群体；cloneXplorer 是一个基于开放式锥形微孔阵列96孔板的活细胞分析和克隆分离平台。该平台可在多达100,000个单细胞共培养中连续监测细胞增殖、细胞因子分泌和表面标志物，从而能够识别罕见的、功能定义的T细胞，并可将其回收用于克隆扩增或序列分析。我们通过若干关键演示对该平台进行基准测试。首先，我们表明该平台能够从细胞系和人T细胞高效生成单克隆细胞群体。接下来，我们证明可以使用表达 NFAT-GFP、CD8 以及识别 K562 抗原呈递细胞所表达肽库中特定抗原的T细胞受体的 Jurkat 细胞模型，在单细胞分辨率下识别抗原特异性。此后，我们表明可以使用荧光夹心分析通过时间推移分析单个微孔共培养中的 IFN-γ 分泌，监测小鼠和人原代样本中的免疫激活。最后，我们在概念验证演示中结合这些能力，使用 IFN-γ 分泌和 CD8 表面标志物的存在作为分层门控，从人外周血中分离并扩增抗原特异性T细胞，并通过四聚体染色验证其特异性。总之，这些结果展示了 cloneXplorer 平台在细胞系开发以及筛选和验证免疫受体与特定抗原相互作用方面的潜在应用。

items.title_en: Domain advantage in two-dimensional quantum-device design with multi-modal agentic harness
items.title_zh: 多模态智能体工具框架下二维量子器件设计的领域优势
items.abstract_en: High-quality two-dimensional quantum devices are commonly fabricated from mechanically exfoliated crystals, whose irregular shapes and placement require a lithographic layout tailored to each specimen. Drawing these layouts remains largely manual. We introduce qlaybench, a benchmark that tests whether language-model agents can turn microscope images and experimental requirements into device layouts that fit the specimen. Agents with conventional tools often construct devices when material outlines are supplied, but struggle to identify those outlines from images. Modelled on the human workflow, qlaybot, a multimodal agentic harness, connects image interpretation to the tools used to align images, draw device features and inspect the resulting layout. We evaluate each layout with checks drawn from practical design experience, asking whether it fits the specimen and connects its intended components. With greater computational effort, an agent using qlaybot passes 81.5% of the benchmark tasks, compared with 24.1% when it uses conventional tools. This domain advantage highlights the importance of connecting scientific interpretation of a specimen to geometric design and provides a route towards reducing manual effort in two-dimensional quantum-device fabrication.
items.abstract_zh: 高质量二维量子器件通常由机械剥离晶体制备，其不规则形状和放置位置要求为每个样品定制光刻版图。绘制这些版图在很大程度上仍是手工完成。我们引入 qlaybench，一个基准，用于测试语言模型智能体能否将显微图像和实验要求转化为适合样品的器件版图。使用传统工具的智能体在提供材料轮廓时通常能构建器件，但难以从图像中识别这些轮廓。以人类工作流程为模型，qlaybot 是一个多模态智能体工具框架，将图像解释与用于对齐图像、绘制器件特征并检查所得版图的工具连接起来。我们使用从实际设计经验中提取的检查来评估每个版图，询问其是否适合样品并连接其预期组件。在更大的计算投入下，使用 qlaybot 的智能体通过81.5%的基准任务，而使用传统工具时为24.1%。这种领域优势凸显了将样品的科学解释与几何设计相连接的重要性，并提供了一条减少二维量子器件制造中手工工作量的途径。

items.title_en: RoFE: Rotated Frozen Embeddings for Low-Data Multimodal Tabular Learning
items.title_zh: RoFE：用于低数据多模态表格学习的旋转冻结嵌入
items.abstract_en: Multimodal tabular learning combines tabular data with images and text, often in settings where labeled data are scarce. Tabular foundation models such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) offer a promising solution via in-context learning without task-specific training. However, modern image and text encoders produce embeddings with hundreds or thousands of dimensions, far exceeding the number of features encountered during PFN pretraining. Existing approaches bridge this gap using principal component analysis (PCA) to compress frozen embeddings. Surprisingly, we find that this PCA interface can underperform simple linear classifiers when labeled examples are scarce, even though PFNs are designed for small datasets. We identify the underlying failure mechanism: the PFN's per-column standardization removes the variances of the PCA scores. When the PCA keeps every direction of the labeled examples, the examples collapse into a regular simplex in which all pairwise distances are equal. To address this problem, we propose Rotated Frozen Embeddings (RoFE), a training-free method that rotates PCA scores before PFN inference. We theoretically show that rotation makes the column variances nearly equal, so that standardization approximately preserves the embedding geometry. Across image and text classification tasks, encoders, and tabular foundation models, RoFE improves low-data performance over the PCA interface and outperforms baselines that require task-specific training. The improvements also extend to regression.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态表格学习将表格数据与图像和文本结合，且常处于标注数据稀缺的场景。先验数据拟合网络（PFN）等表格基础模型通过上下文学习提供了一种无需任务特定训练的有前景方案。然而，现代图像和文本编码器产生的嵌入具有数百或数千维，远超 PFN 预训练时遇到的特征数量。现有方法使用主成分分析（PCA）压缩冻结嵌入来弥合这一差距。令人意外的是，我们发现当标注样本稀缺时，这种 PCA 接口可能不如简单线性分类器，尽管 PFN 正是为小数据集设计的。我们识别出潜在的失效机制：PFN 的按列标准化会移除 PCA 得分的方差。当 PCA 保留标注样本的每个方向时，样本会坍缩成一个所有成对距离都相等的正单纯形。为解决该问题，我们提出旋转冻结嵌入（RoFE），一种在 PFN 推理前旋转 PCA 得分的免训练方法。我们从理论上表明，旋转使列方差近乎相等，从而使标准化近似保留嵌入几何。在图像和文本分类任务、编码器以及表格基础模型上，RoFE 相比 PCA 接口提升了低数据性能，并优于需要任务特定训练的基线。这些改进也扩展到回归。

items.title_en: Self-WSP: Can Language Models Improve Themselves Through Weight-Space Programming?
items.title_zh: Self-WSP：语言模型能否通过权重空间编程实现自我改进？
items.abstract_en: Frontier language models can now read and edit the weights of a neural network much like code and thereby improve a small model, an approach known as Weight-Space Programming (WSP). We further explore applying WSP to a language model itself, which we call Self-WSP. Specifically, Qwen3.5-0.8B reads its own weights, proposes an edit, and then continues with the edited weights as both problem solver and editor. We find many cases of genuine self-improvement. Self-edits can raise GSM8K accuracy from 11.8% to 62.2% and MATH500 accuracy from 7.0% to 32.2%, sometimes by changing only 16 parameters, and in some cases repeated self-editing keeps improving the model. A closer look, however, reveals that these gains lack interpretability. The model shows little understanding of the edits it makes, and WSP driven by random search sometimes performs comparably. Self-WSP thus holds promise as a path toward recursive self-improvement (RSI), but realizing this promise requires further exploration.
items.abstract_zh: 前沿语言模型现在能够像处理代码一样读取和编辑神经网络权重，从而改进一个小模型，这种方法称为权重空间编程（WSP）。我们进一步探索将 WSP 应用于语言模型本身，称之为 Self-WSP。具体而言，Qwen3.5-0.8B 读取自身权重，提出一次编辑，然后以编辑后的权重继续，同时充当问题求解器和编辑器。我们发现许多真实自我改进的案例。自我编辑可将 GSM8K 准确率从 11.8% 提升到 62.2%，将 MATH500 准确率从 7.0% 提升到 32.2%，有时仅改变 16 个参数，且在某些情况下重复自我编辑会持续改进模型。然而，进一步观察发现这些增益缺乏可解释性。模型对其所做编辑的理解很少，而由随机搜索驱动的 WSP 有时表现相当。因此，Self-WSP 作为通往递归自我改进（RSI）的一条路径具有前景，但实现这一前景仍需进一步探索。

items.title_en: Confidently Lost: Silent Failure and Edge Deployment of Dense Visual SLAM under Photon Starvation
items.title_zh: 自信地迷失：光子匮乏下稠密视觉 SLAM 的静默失败与边缘部署
items.abstract_en: Dense visual SLAM built on learned two-view geometry is evaluated in good light; in low light it fails silently. Two frames of 9-level quantized noise, no scene at all, give MASt3R-SLAM's network a cross-view geometric self-consistency of 0.936; a real dark frame pair gives 0.935. Starved of structure, the network invents the same geometry for both views and the system trusts the agreement: on a dark sequence it consumes 1,605 frames, emits 7 keyframes, rejects no factor-graph edges and reports full frame rate, while over 95% of the correspondences it accepts violate the ground-truth epipolar geometry. One inflated statistic is read by two subsystems against thresholds in opposite directions, so keyframing starves while relocalization accepts almost every candidate. The same statistic, read at keyframe-pair baselines, separates the confident collapse from working runs on the ETH3D dark sequences without ground truth or extra computation (in-sample). Low-light-adapted weights take tracked trajectories from 1/6 to 5/6, as does retuning two thresholds; neither yields accurate ones, because the adaptation withdraws confidence from wrong geometry rather than finding right geometry. Replayed on a Jetson AGX Orin carried by a legged robot, the mechanism's signature reproduces on the two darkest of four routes, and which of its faces appears varies with route geometry and sensor encoding. The network does not lose confidence in the dark; it manufactures it.
items.abstract_zh: 基于学习到的双视图几何构建的稠密视觉 SLAM 通常在良好光照下评估；在低光下它会静默失败。两帧 9 级量化噪声、完全没有场景，使 MASt3R-SLAM 的网络获得 0.936 的跨视图几何自一致性；一对真实暗光帧则给出 0.935。由于缺乏结构，网络为两个视图虚构出相同几何，而系统信任这种一致性：在暗光序列上，它消耗 1,605 帧，输出 7 个关键帧，不拒绝任何因子图边并报告满帧率，而其接受的对应关系中超过 95% 违反真值对极几何。一个被夸大的统计量被两个子系统以相反方向的阈值读取，因此关键帧选择饿死，而重定位几乎接受每个候选。同一统计量在关键帧对基线上读取时，无需真值或额外计算（样本内），即可在 ETH3D 暗光序列上区分这种自信崩溃与正常运行。低光自适应权重将被跟踪轨迹从 1/6 提升到 5/6，重新调整两个阈值也有同样效果；但二者都不能产生准确的轨迹，因为这种自适应是从错误几何中撤回置信度，而不是找到正确几何。在由腿式机器人携带的 Jetson AGX Orin 上回放时，该机制的签名在四条路线中最暗的两条上重现，且其呈现出的具体表现随路线几何和传感器编码而变化。网络在黑暗中并没有失去置信度；它是在制造置信度。

items.title_en: Parsing Visual Latents for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning
items.title_zh: 解析视觉潜变量以进行多模态空间推理
items.abstract_en: Spatial reasoning across multiple views requires inferring the 3D relations between objects and the camera from 2D observations, which depends on cross-view correspondence and scene geometry that vision-language models (VLMs) do not reliably extract. Pretrained vision encoders already capture this information in their latent features, with CLIP linking objects to image regions, DINOv3 matching semantics across views, and VGGT encoding multi-view geometry. However, VLMs do not benefit from these features when we present them directly in context as grayscale feature images. We therefore propose LatentParse, a training-free framework that parses latent features into explicit spatial evidence for VLMs. In LatentParse, an analyst VLM probes the features of all three encoders with predefined tools that locate objects, track them across views, and measure motion between views. It then distills the results into a concise text report, which is provided together with the images to the VLM to answer the question. We evaluate LatentParse on MMSI-Bench, MV-RoboBench and SPAR-Bench, where it improves all five VLMs over the photo-only baseline by 0.7-2.4 percentage points on average. On MMSI-Bench, it raises Qwen3.8-27B from 34.4% to 39.5%, with the largest improvements of 19.2 percentage points on the camera-related questions. These results suggest that latent features become useful for spatial reasoning once they are parsed into relation evidence, without training. Code is available at https://github.com/Harvard-AI-and-Robotics-Lab/LatentParse.
items.abstract_zh: 跨多个视图的空间推理需要从 2D 观测推断物体与相机之间的 3D 关系，这依赖于视觉语言模型（VLM）无法可靠提取的跨视图对应关系和场景几何。预训练视觉编码器已在其潜在特征中捕获这些信息：CLIP 将物体与图像区域关联，DINOv3 跨视图匹配语义，VGGT 编码多视图几何。然而，当我们将这些特征以灰度特征图形式直接呈现在上下文中时，VLM 并不能从中受益。因此，我们提出 LatentParse，一个免训练框架，将潜在特征解析为供 VLM 使用的显式空间证据。在 LatentParse 中，一个分析者 VLM 使用预定义工具探测全部三个编码器的特征，这些工具定位物体、跨视图跟踪物体并测量视图间运动。随后它将结果提炼为简洁的文本报告，并与图像一起提供给 VLM 以回答问题。我们在 MMSI-Bench、MV-RoboBench 和 SPAR-Bench 上评估 LatentParse；相比仅图像基线，它使全部五个 VLM 平均提升 0.7–2.4 个百分点。在 MMSI-Bench 上，它将 Qwen3.8-27B 从 34.4% 提升到 39.5%，在相机相关问题上的最大提升为 19.2 个百分点。这些结果表明，潜在特征一旦被解析为关系证据，无需训练即可用于空间推理。代码可在 https://github.com/Harvard-AI-and-Robotics-Lab/LatentParse 获取。

items.title_en: Confidence-Guided Machine Learning Staging of the Mouse Estrous Cycle from External Anatomical Images Reduces Cytology Burden
items.title_zh: 基于外部解剖图像的置信度引导机器学习小鼠动情周期分期，减轻细胞学负担
items.abstract_en: Although the 2015 National Institutes of Health mandate to consider sex as a biological variable in preclinical studies has increased sex-inclusive study designs, many research groups continue to cite the complexity of monitoring female-specific physiology as a barrier to adoption. Central to this challenge is the murine estrous cycle, a hormonally driven process comprising four stages (proestrus, estrus, metestrus, and diestrus), each associated with distinct hormonal and cytological profiles. Current staging methods rely primarily on vaginal cytology, which requires skilled animal handling, specialized expertise in cytology observation, and considerable time, limiting their routine application outside of reproductive endocrinology. To address these barriers, we developed and evaluated a machine learning framework for estrous cycle staging based on photographs of the mouse external vaginal opening. Using 2,297 photographs from C57BL/6J and BALB/c female mice paired with concurrent cytological assessments and partitioned strictly at the animal level, we trained and evaluated three models of varying granularity: a four-stage model, a three-stage model combining metestrus and diestrus, and a two-stage binary model separating the follicular from the luteal and transitional phases. In a held-out evaluation cohort of 466 photographs from 29 unseen mice, overall classification accuracy was 47.4% (95% CI: 40.7-51.9%) for the four-stage model, 54.5% (47.6-62.9%) for the three-group model, and 69.5% (61.8-75.3%) for the binary two-group model. Misclassifications occurred predominantly between biologically adjacent stages, particularly between proestrus and estrus. Crucially, applying a calibrated confidence threshold to the two-group classifier increased accuracy to 82.8% (95% CI: 71.1-92.1%) among the 43.8% of photographs with confidence [≥] 0.80, and to 92.5% (95% CI: 87.1-96.6%) among the 20.0% of photographs with confidence [≥] 0.90. While external photography does not support standalone four-stage classification, confidence-guided photographic assessment offers an accessible decision-support framework to selectively triage uncertain cases for cytology and reduce the wet-lab burden of estrous monitoring in preclinical research, including cohort assembly for hormone-dependent models of genital tract infection.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管2015年美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）要求将性别作为生物学变量纳入临床前研究，提升了纳入两性的研究设计比例，但许多团队仍以监测雌性特有生理的复杂性为由不予采用。核心难点是小鼠动情周期：它由激素驱动，分为动情前期、动情期、动情后期与间情期四个阶段，各有不同的激素与细胞学特征。现有分期主要依赖阴道细胞学，需要熟练的动物操作、专业的细胞学判读与大量时间，限制了其在生殖内分泌学之外的常规使用。为降低门槛，作者开发并评估了基于小鼠外阴开口照片的机器学习分期框架。使用C57BL/6J与BALB/c雌鼠的2,297张照片（配合同期细胞学评估，并严格按动物划分数据集），训练并评估了三种粒度模型：四阶段模型、合并动情后期与间情期的三阶段模型、区分卵泡期与黄体及过渡期的二分类模型。在由29只未参与训练的雌鼠的466张照片构成的留出队列中，整体准确率分别为47.4%（95% CI 40.7–51.9%）、54.5%（47.6–62.9%）与69.5%（61.8–75.3%）；误分类主要发生在生物学上相邻的阶段之间，尤其是动情前期与动情期。关键在于，对二分类器施加校准后的置信度阈值可将准确率提升至82.8%。
items.highlight_zh: 外阴照片加置信度阈值实现无创分期，大幅减少细胞学负担
items.digest_zh:
• 研究了什么问题：NIH要求临床前研究纳入雌性动物，但很多实验室嫌“追踪动情周期太麻烦”。传统做法是取阴道涂片、染色、在显微镜下判读细胞类型，需要熟练操作与专业知识，还费时间，因此常被跳过。
• 用了什么方法：作者尝试用更简单的外部体征替代细胞学——直接给小鼠外阴开口拍照。他们收集了C57BL/6J和BALB/c两个品系雌鼠的2,297张照片，每张都有同期细胞学结果作为“标准答案”。训练与测试严格按动物划分，避免同一只鼠的照片同时出现在两边。模型分三种粒度：四阶段、三阶段（合并动情后期与间情期）、二分类（卵泡期 vs 黄体及过渡期）。
• 有什么结果：在29只没见过的鼠、466张照片上，四阶段准确率47.4%，三组54.5%，二分类69.5%。错误几乎都发生在生物学上相邻的阶段之间，尤其动情前期与动情期最难区分。给二分类器加上置信度阈值、只对模型有把握的样本给结论后，准确率升到82.8%。
• 为何重要：这并不是要完全取代细胞学，而是把工作量分级——大部分样本用拍照快速筛查，少数不确定的再做涂片确认。这样能显著降低纳入雌性动物的操作门槛，有助于性别作为生物学变量的政策真正落地。

items.title_en: Non unitary and nonlinear quantum generative large model design and fast large-scale training without back propagation
items.title_zh: 非酉与非线性量子生成大模型设计及无反向传播的快速大规模训练
items.abstract_en: Transformer-based large models require huge computational and storage costs. Quantum computation is expected to address that due to its potential to speed up classical algorithms exponentially. Key challenges of implementing quantum large models include the linear, unitary nature of qubit evolutions contrast with the non-unitary matrices and nonlinear functions in classical Transformers, as well as the difficulty of implementing gradient back-propagation on quantum hardware. Here we propose a fully quantum large model containing all the Transformer layers, implementing the non-unitary transformations through SVD-decomposition-based quantum circuits, and approximated nonlinear activation functions through pre-trained parameterized quantum circuits. We also propose a quantum circuit training algorithm based on multi-agent Reinforcement Learning, which can train large-scale parameterized quantum circuits without back-propagation. The dependency between the inference time complexity and the model's hidden dimension has been reduced from polynomial to logarithmic, showing an exponential advantage. The inference executions on the quantum hardware verify our model's 300-1000 times speed-up, and the measurements on the sequence-to-sequence tasks shows its learning ability. The training algorithm achieves only 25% complexity of the best SOTA quantum circuit training algorithms, especially this ratio decreases fast as the parameter scale increases. Our work not only proposes a quantum large model that can significantly reduce the computational cost, but also promotes the quantum computation towards general computing.
items.abstract_zh: 基于 Transformer 的大模型需要巨大的计算和存储成本。量子计算因其指数级加速经典算法的潜力而被期望解决这一问题。实现量子大模型的关键挑战包括：量子比特演化的线性、酉性质与经典 Transformer 中的非酉矩阵和非线性函数形成对比，以及在量子硬件上实现梯度反向传播的困难。在此，我们提出一个包含所有 Transformer 层的全量子大模型，通过基于 SVD 分解的量子电路实现非酉变换，并通过预训练的参数化量子电路近似非线性激活函数。我们还提出一种基于多智能体强化学习的量子电路训练算法，可在无反向传播的情况下训练大规模参数化量子电路。推理时间复杂度与模型隐藏维度之间的依赖已从多项式降低到对数，显示出指数级优势。在量子硬件上的推理执行验证了我们的模型实现 300–1000 倍加速，序列到序列任务上的测量显示了其学习能力。该训练算法仅达到最佳 SOTA 量子电路训练算法复杂度的 25%，尤其该比例随参数规模增大而快速下降。我们的工作不仅提出一个可显著降低计算成本的量子大模型，也推动量子计算迈向通用计算。

items.title_en: Schism: Reconfigurable Scale-Up Domains for Distributed Quantum Computing
items.title_zh: Schism：面向分布式量子计算的可重构扩展域
items.abstract_en: Switch-based quantum datacenters connect quantum processing units (QPUs) through photonic switches and shared Bell-state measurement (BSM) devices. Sharing BSMs saves hardware, but fixed connectivity constrains access to these resources. Local communication can overload one rack's BSMs while others remain idle; reaching those idle resources incurs additional optical loss and retries through switches and quantum frequency converters (QFCs). Programs remain locked into this locality-contention tradeoff as their communication patterns change. We propose Schism, an architecture that lets programs dynamically change which QPUs share each BSM pool. Schism places BSM pools at aggregation switches and QFCs on their core-facing uplinks. Top-of-rack switches establish reconfigurable native-wavelength circuits from QPUs to these pools, forming scale-up domains bounded by the optical loss budget. Reconfiguration reshapes resource sharing across racks without moving QPUs or migrating quantum states. Our key insight is that QPU grouping jointly determines photon-path loss and contention for BSM resources: locality alone cannot identify the best grouping, and a grouping pays off only if its savings outweigh the delay of reconfiguring to it. We develop an optimization framework that combines graph partitioning with resource-constrained completion-time estimates and dynamic programming to select how QPUs share BSM pools and when those groupings reconfigure, between or within circuit phases. Our evaluation using SeQUeNCe with trapped-ion parameters shows that Schism achieves communication speedups of 4.9-7.3x across 11 workloads on 32 QPUs compared to Fixed Clos connectivity and 3.6-8.3x compared to SwitchQNet. Schism also outperforms a hypothetical network-wide switch by 1.35-1.38x on the eight workloads whose phases fit in a pool, and trails it by 1.1-1.75x on the other three.
items.abstract_zh: 基于交换机的量子数据中心通过光子交换机和共享的贝尔态测量（BSM）设备连接量子处理单元（QPU）。共享 BSM 可节省硬件，但固定连接限制了对这些资源的访问。局部通信可能使一个机架的 BSM 过载，而其他机架的 BSM 空闲；访问这些空闲资源会通过交换机和量子频率转换器（QFC）带来额外光损耗和重试。随着程序通信模式变化，程序仍被锁定在这种局部性与争用的权衡中。我们提出 Schism，一种让程序动态改变哪些 QPU 共享每个 BSM 池的架构。Schism 将 BSM 池放置在汇聚交换机处，并将 QFC 放置在其面向核心的上行链路上。机架顶部交换机建立从 QPU 到这些池的可重构原生波长电路，形成受光损耗预算约束的扩展域。重配置在不移动 QPU 或不迁移量子态的情况下重塑跨机架的资源共享。我们的关键洞见是：QPU 分组共同决定光子路径损耗和对 BSM 资源的争用；仅凭局部性无法确定最佳分组，且一种分组只有在其节省超过重配置到该分组的延迟时才有收益。我们开发了一个优化框架，将图划分与资源约束下的完成时间估计和动态规划相结合，以选择 QPU 如何共享 BSM 池，以及这些分组在电路阶段之间或之内何时重配置。我们使用 SeQUeNCe 及囚禁离子参数进行评估，结果表明：在 32 个 QPU 上的 11 个工作负载中，相比固定 Clos 连接，Schism 实现 4.9–7.3 倍的通信加速；相比 SwitchQNet 实现 3.6–8.3 倍加速。对于阶段能容纳于一个池中的八个工作负载，Schism 还比假设的全网交换机快 1.35–1.38 倍；在其他三个工作负载上则比它慢 1.1–1.75 倍。

items.title_en: CO-GRAFT: Attributing Reinforcement Learning Gains in Search Agents via Role-Level Policy Grafting
items.title_zh: CO-GRAFT：通过角色级策略嫁接归因搜索智能体中的强化学习增益
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves large language model search agents by up to 32 exact-match (EM) points over their pre-RL initializations, yet overall accuracy gains do not identify which underlying functional capabilities improve or interact during training. We introduce CO-GRAFT, a reward-agnostic interventional attribution framework in which an RL-trained agent and its pre-RL initialization jointly generate a single trajectory under closed-loop execution with live retrieval. Each policy controls a mutually exclusive subset of four functional roles: intermediate reasoning, search-or-answer decision, search query generation, and final answer extraction. Evaluating all 2^4=16 role assignments without modifying weights or retraining defines a cooperative game whose Shapley values decompose the total RL gain across roles, while M"obius interaction terms distinguish standalone role improvements from multi-role coupling. Applying CO-GRAFT to Search-R1 agents across Qwen2.5 and Llama-3.2 models (spanning two sizes, base and instruction-tuned initializations, GRPO and PPO optimizers, and NQ and HotpotQA datasets), we show that query generation never exceeds 15% of the total gain; instead, gains are governed by pre-RL answer validity, search retention, model scale, and fixed task-level search budgets, shifting credit from reasoning toward answer extraction in larger or well-formatted answer response checkpoints while smaller base models rely on reasoning--decision coupling.
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）可将大语言模型搜索智能体相对于其RL前初始化提升最多32个精确匹配（EM）点，但总体准确率增益并不能识别训练期间哪些底层功能能力得到改善或发生交互。我们提出CO-GRAFT，一种与奖励无关的干预式归因框架，其中经RL训练的智能体与其RL前初始化在带实时检索的闭环执行下共同生成单条轨迹。每个策略控制四个功能角色中互斥的一个子集：中间推理、搜索或回答决策、搜索查询生成、最终答案抽取。在不修改权重或重新训练的情况下评估全部2^4=16种角色分配，定义了一个合作博弈，其Shapley值将总RL增益分解到各角色，而Möbius交互项将单角色改进与多角色耦合区分开。将CO-GRAFT应用于Qwen2.5和Llama-3.2模型上的Search-R1智能体（涵盖两种规模、基础与指令微调初始化、GRPO和PPO优化器，以及NQ和HotpotQA数据集），我们发现查询生成在总增益中从未超过15%；相反，增益由RL前答案有效性、搜索保留、模型规模以及固定任务级搜索预算主导，在更大或答案格式良好的答案响应检查点中，信用从推理转向答案抽取，而较小的基础模型依赖推理—决策耦合。

items.title_en: Particle Belief Representations for Reinforcement Learning under Partial Observability
items.title_zh: 部分可观测性下强化学习的粒子信念表示
items.abstract_en: Particle filters flexibly represent complex, multimodal beliefs but expose them as weighted, unordered sets incompatible with conventional fixed-dimensional policies. We study particle-belief encodings as inputs to reinforcement-learning policies while holding belief estimation and policy optimization fixed. We compare statistical summaries, cumulant-generating-function (CGF) features, and permutation-invariant set encoders. Trainable encoders are learned end-to-end or pretrained through belief reconstruction or task-specific prediction. Across eight tasks, pooling-based set encoders and gradient CGF features are reliable end-to-end, while the Set Transformer achieves the highest performance with appropriate pretraining. Task-specific pretraining helps when its target captures decision-relevant belief structure, whereas reconstruction pretraining and latent alignment provide more selective benefits. For selecting and training particle-belief encoders in partially observable Markov decision processes, our results show that an encoding that reconstructs the belief well is not necessarily a good input for control.
items.abstract_zh: 粒子滤波器可灵活表示复杂的多模态信念，但将其暴露为加权、无序集合，与传统固定维策略不兼容。我们在保持信念估计和策略优化固定的条件下，研究作为强化学习策略输入的粒子信念编码。我们比较统计摘要、累积生成函数（cumulant-generating-function, CGF）特征和置换不变集合编码器。可训练编码器通过端到端学习，或通过信念重建或任务特定预测进行预训练。在八个任务中，基于池化的集合编码器和梯度CGF特征在端到端设置下可靠，而Set Transformer在适当预训练下取得最高性能。当其目标捕获与决策相关的信念结构时，任务特定预训练有帮助，而重建预训练和潜在对齐提供更具选择性的收益。对于部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程中的粒子信念编码器选择与训练，我们的结果表明，能够很好地重建信念的编码未必是控制的好输入。

items.title_en: GSDet: Gaussian Splatting for Oriented Object Detection
items.title_zh: GSDet：用于有向目标检测的高斯泼溅
items.abstract_en: Oriented object detection has advanced with the development of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and transformers. However, modern detectors still rely on predefined object candidates, such as anchors in CNN-based methods or queries in transformer-based methods, which struggle to capture spatial information effectively. To address the limitations, we propose GSDet, a novel framework that formulates oriented object detection as Gaussian splatting. Specifically, our approach performs detection within a 3D feature space constructed from image features, where 3D Gaussians are employed to represent oriented objects. These 3D Gaussians are projected onto the image plane to form 2D Gaussians, which are then transformed into oriented boxes. Furthermore, we optimize the mean, anisotropic covariance, and confidence scores of these randomly initialized 3D Gaussians, using a decoder that incorporates 3D Gaussian sampling. Moreover, our method exhibits flexibility, enabling adaptive control and a dynamic number of Gaussians during inference. Experiments on 3 datasets indicate that GSDet achieves AP$_{50}$ gains of 0.7\% on DIOR-R, 0.3\% on DOTA-v1.0, and 0.55\% on DOTA-v1.5 when evaluated with adaptive control and outperforms mainstream detectors.
items.abstract_zh: 有向目标检测随着卷积神经网络（CNN）和Transformer的发展而进步。然而，现代检测器仍依赖预定义的目标候选，例如基于CNN方法中的锚框或基于Transformer方法中的查询，这些候选难以有效捕获空间信息。为解决这些限制，我们提出GSDet，一种将有向目标检测表述为高斯泼溅的新框架。具体而言，我们的方法在由图像特征构建的3D特征空间内执行检测，其中采用3D高斯表示有向目标。这些3D高斯被投影到图像平面形成2D高斯，随后转换为有向框。此外，我们使用包含3D高斯采样的解码器，优化这些随机初始化的3D高斯的均值、各向异性协方差和置信度分数。此外，我们的方法具有灵活性，可在推理期间实现自适应控制和动态数量的高斯。在3个数据集上的实验表明，当采用自适应控制评估时，GSDet在DIOR-R上取得0.7%的AP$_{50}$增益，在DOTA-v1.0上取得0.3%的增益，在DOTA-v1.5上取得0.55%的增益，并优于主流检测器。

items.title_en: Dynamic Inter-Modality Source Coupling Reveals Sex Differences in Children based on Brain Structural-Functional Network Connectivity: A Multimodal MRI Study of the ABCD Dataset
items.title_zh: 动态跨模态源耦合揭示基于脑结构-功能网络连接的儿童性别差异：一项基于ABCD数据集的多模态MRI研究
items.abstract_en: Background: Sex differences in brain development are well-documented, yet the dynamic coupling between structure and function remains underexplored. We introduce dynamic inter-modality source coupling (dIMSC), extending our previous work to link structural MRI source-based morphometry (SBM) with dynamic functional network connectivity (dFNC). Methods: We used data from 500 participants in the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) study (ages 9-11) and combined SBM-derived gray matter sources with sliding-window dFNC. dIMSC was computed as the time-resolved cross-correlation between these modalities to quantify structure-function coupling strength. We evaluated sex differences in these coupling profiles and used a cognitive moderation analysis to validate the sensitivity of the identified coupling states. Results: Significant sex-specific patterns emerged: males exhibited stronger positive coupling in sensorimotor regions (postcentral gyrus), while females showed stronger coupling in higher-order associative regions (inferior parietal lobule). These configurations were functionally distinct: higher positive coupling predicted better crystallized cognition (vocabulary) in females, whereas it predicted better fluid cognition (working memory) in males. Conclusion: These findings validate the functional sensitivity of dIMSC, demonstrating that the time-resolved coupling states it identifies are neurobiologically meaningful and differentially predictive of cognitive performance as a function of biological sex, consistent with known sex differences in neurodevelopmental during late childhood.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：脑发育中的性别差异已有充分记录，但结构与功能之间的动态耦合仍研究不足。我们提出动态跨模态源耦合（dIMSC），扩展我们此前的工作，将结构MRI的基于源的形态测量（SBM）与动态功能网络连接（dFNC）联系起来。方法：我们使用青少年脑认知发展（ABCD）研究中500名参与者（9-11岁）的数据，并将SBM衍生的灰质源与滑动窗口dFNC相结合。dIMSC计算为这些模态之间的时间分辨互相关，以量化结构-功能耦合强度。我们评估了这些耦合模式中的性别差异，并使用认知调节分析来验证所识别耦合状态的敏感性。结果：出现了显著的性别特异性模式：男性在感觉运动区域（中央后回）表现出更强的正耦合，而女性在高级联合区域（顶下小叶）表现出更强的耦合。这些配置在功能上不同：较高的正耦合在女性中预测更好的晶体认知（词汇），而在男性中预测更好的流体认知（工作记忆）。结论：这些发现验证了dIMSC的功能敏感性，表明其识别的时间分辨耦合状态具有神经生物学意义，并作为生物性别的函数对认知表现具有差异化预测作用，这与已知的儿童晚期神经发育性别差异一致。

items.title_en: On-demand frequency-entangled microwave biphotons from a transmon-resonator dimer
items.title_zh: 由transmon-谐振器二聚体产生的按需频率纠缠微波双光子
items.abstract_en: We propose a superconducting circuit QED source of on-demand frequency-entangled microwave photon pairs, with one photon emitted into each of two separate waveguides, enabling individual manipulation. The design is based on a transmon-resonator dimer, which consists of two transmon-resonator subsystems coupled through a cross-Kerr interaction. We outline a viable circuit-QED realization in which the required cross-Kerr interaction is implemented using Josephson-junction couplers. To analyze the emission dynamics, we derive and numerically solve the set of evolution equations that enable tracking the evolution of the joint spectral intensity of photons. We characterize the resulting photon-number correlations, frequency anticorrelation, and spectral entanglement. By varying the coupling strengths, we obtain biphotons with distinct joint spectral intensities and Schmidt spectra, ranging from broadly distributed multimode entanglement to states dominated by two nearly equally weighted Schmidt contributions. In the latter regime, optimizing the transmon-resonator coupling and detuning yields an output biphoton state that has fidelity $F \approx 0.956$ with a two-dimensional maximally entangled state. Restricting the local target modes to separated frequency bins yields a fidelity $F_\mathrm{bin} \approx 0.949$, indicating that the output state closely approximates a frequency-bin Bell pair. Thus, the proposed microwave biphoton source provides a route toward distributing frequency-encoded quantum resources between remote superconducting nodes.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种超导电路QED源，可按需产生频率纠缠的微波光子对，每个光子发射到两个独立波导之一，从而实现独立操控。该设计基于transmon-谐振器二聚体，其由两个通过交叉Kerr相互作用耦合的transmon-谐振器子系统组成。我们概述了一种可行的电路QED实现，其中所需的交叉Kerr相互作用使用约瑟夫森结耦合器实现。为分析发射动力学，我们推导并数值求解了一组演化方程，从而能够追踪光子联合谱强度的演化。我们表征了所得的光子数关联、频率反关联和谱纠缠。通过改变耦合强度，我们获得具有不同联合谱强度和Schmidt谱的双光子，范围从宽分布的多模纠缠到由两个几乎等权Schmidt贡献主导的状态。在后一情形下，优化transmon-谐振器耦合和失谐可产生输出双光子态，其与二维最大纠缠态的保真度为 $F \approx 0.956$。将局部目标模式限制在分离的频率bin时，保真度为 $F_\mathrm{bin} \approx 0.949$，表明输出态紧密近似频率bin Bell对。因此，所提出的微波双光子源为在远程超导节点之间分发频率编码的量子资源提供了一条途径。

items.title_en: AdaptRouter: Adaptive Routing across Evolving Tasks and Models
items.title_zh: AdaptRouter：跨演化任务与模型的自适应路由
items.abstract_en: Model routing assigns each query to a suitable foundation model, but tasks and available models keep changing, and existing routers are either untrained for the pool at hand or fit once and forget earlier tasks when updated. We present AdaptRouter, an adaptive router trained by policy learning: a compact multimodal decision model reads each question with cards describing the current experts and learns from native task feedback, without routing labels, to select one frozen expert. Open-weight and API experts share the router, its inputs, and the quality-cost trade-off but use different losses: cheap open-weight experts are explored with RL, whereas paid API experts are queried once and their cached feedback is reused as soft labels. New tasks are learned without replay, new experts enter as cards, and an open-weight quality-first advantage provably keeps cost from overriding quality. Across four task stages, AdaptRouter loses at most 0.4 points on earlier tasks, whereas feedback-trained routers lose up to 7.0, and as its pool grows from three to ten experts, its accuracy rises from 67.2% to 72.1%. On five API models, it exceeds GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Astra (low) by over 22 points at under a third of their cost.
items.abstract_zh: 模型路由将每个查询分配给合适的基础模型，但任务和可用模型不断变化，现有路由器要么未针对当前模型池训练，要么在更新时一次拟合后遗忘早期任务。我们提出AdaptRouter，一种通过策略学习训练的自适应路由器：一个紧凑的多模态决策模型读取每个问题及描述当前专家的卡片，并在无路由标签的情况下从原生任务反馈中学习，以选择一个冻结专家。开放权重专家和API专家共享路由器、其输入以及质量-成本权衡，但使用不同的损失：廉价开放权重专家通过RL进行探索，而付费API专家仅查询一次，其缓存反馈被重用为软标签。新任务在无回放的情况下学习，新专家以卡片形式进入，并且开放权重质量优先优势可证明地防止成本凌驾于质量之上。在四个任务阶段中，AdaptRouter在早期任务上最多损失0.4个点，而反馈训练的路由器最多损失7.0个点；当其模型池从三个专家增长到十个专家时，其准确率从67.2%升至72.1%。在五个API模型上，它以不到其三分之一成本超过GPT-6.1 Sol和GPT-6 Astra (low) 22个点以上。

items.title_en: From Rewarding What Models Say to How They Think: Attention Process Reward Model for LLM Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 从奖励模型所说内容到奖励模型如何思考：面向大语言模型强化学习的注意力过程奖励模型
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become an important component in large language models (LLMs). However, existing RL approaches focus on final outputs or textual solution trajectories, leading to coarse-grained rewards and unreliable reasoning. Such paradigms focus mainly on what the model outputs while overlooking how the model internally reasons. Therefore, can we reward how a model thinks internally rather than merely what it says? We first reveal the problem of textual reward aliasing in existing reward modeling approaches. Motivated by this, we propose the Attention Process Reward Model (APRM), which assigns internal rewards based on hidden states and attention maps to capture high-quality reasoning patterns. With only approximately 46M parameters, APRM is trained using ranking and counterfactual objectives, and its reward guides RL optimization while being periodically updated to handle distribution shifts. Integrated with representative RL methods, APRM achieved an average pass@8 gain of 2.88\%. Our results demonstrate the promise of incorporating internal reasoning signals into RL for LLMs.
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）已成为大语言模型（LLM）的重要组成部分。然而，现有RL方法聚焦于最终输出或文本解答轨迹，导致奖励粗粒度且推理不可靠。此类范式主要关注模型输出什么，而忽视模型内部如何推理。因此，我们能否奖励模型内部如何思考，而不仅仅是奖励它说了什么？我们首先揭示现有奖励建模方法中的文本奖励混叠问题。受此启发，我们提出注意力过程奖励模型（APRM），它基于隐藏状态和注意力图为内部奖励赋值，以捕捉高质量推理模式。APRM仅有约46M参数，使用排序和反事实目标进行训练，其奖励引导RL优化，并定期更新以处理分布偏移。与代表性RL方法集成后，APRM取得平均2.88\%的pass@8提升。我们的结果展示了将内部推理信号纳入LLM强化学习的潜力。

items.title_en: Generating Safety-Critical Driving Scenarios from Role-Typed Signal Temporal Logic Specifications Drafted by Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 从大语言模型起草的角色类型化信号时序逻辑规范生成安全关键驾驶场景
items.abstract_en: Safety-critical scenarios are rare in recorded driving and must be generated to test and train motion planners of automated vehicles. In guided diffusion models, each scenario type needs its own weighted objective, separate from the validity check. Optimized together with the attacker, the vehicle under test can cancel the attack or draw it toward itself. We state each scenario as a signal temporal logic specification with clauses typed by role. Every clause names the agent it may change and the agents it may read, and the vehicle under test reads the attacker only from the attack onset. A large language model drafts the specification from a description, and a type checker accepts it. A compiler derives the optimization: it edits a diffusion model's samples by the smallest change that satisfies the specification, each clause moves only its owner, the attacker is solved against the unreacted vehicle under test before its response, and the monitor of the same specification decides acceptance. On nuScenes and CommonRoad, judged independently of the specification, one parameter set produced valid scenarios at a rate 0.14 above a weighted objective tuned per scenario type, and descriptions yielded at least one valid scenario for 11 of the 16 pre-crash types expressible in the public data. Learned planners fail more often on the generated scenarios than on their seeds. Fine-tuning on them lowers a planner's failure rate on critical scenarios, and the time headway one clause of the label requires, not the generator, sets the size of the gain.
items.abstract_zh: 安全关键场景在记录驾驶数据中很少见，必须生成此类场景以测试和训练自动驾驶车辆的运动规划器。在引导扩散模型中，每种场景类型都需要自己的加权目标，并与有效性检查分开。与被测车辆一起优化时，被测车辆可以取消攻击或将其引向自身。我们将每种场景表述为信号时序逻辑规范，其子句按角色类型化。每个子句指明它可改变的智能体以及它可读取的智能体，并且被测车辆仅从攻击开始时刻读取攻击者。大语言模型根据描述起草该规范，类型检查器接受该规范。编译器导出优化过程：它通过对扩散模型样本作出满足规范的最小改动来编辑样本，每个子句仅移动其所属对象，攻击者是在被测车辆尚未反应之前针对未反应车辆求解的，而同一规范的监视器决定是否接受。在nuScenes和CommonRoad上，独立于规范进行评判时，一组参数生成有效场景的比率比按场景类型调优的加权目标高0.14，并且对于公共数据中可表达的16种碰撞前类型中的11种，描述至少产生了一个有效场景。学习到的规划器在生成场景上的失败频率高于其种子场景。在这些场景上微调可降低规划器在关键场景上的失败率，而增益大小由标签中一个子句所要求的时间车头间距决定，而非由生成器决定。

items.title_en: AdvMTO: Multimodal and Temporal Adversarial Object Attacks via 2D Gaussian Splatting for BEV-Based 3D Object Detection
items.title_zh: AdvMTO：面向基于BEV的3D目标检测的通过2D高斯泼溅的多模态与时间对抗物体攻击
items.abstract_en: Adversarial object attacks pose a threat to BEV-based 3D object detectors in autonomous driving. Existing attacks typically target a single modality, coordinate camera and LiDAR observations at the current timestamp, or model temporal persistence mainly in camera streams. Without a unified construction of current and historical observations, attacks can leave part of the detector's accumulated evidence unsuppressed, limiting their effectiveness. In this paper, we propose AdvMTO, a 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) framework for suppressing detection of persistent adversarial objects. Its oriented surfels encode appearance, geometry, and opacity in one object state, from which camera images and scanline LiDAR returns are generated. AdvMTO then constructs current and historical inputs through detector-native processing, regenerating LiDAR returns in each native source sweep for fusion detectors. We optimize bounded appearance perturbations for each detector, propagating gradients through historical BEV memory for temporal camera detectors. For fusion detectors, bounded geometry refinement along local normals further perturbs both sensing modalities. Experiments on nuScenes demonstrate effective suppression of traffic-cone detection across three BEV detectors. Temporal ablations further highlight the importance of detector-native history modeling for both attack construction and optimization.
items.abstract_zh: 对抗物体攻击对自动驾驶中基于BEV的3D目标检测器构成威胁。现有攻击通常针对单一模态，在当前时间戳协调相机和LiDAR观测，或主要在相机流中建模时间持续性。若没有对当前和历史观测的统一构建，攻击可能无法抑制检测器积累的部分证据，从而限制其有效性。本文提出AdvMTO，一个用于抑制持续对抗物体检测的2D高斯泼溅（2DGS）框架。其有向面元在一个物体状态中编码外观、几何和不透明度，并由此生成相机图像和扫描线LiDAR回波。AdvMTO随后通过检测器原生处理构建当前和历史输入，并为融合检测器在每个原生源扫描中重新生成LiDAR回波。我们为每个检测器优化有界外观扰动，并通过历史BEV记忆为时间相机检测器传播梯度。对于融合检测器，沿局部法线的有界几何细化进一步扰动两种传感模态。在nuScenes上的实验表明，该方法在三个BEV检测器上有效抑制交通锥检测。时间消融进一步突出了检测器原生历史建模对攻击构建和优化的重要性。

items.title_en: Continually pretrained open-weight language models can outperform traditional machine learning in EHR-based clinical prediction
items.title_zh: 持续预训练的开放权重语言模型在基于EHR的临床预测中可优于传统机器学习
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) prompted with electronic health record (EHR) data have predicted clinical outcomes less accurately than locally trained machine-learning models. We developed VEX-EHR by extending the vocabulary of a 12-billion-parameter open-weight LLM (weights publicly available) with 17,601 clinical and audit-log codes from 170,483 patients' records at one academic medical center, continuing its pretraining on those 2019-2024 records (4.7 billion tokens) and fine-tuning it per task. AUROCs were 0.917 for next-24-hour discharge, 0.715 for 30-day readmission and 0.847 for intensive care unit acute kidney injury, against 0.868, 0.677 and 0.828 for gradient-boosted trees and 0.848, 0.650 and 0.791 for CEHR-BERT, an EHR foundation model. Continued pretraining added 0.031-0.053 AUROC on every task. With 10% of the labels, VEX-EHR exceeded both comparators using all labels for discharge, and CEHR-BERT for readmission, valuable where labels are costly. Adapted by continued pretraining, open-weight LLMs can outperform traditional machine learning in EHR-based prediction.
items.abstract_zh: 使用电子健康记录（EHR）数据提示的大语言模型（LLM）在预测临床结局方面不如本地训练的机器学习模型准确。我们开发了VEX-EHR：扩展一个120亿参数开放权重LLM（权重公开可用）的词表，加入来自一个学术医疗中心170,483名患者记录中的17,601个临床和审计日志代码，在这些2019—2024年记录（47亿token）上继续预训练，并按任务微调。AUROC为：未来24小时出院0.917、30天再入院0.715、重症监护病房急性肾损伤0.847；梯度提升树分别为0.868、0.677和0.828，EHR基础模型CEHR-BERT分别为0.848、0.650和0.791。继续预训练在每个任务上增加0.031—0.053 AUROC。仅使用10%的标签时，VEX-EHR在出院任务上超过两个使用全部标签的对照模型，在再入院任务上超过CEHR-BERT，这在标签成本高昂时很有价值。通过继续预训练进行适配后，开放权重LLM可在基于EHR的预测中优于传统机器学习。

items.title_en: A single-photon quantum sensor via single-atom cavity-QED
items.title_zh: 通过单原子腔QED实现的单光子量子传感器
items.abstract_en: We describe a cavity-QED sensor using an optical probe with exactly one photon per pulse. This has a better sensitivity than a coherent pulse with the same average power when no global coherent phase reference is available. The sensor measurement is based on the estimation of the Raman-controlled absorption probability of a single-photon pulse. We use the Fock state master equation to determine the dynamics and performance of the Raman-controlled absorption of a single photon pulse and optimise the sensitivity using machine learning. Two examples are presented; (1) the target parameter is the detuning of the two-level system itself, and (2) the target parameters describe a remote reflecting cavity. In the second case, the scheme does not require a shared coherent phase reference.
items.abstract_zh: 我们描述一种腔QED传感器，其光学探针每脉冲恰好使用一个光子。在没有全局相干相位参考时，与相同平均功率的相干脉冲相比，它具有更好的灵敏度。该传感器的测量基于对单光子脉冲的拉曼控制吸收概率的估计。我们使用福克态主方程确定单光子脉冲拉曼控制吸收的动力学和性能，并利用机器学习优化灵敏度。文中给出两个例子：（1）目标参数是二能级系统自身的失谐；（2）目标参数描述一个远程反射腔。在第二种情况下，该方案不需要共享的相干相位参考。

items.title_en: World Models and the Law
items.title_zh: 世界模型与法律
items.abstract_en: Current AI may have a model of how we use human language, but this does not translate into a reliable representation of physical reality. World models promise to fill this gap by learning how an environment changes over time and predicting the consequences of an action, and they are already used to steer robots and generate explorable worlds. This article asks how AI regulation in three major legal contexts, the European Union, California, and China, copes with the distinctive challenges they raise. I propose a definition and a taxonomy of world models based on who or what acts on their predictions, and identify the risks of misplaced reliance on them. I argue that existing rules tend to cover world models but leave three questions open, i.e., action provenance, trajectory validity, and the weight of simulated evidence, and recommend ways to fill these gaps.
items.abstract_zh: 当前AI或许拥有关于我们如何使用人类语言的模型，但这并不能转化为对物理现实的可靠表示。世界模型有望通过学习环境如何随时间变化并预测某一行动的后果来填补这一空白，它们已被用于引导机器人和生成可探索世界。本文探讨欧盟、加利福尼亚和中国这三个主要法律语境中的AI监管如何应对世界模型带来的独特挑战。我基于谁或什么依据世界模型的预测采取行动，提出世界模型的定义和分类法，并识别错误依赖世界模型的风险。我认为，现有规则倾向于覆盖世界模型，但留下三个问题未决，即行动来源、轨迹有效性以及模拟证据的权重，并提出填补这些空白的方式。

items.title_en: TAP: Policy Interfaces for Diffusion Language Models
items.title_zh: TAP：扩散语言模型的策略接口
items.abstract_en: Diffusion language models denoise a masked canvas, making them a natural setting for selective generation decisions such as answering, waiting, clarifying, or refusing. We introduce TAP-DiLM, which adds a typed policy variable to masked diffusion LMs, and study how this policy should be attached to the denoising process. Across BERT-base, MDLMOWT, LLaDA-8B, and Dream-7B, we compare shared-vocabulary slots, dedicated slot heads, and CLS-based external heads. The results reveal a clear interface-backbone interaction: dedicated heads provide robust policy learning across scales, while sharedvocabulary heads can be effective when the LM-head geometry is favorable. A simple LMhead sharpness probe predicts when sharedhead policy internalization is reliable, giving a practical diagnostic for interface selection. Causal clamp and slot-injection tests show that dedicated policy slots can influence body denoising through feedback, especially at 8B scale. Safety-refusal experiments further show that TAP-DiLM supports competitive typed refusal behavior when trained with diverse unsafe prompts.
items.abstract_zh: 扩散语言模型对掩码画布进行去噪，这使其成为回答、等待、澄清或拒绝等选择性生成决策的自然场景。我们提出 TAP-DiLM，向掩码扩散语言模型加入类型化策略变量，并研究该策略应如何附着到去噪过程。在 BERT-base、MDLMOWT、LLaDA-8B 和 Dream-7B 上，我们比较共享词表槽位、专用槽位头和基于 CLS 的外部头。结果揭示明显的接口-骨干交互：专用头跨规模提供稳健的策略学习，而共享词表头在 LM 头几何有利时可有效。一个简单的 LM 头锐度探针可预测共享头策略内化何时可靠，为接口选择提供实用诊断。因果钳制和槽注入测试表明，专用策略槽可通过反馈影响主体去噪，尤其在 8B 规模。安全拒绝实验进一步表明，在使用多样化不安全提示训练时，TAP-DiLM 支持有竞争力的类型化拒绝行为。

items.title_en: RoboCap-10k: A Metrically Accurate Egocentric Dataset for Robot Learning
items.title_zh: RoboCap-10k：用于机器人学习的度量准确自我中心数据集
items.abstract_en: Egocentric video is the most scalable source of manipulation data for robot learning, but its difficulty lies in producing high-quality supervision. Existing large corpora lack metric 3D labels or rely on heterogeneous devices, motion-capture labs, or a headset's built-in real-time tracker, whose accuracy is not reported for the released data. We introduce RoboCap-10k: 10,000 curated hours of unscripted manipulation recorded during workers' paid shifts in 11 countries, spanning 18 task families, 200 task types, and 2,000 tasks. Every hour is captured on one device, the RoboCap, a 250 g hat with six synchronized global-shutter cameras and dual IMUs. Online calibration brings every device below 1 px of epipolar error, visual-inertial SLAM yields gravity-aligned 6-DoF head trajectories, and a multi-view hand tracker yields metric cm-precise hand poses. Each episode is annotated with task and sub-task language captions. Project page: https://robocap10k.com
items.abstract_zh: 自我中心视频是机器人学习中最可扩展的操作数据来源，但其困难在于产生高质量监督。现有大型语料库缺乏度量3D标签，或依赖异构设备、动作捕捉实验室，或头显内置实时追踪器，而这些追踪器在发布数据上的精度未被报告。我们提出RoboCap-10k：10,000个精选小时的无脚本操作数据，记录于11个国家工人的带薪班次期间，涵盖18个任务族、200种任务类型和2,000项任务。每个小时都由同一设备RoboCap采集，这是一顶250 g的帽子，配有六个同步全局快门相机和双IMU。在线校准使每台设备的对极误差低于1 px，视觉-惯性SLAM给出重力对齐的6自由度头部轨迹，多视角手部追踪器给出度量级厘米精度的手部姿态。每个片段都标注了任务和子任务的语言描述。项目页面：https://robocap10k.com

items.title_en: RadioWorld: Transferring World Models to Radio-Frequency Radiance Fields
items.title_zh: RadioWorld：将世界模型迁移到射频辐射场
items.abstract_en: Electromagnetic (EM) wave propagation in the physical world constitutes a Radio-Frequency (RF) radiance field, providing rich information for 6G communication and sensing. However, existing neural RF field methods suffer from three fundamental limitations: (1) they predominantly rely on per-scene optimization and cannot generalize to unseen scenes; (2) they require costly reference RF measurements in each target scene; and (3) they degrade severely when extrapolating beyond the vicinity of reference measurements. To overcome these limitations, we present RadioWorld, a general framework that adapts a world model to synthesize RF radiance fields directly from physical scene geometry and transceiver locations, without requiring any reference RF measurements at inference. Specifically, RadioWorld couples two specialized modules within a dual-stream Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture: a Scene-Understanding Transformer that encodes 3D scene geometry and transceiver locations to extract environment-aware global EM propagation features, and a Field-Generation Transformer that attends to these features to synthesize the RF radiance field with the local query conditions. We also establish UrbanRF-Bench, a large-scale ray-traced benchmark spanning 657 urban scenes and 32,850 RF radiance fields across seven global cities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RadioWorld significantly outperforms specialized baselines and accurately synthesizes RF fields at arbitrary locations in unseen cities. Code, datasets, and checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.
items.abstract_zh: 物理世界中的电磁波传播构成射频（RF）辐射场，为 6G 通信与感知提供丰富信息。然而现有神经 RF 场方法存在三点根本局限：(1) 主要依赖逐场景优化，无法泛化到未见场景；(2) 每个目标场景都需昂贵的参考 RF 测量；(3) 在参考测量邻域之外外推时性能严重退化。为此我们提出 RadioWorld——一个通用框架，可将世界模型适配为直接从物理场景几何与收发机位置合成 RF 辐射场，推理阶段无需任何参考 RF 测量。具体而言，RadioWorld 在双流 Mixture-of-Transformers（MoT）架构中耦合两个专用模块：Scene-Understanding Transformer 编码三维场景几何与收发机位置，提取环境感知的全局电磁传播特征；Field-Generation Transformer 关注这些特征，并结合局部查询条件合成 RF 辐射场。我们还建立了 UrbanRF-Bench，一个覆盖全球七座城市、657 个城市场景、32,850 个 RF 辐射场的大规模射线追踪基准。大量实验表明 RadioWorld 显著优于专用基线方法，并能在未见城市的任意位置准确合成 RF 场。代码、数据集与检查点将在录用后公开。
items.highlight_zh: 无需参考测量，直接由场景几何合成未见城市的射频辐射场
items.digest_zh:
一、研究了什么问题：手机、基站、雷达之间的电磁波在真实城市里如何传播，本质上构成一张“射频辐射场”地图，对 6G 通信与感知至关重要。以往用神经网络建模这类场的方法有三个硬伤：每换一个场景就得重新训练，泛化不了；每个新场景都要实测大量参考射频数据，成本高；一旦要在测量点之外的地方推断，精度就大幅下降。

二、用了什么方法：作者提出 RadioWorld，思路是把“世界模型”迁移过来，让模型学会从物理场景本身——建筑几何、材质布局、收发机位置——直接推演电磁波怎么传播，而推理时完全不需要任何实测 RF 数据。模型采用双流 Mixture-of-Transformers（MoT）结构，包含两个分工明确的模块：Scene-Understanding Transformer 负责读懂三维场景与收发机位置，提炼出环境感知的全局电磁传播特征；Field-Generation Transformer 则结合这些特征与具体查询点的局部条件，生成该处的射频场值。为系统评测，作者还用射线追踪构建了 UrbanRF-Bench，覆盖全球七座城市、657 个城市场景、共 32,850 个 RF 辐射场。

三、有什么结果：实验显示 RadioWorld 明显优于各专用基线方法，并且能在训练中从未见过的城市里、在任意位置上较准确地合成射频场，实现了跨场景泛化，摆脱了对逐场景实测的依赖。

四、为何重要：这意味着未来部署网络时，可能先靠几何模型“预演”电磁环境，再用少量实测校准，大幅降低射频测量的时间与成本；对 6G 覆盖规划、感知与数字孪生都有直接价值。

items.title_en: Regional brain-age gaps reveal a shared polygenic architecture and regionally patterned clinical and cell-type associations
items.title_zh: 区域性脑龄差揭示共享的多基因架构以及具有区域模式的临床与细胞类型关联
items.abstract_en: A single brain-age estimate may obscure regional differences in clinical vulnerability. Using voxel-level deep learning, we derived whole-brain and nine regional brain-age gaps (BAGs) spanning cortical, subcortical and cerebellar regions from T1-weighted MRI in 46,254 UK Biobank participants. Genetic correlation estimates in 41,067 participants (rg = 0.56-0.93) exceeded phenotypic correlations across all 45 pairs, yet regional profiles varied across 24 hospital-recorded diagnoses. Oligodendrocyte annotations predominated for whole-brain and cerebellar BAGs, whereas annotations for caudate BAG included astrocyte and vascular classes. In the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative, temporal BAG showed stronger associations with cerebrospinal fluid A{beta}42 and cognition than whole-brain BAG when modelled together. A regional model modestly improved discrimination of observed conversion from mild cognitive impairment to Alzheimer's disease during available follow-up compared with a whole-brain model. Polygenic scores showed cross-cohort associations with hypertension and osteoporosis. Regional BAGs provide complementary clinical information within a shared polygenic architecture.
items.abstract_zh: 单一脑龄估计可能掩盖临床易感性的区域差异。使用体素级深度学习，我们从 46,254 名 UK Biobank 参与者的 T1 加权 MRI 中推导出全脑和九个区域性脑龄差（BAG），涵盖皮层、皮层下和小脑区域。在 41,067 名参与者中的遗传相关估计（rg = 0.56–0.93）在全部 45 对中均超过表型相关，但区域谱在 24 种医院记录诊断间存在差异。少突胶质细胞注释在全脑和小脑 BAG 中占主导，而尾状核 BAG 的注释包括星形胶质细胞和血管类别。在阿尔茨海默病神经影像学倡议中，当一起建模时，颞叶 BAG 与脑脊液 A{beta}42 和认知的关联强于全脑 BAG。与全脑模型相比，区域模型在可用随访期间对观察到的轻度认知障碍向阿尔茨海默病转化的区分能力有适度改善。多基因评分显示与高血压和骨质疏松症存在跨队列关联。区域 BAG 在共享的多基因架构内提供补充性临床信息。
