items.title_en: Turbulence Strength Estimation from Multiplexed Orbital Angular Momentum Beams Using Multimode Fibre Speckle
items.title_zh: 利用多模光纤散斑从复用轨道角动量光束估计湍流强度
items.abstract_en: The strength of atmospheric turbulence governs how much the modes of a free-space optical link mix together. It is usually measured with a separate instrument or with a Gaussian probe beam, neither of which uses the beams that a structured-light link already carries. Here we show that the turbulence strength, expressed as the Fried parameter, can be estimated directly from multiplexed orbital angular momentum (OAM) beams without knowing which modes are present. The beams pass through a passive multimode fibre that turns them into speckle on a camera, and a trained weighted sum of the camera pixels (known as an extreme learning machine), averaged over a few tens of frames, gives the Fried parameter. In the laboratory with emulated turbulence, superpositions of up to eleven OAM modes give an estimate as accurate as that from a Gaussian probe beam sent through the same fibre. In all but weak turbulence the estimate is also more accurate than an ideal Strehl meter or an ideal tip/tilt sensor, providing an efficient way to estimate turbulence strength in mode-division multiplexed systems.
items.abstract_zh: 大气湍流强度决定自由空间光链路各模式相互混合的程度。它通常用单独仪器或高斯探测光束测量，二者都未利用结构光链路已携带的光束。这里我们表明，以 Fried 参数表示的湍流强度可以直接从复用轨道角动量（OAM）光束估计，而无需知道存在哪些模式。光束经过无源多模光纤，在相机上变成散斑；对相机像素的训练加权和（称为极限学习机）在几十帧上平均后给出 Fried 参数。在模拟湍流的实验室中，最多十一个 OAM 模式的叠加给出的估计与通过同一光纤发送的高斯探测光束一样准确。除弱湍流外，该估计也比理想 Strehl 计或理想 tip/tilt 传感器更准确，为模分复用系统中估计湍流强度提供了高效方法。

items.title_en: MobileGrail: Learning Compact Guardrails for On-Device deployable Mobile GUI Agent Safety
items.title_zh: MobileGrail：学习紧凑护栏以实现可设备端部署的移动 GUI 智能体安全
items.abstract_en: Runtime guardrails protect mobile GUI agents by assessing each proposed action before execution, but existing guardrails rely on cloud hosted large multimodal models, exposing every screen to a remote server, including private information such as payments, messages, and medical records. We propose MobileGrail, an on-device deployable model that addresses both. It maintains a recurrent task state that retains only the evidence subsequent safety decisions depend on, so that authorization and execution progress persist beyond the short context. To intervene early while keeping the safety boundary precise, it learns two labels, unsafe and block: unsafe marks the action that commits a violation, whereas block may be issued at any step of an intervention window, which spans from the first action that the user's authorization no longer explains to the committing action itself. To support training, we build an environment of 32 applications whose backends verify the effect of every action, supplying verified labels for supervision and rewards for reinforcement learning to calibrate intervention timing. We also build MobileVeto, an offline benchmark of unsafe trajectories largely on held-out applications, each paired with a benign counterpart. On MobileVeto, MobileGrail built on Qwen3.5-2B intercepts 76.2% of violations, up from 64.5% for its prompted backbone, while reducing premature intervention from 58.6% to 5.2%, outperforming the cloud-based OS-Sentinel on both. We further conduct online evaluation on GhostEIBench, where MobileGrail guarding a Qwen3.8-27B agent reduces fully successful attacks from 13 to 3 of 110 tasks while raising task completion from 48 to 58. Quantized to 4 bits, MobileGrail runs on a Snapdragon 8 Elite at a median latency of 4.7 s, comparable to the 5.1s of cloud-hosted Gemini 3.8 Flash.
items.abstract_zh: 运行时护栏通过在执行前评估每个建议动作来保护移动 GUI 智能体，但现有护栏依赖云端托管的大型多模态模型，将每个屏幕暴露给远程服务器，包括支付、消息和医疗记录等隐私信息。我们提出 MobileGrail，一个可设备端部署的模型，同时解决这两个问题。它维护循环任务状态，仅保留后续安全决策所依赖的证据，使授权和执行进度能在短上下文之外持续。为在保持安全边界精确的同时尽早干预，它学习两个标签：unsafe 和 block：unsafe 标记构成违规的动作，而 block 可在干预窗口的任一步发出，该窗口从用户授权不再能解释的第一个动作延伸到构成违规的动作本身。为支持训练，我们构建包含 32 个应用的环境，其后端验证每个动作的效果，提供经验证的标签用于监督，并提供强化学习奖励以校准干预时机。我们还构建 MobileVeto，一个主要基于留出应用的不安全轨迹离线基准，每条轨迹配有一个良性对应轨迹。在 MobileVeto 上，基于 Qwen3.5-2B 构建的 MobileGrail 拦截 76.2% 的违规，高于其经提示的骨干模型的 64.5%，同时将过早干预从 58.6% 降至 5.2%，在这两项上均优于基于云的 OS-Sentinel。我们进一步在 GhostEIBench 上进行在线评估，其中 MobileGrail 守护 Qwen3.8-27B 智能体，在 110 个任务中将完全成功的攻击从 13 个降至 3 个，同时将任务完成数从 48 提升至 58。量化为 4 比特后，MobileGrail 在 Snapdragon 8 Elite 上运行，中位延迟为 4.7 秒，与云端托管的 Gemini 3.8 Flash 的 5.1 秒相当。

items.title_en: What Makes Good Data for Training Coding Agents? A Systematic Study on SWE-Gym
items.title_zh: 什么使数据成为训练编码智能体的好数据？对 SWE-Gym 的系统性研究
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) trains coding agents on software tasks whose hidden tests decide the reward, yet task collections check these tests only against the reference fix. We ask what makes a task good training data, focusing on the correctness of its reward labels. We audit SWE-Gym with two LLM families, and a suspected error counts only if execution reproduces it. We find that unsolved often means mislabelled: 74% of the tasks that a 9B base model never solves have a test that rejects correct fixes (a false negative), versus 20% of those it sometimes solves. We repair or remove such tasks, and the audited tasks that remain train better policies. At equal size and matched difficulty, models trained on them score 2.4 and 2.7 points higher on held-out tasks from SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro than models trained on the original tasks, whereas simply dropping the never-solved tasks shows no such gain. We further find that wrong patches that pass (false positives) make up about a quarter of all passing patches, and that new tests that catch a quarter of them do not change held-out scores detectably. A pass rate shows whether a task yields reward, not whether that reward is right, so the reward labels themselves must be checked. To this end, we release SWE-Gym-Verified with its 1,087 audited tasks, every verdict with its executed evidence, our training sets, and the full audit pipeline.
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）在软件任务上训练编码智能体，这些任务的隐藏测试决定奖励，然而任务集合仅用参考修复来检查这些测试。我们探究什么使任务成为好的训练数据，重点关注其奖励标签的正确性。我们用两个 LLM 系列审计 SWE-Gym，只有执行能复现的疑似错误才被计入。我们发现未解决通常意味着被错误标注：9B 基础模型从未解决的任务中，74% 有一个拒绝正确修复的测试（假阴性），而在其有时解决的任务中这一比例为 20%。我们修复或移除此类任务，保留下来的经审计任务能训练出更好的策略。在规模相同且难度匹配的情况下，与在原始任务上训练的模型相比，在这些任务上训练的模型在 SWE-bench Verified 和 SWE-bench Pro 的留出任务上分别高 2.4 分和 2.7 分，而仅丢弃从未解决的任务则没有这种增益。我们进一步发现，通过测试的错误补丁（假阳性）约占所有通过补丁的四分之一，而能捕获其中四分之一的新测试未能在可检测程度上改变留出分数。通过率表明任务是否产生奖励，而不是该奖励是否正确，因此必须检查奖励标签本身。为此，我们发布 SWE-Gym-Verified，包含其 1,087 个经审计任务、每个判定及其执行证据、我们的训练集以及完整审计流程。

items.title_en: From Sequence to Space: Explicit Spatial Belief with Vision-Language Distillation for Active Geo-Localization
items.title_zh: 从序列到空间：面向主动地理定位的显式空间信念与视觉-语言蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Active geo-localization (AGL) asks an agent to navigate a small aerial search grid and reach a target specified by an aerial image, a ground-level photograph, or text. Existing methods align the goal modalities well, but they keep the navigation state inside a large sequential Transformer and train with a dense distance reward that uses the hidden goal location. This paper proposes EAGLE, an Explicit spatial-belief Agent for Geo-Localization and Exploration. Offline training jointly optimizes a teacher-conditioned Swin branch and a context-free Swin student from the same randomly masked partial mosaics. The teacher branch attends to frozen full-scene context extracted by Qwen2.5-VL-7B, both branches receive masked-cell aerial-feature reconstruction and uncertainty supervision, while the student additionally distills stop-gradient feature predictions from the teacher. After distillation, Qwen, its cached context, and the teacher-attention branch are discarded. The retained student predicts cell-level aerial-feature embeddings and predictive uncertainty from partial observations alone. These predictions are combined with the modality-aligned goal embedding and a trajectory-derived visitation mask to construct the spatial belief tensor. The student is then frozen while a compact CNN actor-critic is optimized with PPO. EAGLE achieves state-of-the-art average success rates of 78.1%, 76.4%, and 76.8% on MASA, xBD zero-shot transfer, and the MM-GAG zero-shot aerial-goal split, respectively, without using a VLM or cached visual tokens at inference. Code will be made publicly available.
items.abstract_zh: 主动地理定位（AGL）要求智能体在小型空中搜索网格中导航，并到达由航拍图像、地面照片或文本指定的目标。现有方法能很好地对齐目标模态，但它们将导航状态保留在大型序列Transformer内部，并使用利用隐藏目标位置的稠密距离奖励进行训练。本文提出EAGLE，一种用于地理定位与探索的显式空间信念智能体。离线训练从相同的随机掩码部分镶嵌图联合优化一个教师条件Swin分支和一个无上下文Swin学生模型。教师分支关注由Qwen2.5-VL-7B提取的冻结全场景上下文；两个分支均接受掩码单元航拍特征重建和不确定性监督，而学生模型还额外蒸馏来自教师的停止梯度特征预测。蒸馏后，Qwen、其缓存上下文以及教师注意力分支被丢弃。保留下来的学生模型仅根据部分观测预测单元级航拍特征嵌入和预测不确定性。这些预测与模态对齐的目标嵌入以及由轨迹导出的访问掩码相结合，以构建空间信念张量。随后冻结学生模型，同时使用PPO优化一个紧凑的CNN actor-critic。EAGLE在MASA、xBD零样本迁移和MM-GAG零样本航拍目标划分上分别取得78.1%、76.4%和76.8%的最先进平均成功率，且在推理时不使用VLM或缓存视觉token。代码将公开提供。

items.title_en: 3D Open-Vocabulary Detection via Visual Alignment and Generative Captions
items.title_zh: 通过视觉对齐与生成式描述进行3D开放词汇检测
items.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary 3D object detection remains a significant challenge for outdoor scenes, with existing methods often struggling to effectively transfer the rich semantic knowledge from powerful 2D Vision-Language Models (VLMs) into a 3D context. We propose a novel, two-part framework for this task. First, we introduce a direct, object-level distillation method. We generate class-agnostic 3D proposals to source regions from the entire scene, without relying on any manual labels. We leverage a spatially-aware VLM to extract a semantic embedding from each proposal's projected 2D bounding box and supervise our 3D model to predict this embedding on a per-instance basis. Second, to enhance zero-shot capability and inject domain-specific information, we employ a powerful Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) as an image captioner to generate rich textual captions for each of these proposals. These captions are integrated into the training objective to directly align the 3D features with these rich semantics, creating a composite loss that combines direct feature distillation with caption-based semantic enrichment. Our experiments validate the effectiveness of our approach, establishing a new state of the art in 3D open-vocabulary detection on the Waymo Open Dataset and nuScenes.
items.abstract_zh: 开放词汇3D目标检测仍是户外场景中的一项重大挑战，现有方法往往难以将强大的2D视觉-语言模型（VLM）中丰富的语义知识有效迁移到3D语境中。我们为此任务提出一种新颖的两部分框架。首先，我们引入一种直接的对象级蒸馏方法。我们生成类别无关的3D提议，以从整个场景中获取区域，而不依赖任何人工标签。我们利用具有空间感知能力的VLM，从每个提议投影后的2D边界框中提取语义嵌入，并监督我们的3D模型以逐实例方式预测该嵌入。其次，为增强零样本能力并注入领域特定信息，我们采用强大的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）作为图像描述器，为每个提议生成丰富的文本描述。这些描述被整合到训练目标中，以使3D特征与这些丰富语义直接对齐，形成一种将直接特征蒸馏与基于描述的语义增强相结合的组合损失。我们的实验验证了该方法的有效性，在Waymo Open Dataset和nuScenes上确立了3D开放词汇检测的新最先进水平。

items.title_en: One-Step Self-Assembling Lipopolymer Coatings Enable Direct Longitudinal Biosensing in Native Biological Matrices
items.title_zh: 一步自组装脂质聚合物涂层实现原生生物基质中的直接纵向生物传感
items.abstract_en: Sample-driven cross-reactivity remains a fundamental bottleneck for sensitive and selective biosensing in complex biological environments, particularly in microfluidic systems where high surface-to-volumes ratios amplify non-specific interactions. Here, we address this challenge with a one-step, biomimetic surface functionalization strategy based on engineered lipid-based nanocarriers that self-assemble within minutes into immunoassay-ready, antifouling interfaces that couple pegylated-lipid passivation with biorthogonal, site-specific probe conjugation. This approach enables rapid, tuneable, and reproducible surface functionalization, which suppresses sample-specific cross-reactivity even in undiluted serum, and supports direct, label-free digital biosensing assays directly in native biological environments. When integrated into an optofluidic platform combining digital in-line holography and microfluidics, this approach allows time-resolved quantification of tetraspanin-positive extracellular vesicle secretion dynamics from two-dimensional and three-dimensional lung cancer cell models using 50 μL of sample within 10 min, without isolation or purification. Because the presented surface functionalization proceeds via self-assembly rather than covalent surface modification, this one-step modular-approach is intrinsically decoupled from device fabrication and applies to both glass and PDMS, coating the entire microfluidic channel, thereby establishing a general route for integrating biomimetic nanostructures into robust, high-performance immunoassays, advancing biosensing beyond end-point measurements, and towards rapid and continuous real-time monitoring.
items.abstract_zh: 样本驱动的交叉反应性仍然是复杂生物环境中灵敏且选择性生物传感的基本瓶颈，尤其是在高表面积与体积比会放大非特异性相互作用的微流控系统中。在此，我们通过一种一步、仿生的表面功能化策略应对这一挑战；该策略基于工程化脂质纳米载体，这些载体可在数分钟内自组装成即用型免疫分析、抗污染界面，将聚乙二醇化脂质钝化与生物正交、位点特异性探针偶联相结合。该方法实现快速、可调且可重复的表面功能化，即使在未稀释血清中也能抑制样本特异性交叉反应，并支持直接在原生生物环境中进行直接、无标记的数字生物传感测定。当集成到结合数字同轴全息与微流控的光流控平台中时，该方法可在 10 分钟内使用 50 μL 样本，对二维和三维肺癌细胞模型中的四跨膜蛋白阳性细胞外囊泡分泌动态进行时间分辨定量，无需分离或纯化。由于所提出的表面功能化通过自组装而非共价表面修饰进行，这一一步模块化方法本质上与器件制造解耦，并适用于玻璃和 PDMS，涂覆整个微流控通道，从而为将仿生纳米结构整合到稳健、高性能免疫分析中建立了一条通用路径，推动生物传感超越终点测量，迈向快速、连续的实时监测。

items.title_en: Ultrabroadband, high-sensitivity time-resolved terahertz spectroscopy enabled by a Yb-based laser system
items.title_zh: 基于Yb基激光系统的超宽带、高灵敏度时间分辨太赫兹光谱
items.abstract_en: Ultrafast optical fields have introduced numerous novel light-induced states in quantum materials. Identifying these states and elucidating their formation mechanisms require comprehensive, quantitative access to nonequilibrium electrodynamics across relevant energy scales. Here, we develop a Yb-laser-based time-resolved terahertz spectroscopy (TRTS) platform combining multi-pass-cell pulse compression, spintronic terahertz generation, and air-biased coherent detection. A single time-domain waveform scan provides continuous phase-resolved spectral coverage to 25 THz ($\sim$100 meV) with a Fourier resolution of 0.1 THz ($\sim$0.4 meV). This capability enables the characterization of both low-frequency charge dynamics and higher-energy resonant excitations in quantum materials under a common temporal reference. The system achieves a single-scan time-domain signal-to-noise ratio of 72 dB with long-term waveform stability, while preserving most of the laser pulse energy for tunable excitation. Measurements on intrinsic GaAs resolve extremely weak phonon features above 23 THz and demonstrate quantitative retrieval of equilibrium and transient complex optical properties. The resulting platform can provide a more complete microscopic picture of light-induced states in quantum materials.
items.abstract_zh: 超快光场已在量子材料中引入众多新颖的光致态。识别这些态并阐明其形成机制，需要全面、定量地获取相关能量尺度上的非平衡电动力学。在此，我们开发了一个基于Yb激光的时间分辨太赫兹光谱（TRTS）平台，结合多通池脉冲压缩、自旋电子太赫兹产生和空气偏置相干探测。单次时域波形扫描提供连续相位分辨的光谱覆盖至25 THz（约100 meV），傅里叶分辨率为0.1 THz（约0.4 meV）。该能力使得在共同时间参考下表征量子材料中的低频电荷动力学和更高能量共振激发成为可能。该系统在长期波形稳定性下实现单次扫描时域信噪比72 dB，同时保留大部分激光脉冲能量用于可调谐激发。对本体GaAs的测量分辨出23 THz以上的极弱声子特征，并展示平衡态和瞬态复光学性质的定量反演。所得平台可为量子材料中光致态提供更完整的微观图像。

items.title_en: LIELLA: Private Edge Adaptation with Photonic Weight Streams
items.title_zh: LIELLA：基于光子权重流的私有边缘适配
items.abstract_en: Although photonic accelerators have shown promise for energy-efficient machine learning inference, privately personalizing large models across multiple edge clients remains difficult under tight memory, precision, and hardware constraints. We present LIELLA, a weight-streaming architecture that enables multiple edge clients to personalize a shared model through compact private adapters. The two proposed photonic adapter architectures accommodate both backpropagation and forward-only optimization while substantially reducing modeled client-side electrical energy consumption compared with electronic adapters. Under simulated hardware noise, clients sharing the same streamed backbone achieve nearly clean accuracy on QNLI and SST-2, even with attojoule-scale optical energy per MAC at each receiver. The architecture also enables hardware-aware adaptation among clients performing the same task, allowing their individual private adapters to achieve further accuracy improvements. For a gigabyte-scale TinyLlama backbone, LIELLA maintains a megabyte-scale inference memory footprint and kilobyte-scale persistent adapter storage per client, while achieving strong performance through forward-only adaptation. These findings further highlight hardware-driven opportunities to develop smaller yet more effective parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods and more accurate, noise-robust forward-only optimization algorithms.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管光子加速器在能效高的机器学习推理方面显示出前景，但在严格的内存、精度和硬件约束下，在多个边缘客户端之间私有地个性化大模型仍然困难。我们提出LIELLA，一种权重流式架构，使多个边缘客户端能够通过紧凑的私有适配器个性化共享模型。所提出的两种光子适配器架构同时支持反向传播和仅前向优化，同时与电子适配器相比大幅降低建模的客户端侧电能消耗。在模拟硬件噪声下，共享同一流式主干的客户端在QNLI和SST-2上达到接近干净准确率，即使每个接收器每次MAC仅使用阿托焦耳级光能。该架构还支持执行相同任务的客户端之间进行硬件感知适配，使其各自的私有适配器实现进一步的准确率提升。对于千兆字节规模的TinyLlama主干，LIELLA保持兆字节级推理内存占用和每客户端千字节级持久适配器存储，同时通过仅前向适配实现强劲性能。这些发现进一步凸显了硬件驱动的机会，以开发更小但更有效的参数高效微调（PEFT）方法以及更准确、噪声鲁棒的仅前向优化算法。

items.title_en: From Point Clouds to Engineering Models: Benchmarking Agentic 3D Reconstruction in the Built Environment
items.title_zh: 从点云到工程模型：建筑环境中智能体式三维重建的基准测试
items.abstract_en: Coding agents can translate 3D measurements into CAD geometry, but reconstructing engineering models for the built environment demands semantic interpretation and consistent construction constraints beyond surface fitting. We formulate scene-level Scan-to-BIM (Building Information Modeling) as an agentic 3D coding task and introduce S2Bench, comprising public and proprietary scans of 128 real-world scenes across five domains, paired with expert-curated reference models spanning diverse spatial scales. A shared framework lets agents measure scans in Python, build class-labeled components in a live CAD/BIM kernel, and iteratively refine their code. We also propose parallel asynchronous collaboration, where a lead delegates versioned tasks, continues modeling while workers execute, and integrates revision-bound proposals. Evaluating five agents and a collaborative team across 1,028 reconstructions shows that scan-to-model residuals directly guide geometric repair, whereas inferring semantic classes and construction relations requires joint geometric, visual, and engineering reasoning that agents struggle to ground and verify. Consequently, the leading agent fits scan geometry closely ($96\%$ coverage within $5\,\text{cm}$) yet reaches only $63\%$ mIoU, and no agent passes all engineering checks on more than $38\%$ of scenes. Coverage and engineering conformance drop with scene scale, whereas running a smaller model as a team improves all three axes with greater coverage gains on larger scenes. The project page is available at https://tumcms.github.io/S2Bench.github.io/
items.abstract_zh: 编码智能体可以将三维测量转化为CAD几何，但为建成环境重建工程模型需要超越表面拟合的语义解释和一致的建造约束。我们将场景级Scan-to-BIM（建筑信息建模）形式化为智能体式三维编码任务，并引入S2Bench，包含跨越五个领域的128个真实世界场景的公开和专有扫描，并配有覆盖不同空间尺度的专家整理参考模型。一个共享框架让智能体用Python测量扫描，在实时CAD/BIM内核中构建类别标记的组件，并迭代改进其代码。我们还提出并行异步协作，其中负责人委派带版本的任务，在工作者执行时继续建模，并整合修订绑定的提案。在1,028次重建中评估五个智能体和一个协作团队表明，扫描到模型的残差直接指导几何修复，而推断语义类别和建造关系需要联合的几何、视觉和工程推理，智能体难以落地和验证。因此，领先智能体紧密拟合扫描几何（5 cm内覆盖率96%），但仅达到63% mIoU，且没有智能体在超过38%的场景上通过所有工程检查。覆盖率和工程一致性随场景规模下降，而将较小模型作为团队运行可改善所有三个维度，并在较大场景上获得更大覆盖率提升。项目页面见 https://tumcms.github.io/S2Bench.github.io/。

items.title_en: ReWeave: Emergent Physical Task Topologies for Embodied Harness Optimization and Cross-Task Meta-Distillation
items.title_zh: ReWeave：用于具身执行框架优化与跨任务元蒸馏的涌现物理任务拓扑
items.abstract_en: Long-horizon embodied tasks involve physical dependencies that may only become clear through interaction. As task understanding deepens, past trials can reveal new information for adaptation and transfer. However, coarse progress feedback cannot identify which physical preconditions held, leaving search unguided, while task-specific optimization easily overfits to individual scenes, making cross-task transfer brittle. We introduce ReWeave, a framework that jointly optimizes an embodied agent harness and an emergent physical task topology from interaction without updating policy weights. Keeping execution policies and perception frozen, ReWeave co-optimizes coupled context, workflows, and control loops. As new evidence revises the topology, ReWeave reprojects past trials onto the updated task understanding, exposing retained progress, regressions, and bottlenecks that guide parent selection and search width. Across tasks, matching verified local mechanisms to unmet preconditions consolidates 72 specialist units into 44 reusable groups ($0.34\times$ full concatenation) within a compact shared harness capable of continual learning. ReWeave improves held-out success from 89.00% to 98.75% on LIBERO-PRO and from 25.50% to 58.25% on RoboDojo, while uncovering retained progress in 89% of 159 failed RoboDojo development trials and translating stronger offline reasoning into higher online performance. On eight unseen LIBERO-PRO tasks, the shared harness reaches 51.3% success versus 41.3% for direct distillation, rising to 75.0% after continual learning.
items.abstract_zh: 长时程具身任务涉及物理依赖关系，这些关系可能只有通过交互才能明确。随着任务理解加深，过去的试验可以揭示用于适应和迁移的新信息。然而，粗糙的进度反馈无法识别哪些物理前提成立，使搜索缺乏引导，而任务特定优化容易过拟合到单个场景，使跨任务迁移变得脆弱。我们引入ReWeave，一个无需更新策略权重、从交互中联合优化具身智能体执行框架和涌现物理任务拓扑的框架。在保持执行策略和感知冻结的情况下，ReWeave协同优化耦合的上下文、工作流和控制回路。当新证据修订拓扑时，ReWeave将过去的试验重新投影到更新后的任务理解上，暴露保留的进展、回退和瓶颈，以指导父代选择和搜索宽度。跨任务中，将验证过的局部机制与未满足的前提匹配，将72个专家单元整合为44个可复用组（全拼接的0.34×），位于一个紧凑的、能够持续学习的共享执行框架中。ReWeave将LIBERO-PRO上的留出成功率从89.00%提高到98.75%，将RoboDojo上的成功率从25.50%提高到58.25%，同时在159次失败的RoboDojo开发试验中的89%里发现保留的进展，并将更强的离线推理转化为更高的在线性能。在八个未见过的LIBERO-PRO任务上，共享执行框架达到51.3%成功率，而直接蒸馏为41.3%，在持续学习后升至75.0%。

items.title_en: SCATR-ITS: a scalable transformer for large-area individual tree segmentation from LiDAR point clouds
items.title_zh: SCATR-ITS：一种用于从LiDAR点云进行大面积单木分割的可扩展Transformer
items.abstract_en: Individual tree segmentation (ITS) from LiDAR point clouds is one of the most widely studied segmentation tasks in forestry. Although deep learning methods define the state of the art on the majority of ITS benchmarks, their high computational complexity and long runtime currently prevent their adoption in large-scale operational workflows. In this work, we present SCATR-ITS, a scalable transformer model specifically designed for efficient ITS over large geographical areas. Based on the ForestFormer3D framework, SCATR-ITS transitions to superpoint-level processing to accelerate inference, with the superpoints constructed from learned embeddings. The architecture incorporates size-aware superpoint-level postprocessing, a dynamic query count module to handle high variation in forest structure, and a maximal input stride designed to minimize prediction redundancy. SCATR-ITS achieves accuracy on par with the state of the art on the FGI-EMIT and FOR-InstanceV2 datasets with an up to 8.5$\times$ higher inference speed. In addition, SCATR-ITS has a significantly lower GPU VRAM footprint during both training and inference, and exhibits excellent zero-shot generalization across multiple datasets. To demonstrate large-area ITS capabilities, SCATR-ITS is applied to a 142 km$^2$ region of Finnish national laser scanning data where it achieves an average throughput of 13.8 min/km$^2$, $\sim$18.6$\times$ faster than ForestFormer3D and approaching the speed of the unsupervised watershed algorithm, which it vastly outperforms in accuracy and segment quality. Overall, SCATR-ITS delivers state-of-the-art accuracy at speeds where operational-scale adoption becomes viable, paving the way toward countrywide deployment. The source code for SCATR-ITS and pretrained weights are available at https://github.com/ruoppa/scatr_its.
items.abstract_zh: 从LiDAR点云进行单木分割（ITS）是林业中最广泛研究的分割任务之一。尽管深度学习方法在大多数ITS基准上代表了最先进水平，但其高计算复杂度和长运行时间目前阻碍其在大规模实际工作流中的应用。在本工作中，我们提出SCATR-ITS，一种专为在大地理区域内高效进行ITS而设计的可扩展Transformer模型。基于ForestFormer3D框架，SCATR-ITS转向超点级处理以加速推理，超点由学习到的嵌入构建。该架构结合了尺寸感知的超点级后处理、用于处理森林结构高度变化的动态查询数量模块，以及旨在最小化预测冗余的最大输入步幅。SCATR-ITS在FGI-EMIT和FOR-InstanceV2数据集上达到与最先进方法相当的精度，推理速度最高提升8.5倍。此外，SCATR-ITS在训练和推理期间的GPU显存占用显著更低，并在多个数据集上表现出优异的零样本泛化能力。为展示大面积ITS能力，SCATR-ITS被应用于芬兰国家激光扫描数据中142 km²的区域，平均吞吐量为13.8 min/km²，比ForestFormer3D快约18.6倍，接近无监督分水岭算法的速度，并在精度和分割质量上大幅优于后者。总体而言，SCATR-ITS在使实际规模采用变得可行的速度下提供了最先进的精度，为全国范围部署铺平道路。SCATR-ITS的源代码和预训练权重见https://github.com/ruoppa/scatr_its。

items.title_en: Learning effective stochastic predator and prey dynamics across physical and biological systems from limited data
items.title_zh: 从有限数据中学习跨物理和生物系统的有效随机捕食者-猎物动力学
items.abstract_en: Constructing an effective low-dimensional stochastic model from sparse observations requires separating deterministic drift from state-dependent fluctuations when the governing interaction law is unknown. We formulate an adaptive neural stochastic differential equation with topology constraints (TC-AdaNSDE) for two-variable predator--prey dynamics. To regularize the inverse problem when data are scarce, the model combines flexible drift and correlated diffusion fields with density-adaptive local Kramers--Moyal moment estimates and soft phase-space constraints reflecting boundary saddle behavior near extinction and local stability near coexistence. Using a known nonlinear stochastic system, we first show that short-time trajectory error cannot assess diffusion accuracy on its own and must be paired with distributional measures of one-step transitions and long-time phase-space occupancy. We then apply this framework to macroscopic turbulence and zonal flow energies reduced from Hasegawa--Wakatani plasma simulations and to short ecological time series. In the sparse-data regime, TC-AdaNSDE reproduces both short-horizon evolution and long-time invariant energy distributions where deterministic reductions collapse and unconstrained stochastic fits diverge, while recovering physically interpretable drift and fluctuation fields across both physical and biological systems.
items.abstract_zh: 从稀疏观测构建有效的低维随机模型，需要在相互作用规律未知时，将确定性漂移与状态依赖涨落分离。我们提出一种带拓扑约束的自适应神经随机微分方程（TC-AdaNSDE），用于两变量捕食者-猎物动力学。为在数据稀缺时正则化逆问题，该模型将灵活的漂移场和相关扩散场与密度自适应局部Kramers-Moyal矩估计以及软相空间约束相结合，这些约束反映灭绝附近的边界鞍行为与共存附近的局部稳定性。使用一个已知的非线性随机系统，我们首先表明短时轨迹误差本身无法评估扩散精度，必须与一步转移的分布度量和长时间相空间占据度量配合使用。随后我们将该框架应用于从Hasegawa-Wakatani等离子体模拟约化得到的宏观湍流和纬向流能量，以及短生态时间序列。在稀疏数据情形下，TC-AdaNSDE在确定性约化失效、无约束随机拟合发散之处，重现了短时程演化和长时间不变能量分布，同时在物理和生物系统中恢复了具有物理可解释性的漂移场和涨落场。

items.title_en: Reconfigurable Microwave Photonic All-Pass Filters based on Optical Kerr Microcombs
items.title_zh: 基于光学克尔微梳的可重构微波光子全通滤波器
items.abstract_en: Microwave photonic (MWP) all pass filters (APFs), which enable phase manipulation without altering signal amplitudes, are essential for phase engineering in high bandwidth microwave signal processing. However, achieving a high degree of reconfigurability in the filter order and characteristic parameters of APFs remains challenging for conventional methods. Here, we propose and experimentally demonstrate a new strategy for realizing MWP APFs based on a microcomb driven transversal filter system, enabling high reconfigurability, sharp phase transitions with high group delays, and low loss. We experimentally demonstrate both 1st and 2nd order APFs, achieving a maximum amplitude variation (MAV) of 1.95 dB and a maximum group delay (MGD) of 580 ps for the former, and a MAV of 2.01 dB and an MGD of 1740 ps for the latter. In addition, both independent and joint tuning of APF characteristic parameters are demonstrated by simply programming the tap coefficients without changing any hardware, enabling highly reconfigurable filter response for diverse phase engineering functionalities. These results highlight the potential of our approach for implementing MWP APFs with both high performance and reconfigurability for practical applications requiring dynamic and versatile phase control.
items.abstract_zh: 微波光子（MWP）全通滤波器（APF）能够在不改变信号幅度的情况下实现相位操控，对于高带宽微波信号处理中的相位工程至关重要。然而，常规方法在实现APF的滤波器阶数和特性参数的高度可重构性方面仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出并实验演示了一种基于微梳驱动的横向滤波器系统实现MWP APF的新策略，能够实现高可重构性、具有高群时延的尖锐相位跃迁以及低损耗。我们实验演示了一阶和二阶APF，前者实现最大幅度变化（MAV）1.95 dB和最大群时延（MGD）580 ps，后者实现MAV 2.01 dB和MGD 1740 ps。此外，通过简单编程抽头系数而无需改变任何硬件，演示了APF特性参数的独立调谐和联合调谐，为多种相位工程功能实现高度可重构的滤波器响应。这些结果突出了我们的方法在实现兼具高性能和可重构性的MWP APF方面的潜力，适用于需要动态且多功能相位控制的实用应用。

items.title_en: Towards Edge Artificial Intelligence for Predicting Antimicrobial Resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis
items.title_zh: 面向预测结核分枝杆菌抗菌药物耐药性的边缘人工智能
items.abstract_en: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB) poses a major challenge to global tuberculosis control, as multidrug-resistant strains limit available treatment options. Rapid and accurate prediction of drug resistance from genomic data could support timely treatment decisions and public health interventions. However, many existing computational approaches for genomic AMR prediction rely on computationally intensive pipelines, limiting their suitability for deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. This limitation is particularly relevant in hospital settings in low- and middle-income countries, where computing infrastructure and access to high-performance computational resources may be limited. To address this challenge, we present a lightweight, novel machine learning (ML) approach suitable for running on edge devices that combines 4-mer frequency features derived from whole-genome sequences with a Random Forest classifier to predict antibiotic resistance in MTB. The proposed ML approach achieved an average area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.82 across 20 antibiotics on an independent test set.
items.abstract_zh: 结核分枝杆菌（MTB）中的抗菌药物耐药性（AMR）对全球结核病控制构成重大挑战，因为耐多药菌株限制了可用的治疗选择。从基因组数据快速准确地预测耐药性可以支持及时的治疗决策和公共卫生干预。然而，许多现有的基因组AMR预测计算方法依赖于计算密集型流程，限制了其在资源受限边缘设备上的部署适用性。这一限制在低收入和中等收入国家的医院环境中尤其相关，因为这些环境中计算基础设施和高性能计算资源的获取可能有限。为应对这一挑战，我们提出一种适合在边缘设备上运行的轻量级新型机器学习（ML）方法，该方法将来自全基因组序列的4-mer频率特征与随机森林分类器相结合，以预测MTB中的抗生素耐药性。在独立测试集上，所提出的ML方法在20种抗生素上取得平均0.82的受试者工作特征曲线下面积。

items.title_en: Tasklets: A Unit-Test Benchmark for Language Model Architectures
items.title_zh: Tasklets：面向语言模型架构的单元测试基准
items.abstract_en: We introduce Tasklets, a benchmark of small synthetic tasks for evaluating the computational capabilities of language model sequence-mixing layers. These tasks probe foundational capabilities such as recall, sequence manipulation, and state tracking. Such tasks are widely used in architecture research, but differences in task selection, formulation, and evaluation make comparisons across studies difficult. Tasklets brings these tasks together, organizing them by the capabilities they test and providing a shared setup for evaluating how different architectural layer types learn fundamental computations. We compare a broad range of layer types through controlled experiments with small models. Our task implementations and evaluation code support reproducible, low-cost testing of new architectural proposals: https://github.com/zaydzuhri/flame/tree/tasklets.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出Tasklets，一个由小型合成任务组成的基准，用于评估语言模型序列混合层的计算能力。这些任务探测召回、序列操作和状态跟踪等基础能力。此类任务广泛用于架构研究，但任务选择、表述和评估方面的差异使跨研究比较困难。Tasklets将这些任务汇集在一起，按其所测试的能力组织，并提供共享设置，用于评估不同架构层类型如何学习基本计算。我们通过小模型受控实验比较了广泛的层类型。我们的任务实现和评估代码支持对新架构提议进行可重复、低成本测试：https://github.com/zaydzuhri/flame/tree/tasklets。

items.title_en: AXE: AlpaSim E2E Closed Loop Challenge Technical Report
items.title_zh: AXE：AlpaSim 端到端闭环挑战技术报告
items.abstract_en: This report presents a comprehensive pipeline for developing an end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving model for the Physical AI AV Track. The framework consists of data curation, HD map auto-labelling, data-driven imitation learning, and simulator-based reinforcement learning. To ensure safety in the closed-loop setting, we introduce a selection-based E2E planning approach that leverages object detection and BEV segmentation to filter out trajectory candidates likely to cause collisions or off-road driving. Trained on NVIDIA NuRec and the NVIDIA PAI-AV dataset, our method scores a fixed vocabulary of trajectory candidates for collision, drivable-area compliance, and progress learned from simulated rollouts, and selects the best candidate that passes the filter. This design highlights the effectiveness of combining E2E planning with perception-based trajectory filtering for safe and reliable closed-loop autonomous driving.
items.abstract_zh: 本报告提出了一个用于 Physical AI AV Track 的端到端（E2E）自动驾驶模型开发的综合流水线。该框架包括数据整理、HD 地图自动标注、数据驱动模仿学习和基于模拟器的强化学习。为确保闭环环境中的安全性，我们引入一种基于选择的 E2E 规划方法，利用目标检测和 BEV 分割来过滤可能造成碰撞或驶出路面的轨迹候选。我们的方法在 NVIDIA NuRec 和 NVIDIA PAI-AV 数据集上训练，对固定词汇的轨迹候选按碰撞、可行驶区域合规性和从模拟 rollout 中学到的进度进行评分，并选择通过过滤器的最佳候选。该设计凸显了将 E2E 规划与基于感知的轨迹过滤相结合，对于安全可靠的闭环自动驾驶的有效性。

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为用于视图合成的神经辐射场
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏的输入视图集优化底层连续体积场景函数，在合成复杂场景的新视图方面取得最先进的结果。我们的算法使用全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，其输入是单个连续的5D坐标（空间位置 $(x,y,z)$ 和观察方向 $(θ, φ)$），输出是该空间位置处的体积密度和视角相关的发射辐射度。我们通过沿相机光线查询5D坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体积渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影到图像中。由于体积渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示所需的唯一输入是一组已知相机姿态的图像。我们描述了如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何形状和外观的场景的逼真新视图，并展示了优于先前神经渲染和视图合成工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看我们的补充视频以进行有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: Pesticide mixtures may compromise ecosystem services provided by an egg parasitoid of soybean pest stink bugs: a comprehensive ecotoxicological risk assessment
items.title_zh: 农药混合物可能损害大豆害虫蝽类卵寄生蜂提供的生态系统服务：一项综合生态毒理学风险评估
items.abstract_en: Tank mixtures of crop protection products are widely used in agricultural systems, yet their integrated effects on biological control agents remain poorly understood. We evaluated the lethal, sublethal, and transgenerational effects of four synthetic insecticides, applied alone or in binary mixtures with three fungicides and two herbicides, on adults and pupae of Telenomus podisi (Hymenoptera: Scelionidae), an important egg parasitoid of pest stink bugs. In adult bioassays, LC50 values ranged from 28.26 mg a.i. L-1 for isocycloseram + lambda-cyhalothrin to 265.88 mg a.i. L-1 for acephate. Overall, mixtures increased adverse effects relative to the individual products, reducing survival, parasitism, and longevity. The lowest parasitism rates occurred with isocycloseram + lambda-cyhalothrin combined with chlorothalonil or glyphosate SL formulation. Transgenerational effects were also detected, including reduced F1 emergence and an increased proportion of males in some treatments. Following pupal exposure, several mixtures reduced F0 emergence, whereas ethiprole + fenpropimorph and acephate + bixafen + prothioconazole + trifloxystrobin also reduced parasitism and longevity of the emerged adults. Integration of lethal and sublethal responses using the reduction coefficient (Ex) revealed increased toxicity for several mixtures and shifts in IOBC risk classification; notably, all insecticide + glyphosate mixtures reached Ex = 100% after pupal exposure. These findings show that assessing pesticides individually may underestimate ecotoxicological risk to T. podisi and highlight the need to consider pesticide mixtures in integrated pest management programs.
items.abstract_zh: 作物保护产品的桶混在农业系统中广泛使用，但其对生物防治天敌的综合影响仍知之甚少。我们评估了四种合成杀虫剂单独施用或与三种杀菌剂和两种除草剂二元混用对 Telenomus podisi（膜翅目：缘腹卵蜂科）成虫和蛹的致死、亚致死及跨代效应；T. podisi 是害虫蝽类的重要卵寄生蜂。在成虫生物测定中，LC50 值范围为 isocycloseram + lambda-cyhalothrin 的 28.26 mg a.i. L-1 至乙酰甲胺磷的 265.88 mg a.i. L-1。总体而言，与单剂相比，混合物增加了不良效应，降低了存活率、寄生率和寿命。最低寄生率出现在 isocycloseram + lambda-cyhalothrin 与百菌清或草甘膦 SL 制剂组合时。还检测到跨代效应，包括某些处理中 F1 羽化减少和雄性比例增加。蛹期暴露后，若干混合物降低了 F0 羽化，而乙虫腈 + 芬丙吗啉和乙酰甲胺磷 + 联苯吡菌胺 + 丙硫菌唑 + 肟菌酯也降低了羽化成虫的寄生率和寿命。使用减少系数（Ex）整合致死和亚致死反应，揭示若干混合物的毒性增加以及 IOBC 风险分类的变化；值得注意的是，所有杀虫剂 + 草甘膦混合物在蛹期暴露后达到 Ex = 100%。这些发现表明，单独评估农药可能低估对 T. podisi 的生态毒理学风险，并强调在综合害虫管理计划中考虑农药混合物的必要性。

items.title_en: Conceptual Design of a 5 MV High-Voltage System for a Compact Orbitron Fusion Device
items.title_zh: 用于紧凑型 Orbitron 聚变装置的 5 MV 高压系统概念设计
items.abstract_en: The high-voltage system is a key part of the puzzle toward achieving net-positive fusion power in a compact Orbitron device. This paper presents a conceptual engineering design for a 5 MV, 20 mA, 100 kW HV system for a next-generation Orbitron, serving as an upper-bound design point for the HV system. The MC-TRANS++ 0-D code is used to set the load requirements: a 1 m long, 0.45 m first-wall-radius central cell, 2.5 T on-axis and 10 T mirror-throat fields, and a 5 MV radial potential drop sustaining supersonic rotation ($M = 4.8$). This delivers a triple product of $5.8 \times 10^{21}$ keV s /m3 and $Q_{sci}$ = 8.5. The HV power supply integrates an AC-DC converter, a SiC full-bridge inverter, a CLLC resonant network with an air-core step-up transformer, and feeds a 120-stage parallel-fed series-cascaded rectifier operating at 250 kHz. At full load, this architecture yields an end-to-end efficiency of 85%, much higher than the 60% typical of triode-driven MV-class power supplies. The 5 MV voltage is delivered to a radially nested 50-gap bushing system that interfaces pressurized insulating gas to high vacuum, using brazed alumina spacers with a corrugated profile. The design draws directly on the measured behavior of a previously demonstrated 300 kV prototype, from which six quantitative lessons are extracted and mapped onto the 5 MV design. Electrostatic simulations of the complete assembly at rated voltage show maximum surface fields of 30.3 MV/m on the corona rings, 7.7 MV/m at the cathode triple junction, and average vacuum-gap fields ranging from 5.5 to 40 MV/m. These field strengths remain below breakdown thresholds due to the implementation of triple-junction shielding, insulation corrugation, and axial magnetic insulation at 2.5-10 T. The conceptual system has a form factor of 2.7 meters in diameter and 6.5 meters in length, projected to deliver a net power output of 86-171 kWe.
items.abstract_zh: 高压系统是在紧凑型 Orbitron 装置中实现净正能量聚变的关键部分。本文介绍用于下一代 Orbitron 的 5 MV、20 mA、100 kW 高压系统的概念工程设计，作为高压系统的上限设计点。使用 MC-TRANS++ 0-D 代码设定负载要求：1 m 长、第一壁半径 0.45 m 的中心室，轴上 2.5 T 和镜喉 10 T 的磁场，以及维持超音速旋转（M = 4.8）的 5 MV 径向势降。这给出 5.8×10^21 keV s/m3 的三重积和 Q_sci = 8.5。高压电源集成 AC-DC 变换器、SiC 全桥逆变器、带空心升压变压器的 CLLC 谐振网络，并为在 250 kHz 下运行的 120 级并联馈电串联级联整流器供电。满载时，该架构的端到端效率为 85%，远高于三极管驱动的 MV 级电源典型的 60%。5 MV 电压输送到径向嵌套的 50 间隙套管系统，该系统将加压绝缘气体与高真空接口，使用带波纹轮廓的钎焊氧化铝垫片。该设计直接借鉴先前演示的 300 kV 原型的实测行为，从中提取六条定量经验并映射到 5 MV 设计。完整组件在额定电压下的静电仿真显示，电晕环上的最大表面场为 30.3 MV/m，阴极三结处为 7.7 MV/m，真空间隙平均场为 5.5 至 40 MV/m。由于实施了三结屏蔽、绝缘波纹以及 2.5–10 T 的轴向磁绝缘，这些场强仍低于击穿阈值。该概念系统的外形尺寸为直径 2.7 米、长度 6.5 米，预计可提供 86–171 kWe 的净功率输出。

items.title_en: cmHC: Balancing Stream Mixing in Hyper-Connections via Geometric Contraction
items.title_zh: cmHC：通过几何收缩平衡超连接中的流混合
items.abstract_en: Manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) extends residual connections to multiple streams and stabilizes residual propagation by constraining stream-mixing residual matrices to the Birkhoff polytope, the set of doubly stochastic matrices. In this work, we investigate how to effectively mix residual streams within the Birkhoff polytope. We reveal a mixing trade-off: when under-mixed residual matrices stay close to the vertices of the Birkhoff polytope, hyper-connections will degenerate into a set of nearly independent streams; when over-mixed residual matrices are concentrated around the uniform barycenter of the polytope, streams will become less distinguishable from each other. We theoretically validate our findings by bounding the cumulative residual mixing, stream difference and gradient difference of mixing coefficients across layers. Motivated by these findings, we propose Contraction for Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (cmHC), an exact doubly stochastic method which geometrically contracts the Birkhoff polytope toward its interior. This contraction mitigates under-mixing by forcing the residual matrices to explore deeper into the polytope, with a provable stream mixing bound and no new parameterization. Moreover, we apply a moderate contraction at the shallow layers to prevent over-mixing, enabling stable gradient propagation on extremely large-scale model pretraining. Extensive experiments across dense and mixture-of-experts models at various parameter scales demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of cmHC. We also develop fused operators for cmHC on Ascend NPUs, reducing hyper-connection execution latency by up to 44.8%.
items.abstract_zh: 流形约束超连接（mHC）将残差连接扩展到多个流，并通过将流混合残差矩阵约束到Birkhoff多面体（双随机矩阵集合）来稳定残差传播。在本工作中，我们研究如何在Birkhoff多面体内有效混合残差流。我们揭示了一种混合权衡：当混合不足时，残差矩阵靠近Birkhoff多面体的顶点，超连接将退化为一组近乎独立的流；当混合过度时，残差矩阵集中在多面体的均匀重心附近，流之间将变得难以区分。我们通过对跨层的累积残差混合、流差异及混合系数的梯度差异进行界定，从理论上验证了这些发现。受此启发，我们提出流形约束超连接的收缩方法（cmHC），这是一种精确双随机方法，在几何上将Birkhoff多面体向其内部收缩。该收缩迫使残差矩阵更深入多面体内部探索，从而缓解混合不足，具有可证明的流混合界且不引入新参数化。此外，我们在浅层施加适度收缩以防止过度混合，从而在超大规模模型预训练中实现稳定梯度传播。在多种参数规模的稠密模型和专家混合模型上的大量实验证明了cmHC的有效性和可扩展性。我们还为cmHC开发了Ascend NPU上的融合算子，将超连接执行延迟最多降低44.8%。

items.title_en: MemFolder: Structure-Guided Memory Folding for Efficient Agent Memory Management
items.title_zh: MemFolder：结构引导的记忆折叠用于高效智能体记忆管理
items.abstract_en: Long-term agents accumulate large external memory stores as interactions unfold, increasing the costs of storage, retrieval, and response generation. Efficiency is constrained by two coupled factors: a growing record count increases retrieval overhead, while longer retrieved contexts increase prefill computation and decoding-time attention costs. Existing methods prune or consolidate records, but pruning can discard useful evidence, whereas consolidation may produce fewer yet longer retrieval units. We introduce MemFolder, a structure-guided memory folding framework that sequentially reduces record count and context length. The framework comprises two core components that share memory groups, using cross-record structure to guide both evidence consolidation and compact representation. RecordFolder grounds entity mentions, progressively selects representative yet complementary anchors, and combines semantic and entity affinity with temporal chaining to consolidate compatible records into fewer retrieval units. ContextFolder encodes the original records within these groups into compact text and uses verification feedback to revise encodings when key facts cannot be recovered. Experiments on the three text-based memory benchmarks LoCoMo, PersonaMem, and LongMemEval and the two multimodal benchmarks M3-Bench-web and M3-Bench-robot demonstrate the strong performance of our methods. Notably, on Mem0, RecordFolder retains 99.0% of the original average performance across the three text-based benchmarks with 50% fewer records, exceeding the strongest baseline by 1.9 percentage points in performance retention. Combined with ContextFolder, existing record compression methods further shorten their output records while retaining most of their performance.
items.abstract_zh: 长期智能体随着交互展开会积累大量外部记忆存储，增加存储、检索和响应生成的成本。效率受到两个耦合因素的制约：记录数量增长增加检索开销，而检索上下文变长增加预填充计算和解码时注意力成本。现有方法对记录进行剪枝或合并，但剪枝可能丢弃有用证据，而合并可能产生更少但更长的检索单元。我们提出MemFolder，一种结构引导的记忆折叠框架，顺序减少记录数量和上下文长度。该框架包括两个共享记忆组的核心组件，利用跨记录结构指导证据合并和紧凑表示。RecordFolder对实体提及进行接地，逐步选择具有代表性但互补的锚点，并将语义和实体亲和性与时间链相结合，将兼容记录合并为更少的检索单元。ContextFolder将这些组内的原始记录编码为紧凑文本，并在关键事实无法恢复时使用验证反馈修正编码。在三个基于文本的记忆基准LoCoMo、PersonaMem和LongMemEval以及两个多模态基准M3-Bench-web和M3-Bench-robot上的实验证明了我们方法的强大性能。值得注意的是，在Mem0上，RecordFolder在三个基于文本的基准上以少50%的记录保留了原始平均性能的99.0%，在性能保留方面超过最强基线1.9个百分点。与ContextFolder结合，现有记录压缩方法进一步缩短其输出记录，同时保留其大部分性能。

items.abstract_zh: 如今，使用消费级 LiDAR 进行房间扫描依赖 ARKit，其跟踪和地图更新是一个黑箱：应用接收深度和位姿，但无法检查它们是如何生成的，因此扫描中的错误无法追溯到原因。本文研究一种开放替代方案——其每个阶段都可检查——在设备上是否可行。Mobile-LIO 是一种深度-惯性里程计流水线，使用手机的深度和惯性数据，不使用 ARKit 位姿。在七段 ScanNet++ iPhone 录制上，它完成了每个场景，与 ARKit 导出的参考偏差为 0.2–2.0 m；而六个开源 LiDAR-惯性估计器按专用扫描仪配置运行时，在 42 次运行中的 41 次至少有 4.46 m 偏差（六者中的两个还未能通过无噪声适配器检查，并且 Mobile-LIO 有一个它们没有的速度上限；该比较并非受控比较，且原文此处含乱码“does not rone 15 Pro Max”；一个采用修正后手机代码的构建在三段 7–13 s 录制、共 15 次回放运行中的 14 次跟上了传感器；原文此处含乱码“e estimator before those corrections”。激光扫描网格给出精度。在 3 m 内，记录深度在三个留出场景中与网格的差异中位数为 1.8–2.3 cm，而原文给出 17 cm；数据集缩放并对齐到网格的、与 ARKit 位姿融合的地图（原文此处不清）。因为流水线是开放的，差距可以被检查：在误差最大的场景中，无噪声渲染使误差从 1.97 m 降至 0.04 m，因此记录深度（其误差在 5–7 m 处达到 20–54 cm）与估计器共同造成了误差。一个开放的（原文此处不清）在手机深度上跟踪，并在短手机回放中跟上了传感器，但尚不如 ARKit 位姿地图准确；这些地图仅达到最粗的 USIBD 精度等级（LOA10）；其在设备上的精度未被测量。

items.title_en: MORSE: Optimizing Streaming Memory Design via Open-World Auto-Research
items.title_zh: MORSE：通过开放世界自动研究优化流式记忆设计
items.abstract_en: A streaming video system must decide in a single pass what evidence to retain under bounded frame storage, before it knows which details a future question will require. Recent recursive self-improvement methods automate the design of the harness that stores and retrieves this evidence. They revise the harness in response to failures, but the editor must still devise each repair from its prior knowledge and a predefined set of tools. A failure that recurs across videos, however, may point to a problem that prior work has already addressed. We introduce MORSE (Memory Optimization with Recursive Self-Evolvement), an open-world auto-research framework that uses recurring failures to guide an online search for solutions. Its editor groups failures in training traces by cause, then searches papers, model cards, and code for methods it can adapt or pretrained perception models it can use. When the editor introduces a new perceptual capability, it can also revise how the harness stores and retrieves the resulting evidence for a frozen video-language model. On held-out validation streams, MORSE first selects revisions that improve answer quality, then seeks faster revisions that preserve those gains within a specified tolerance. Across three streaming video benchmarks, MORSE consistently achieves the highest answer accuracy within each frozen-backbone comparison. On OVO-Bench, our Qwen3-VL-8B harness answers queries in 0.30 seconds on average while achieving 75.1% accuracy, 3.1 percentage points ahead of the next-best evaluated harness using the same frozen backbone.
items.abstract_zh: 流式视频系统必须在单次处理中，在有限帧存储下决定保留哪些证据，而此时尚不知道未来问题会需要哪些细节。最近的递归自我改进方法自动化了存储和检索这些证据的 harness 设计。它们根据失败来修订 harness，但编辑者仍必须根据自己的先验知识和一组预定义工具来设计每次修复。然而，跨视频反复出现的失败可能指向先前工作已解决的问题。我们提出 MORSE（Memory Optimization with Recursive Self-Evolvement，递归自我演化记忆优化），一个开放世界自动研究框架，利用反复出现的失败来指导在线搜索解决方案。其编辑器将训练轨迹中的失败按原因分组，然后搜索论文、模型卡和代码，寻找可适配的方法或可使用的预训练感知模型。当编辑器引入新的感知能力时，它还可以为冻结的视频-语言模型修订 harness 存储和检索由此产生的证据的方式。在留出验证流上，MORSE 首先选择能提高答案质量的修订，然后寻求在指定容差内保持这些收益的更快修订。在三个流式视频基准上，MORSE 在每个冻结骨干比较中始终取得最高答案准确率。在 OVO-Bench 上，我们的 Qwen3-VL-8B harness 平均在 0.30 秒内回答查询，同时达到 75.1% 准确率，比使用相同冻结骨干的次优评估 harness 领先 3.1 个百分点。

items.title_en: Impact of Topology and Sequence Length on the Pressure-Dependent Collapsibility of Proteins
items.title_zh: 拓扑结构与序列长度对蛋白质压力依赖性可塌缩性的影响
items.abstract_en: Several physical and evolutionary factors, including temperature, pressure, solvent quality, and natural selection, influence how amino acid sequences adopt their native structures. Although protein folding has been extensively studied, the physical determinants of protein collapse and their relationship to native-state folding remain less understood. In particular, "collapsibility", the intrinsic propensity of a protein sequence to form compact conformations, is distinct from but closely related to "foldability", the ability to reach the native structure. Previous theoretical studies suggested that collapsibility is encoded in native-state topology, potentially reflecting evolutionary selection. However, the roles of solvent-mediated interactions and hydrostatic pressure remain unclear. Here, we extend the theoretical framework of protein collapsibility by incorporating a pressure-dependent desolvation potential to investigate how hydrostatic pressure influences protein collapse. We find that increasing pressure destabilizes the fully folded native state, but can still favor the compact, water-mediated conformations. Furthermore, the magnitude and direction of pressure-induced changes in collapsibility depend strongly on native-state topology, including secondary and tertiary structures. Proteins and domains with a higher proportion of non-local native contacts generally exhibit greater pressure-induced water-mediated collapsibility. These findings highlight the role of native-state topology in determining the pressure sensitivity of protein collapse and provide insights into the interplay among protein structure, solvent-mediated interactions, and environmental perturbations.
items.abstract_zh: 包括温度、压力、溶剂质量和自然选择在内的若干物理和进化因素影响氨基酸序列如何采用其天然结构。尽管蛋白质折叠已被广泛研究，但蛋白质塌缩的物理决定因素及其与天然态折叠的关系仍知之甚少。特别是，“可塌缩性”（蛋白质序列形成紧凑构象的内在倾向）与“可折叠性”（达到天然结构的能力）不同但密切相关。先前的理论研究提出，可塌缩性编码在天然态拓扑中，可能反映进化选择。然而，溶剂介导相互作用和静水压力的作用仍不清楚。在此，我们扩展蛋白质可塌缩性的理论框架，纳入压力依赖性去溶剂化势，以研究静水压力如何影响蛋白质塌缩。我们发现，增加压力会使完全折叠的天然态失稳，但仍可有利于紧凑的、水介导的构象。此外，压力诱导的可塌缩性变化的大小和方向强烈依赖于天然态拓扑，包括二级和三级结构。具有较高比例非局部天然接触的蛋白质和结构域通常表现出更大的压力诱导水介导可塌缩性。这些发现突出了天然态拓扑在决定蛋白质塌缩压力敏感性中的作用，并为蛋白质结构、溶剂介导相互作用和环境扰动之间的相互作用提供了见解。

items.title_en: Composite Dielectric-Loaded Metallic Metagratings for Dual-Polarized Transmissive Beam Manipulation
items.title_zh: 用于双极化透射光束调控的复合介质加载金属超光栅
items.abstract_en: We present and experimentally demonstrate a comprehensive analytical suite for the design of transmissive metal-based metagratings (MGs) for dual-polarized anomalous refraction. Considering a composite configuration of perforated metallic slabs with controlled dielectric loading, we develop a rigorous mode-matching formulation tying the various MG degrees of freedom to the various reflected and transmitted Floquet-Bloch modes, enabling efficient beam deflection for both transverse electric (TE) and transverse magnetic (TM) polarizations. Inherently versatile, the analytical framework accurately models single-layer and double-layer constructs with multiple rectangular perforations per unit cell, each potentially loaded with dielectric material. We harness this degree-of-freedom abundance to devise diverse polarization-sensitive transmissive MGs, ranging from all-metallic single-layer and double-layer structures for single-polarized (TM or TE) perfect anomalous refraction, to dielectric-loaded architectures implementing dual-polarized routing of the incident wave. Beyond highlighting concrete paths to address TE-polarized fields in such formations, our results, validated via full-wave simulations and experiments at K band, showcase the great potential of metal-based MGs for manipulating fields in transmission, facilitating effective synthesis of durable dual-polarized beamforming superstrates for environmentally demanding and high power antenna applications.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出并通过实验演示了一套综合分析套件，用于设计面向双极化反常折射的透射式金属基超光栅（MG）。考虑具有受控介质加载的穿孔金属板复合配置，我们开发了一种严格的模式匹配公式，将各种 MG 自由度与各种反射和透射 Floquet-Bloch 模式联系起来，从而实现对横电（TE）和横磁（TM）两种极化的高效光束偏转。该分析框架本质上具有通用性，可准确建模每单元具有多个矩形穿孔、且每个穿孔可加载介质材料的单层和双层结构。我们利用这种丰富的自由度设计了多种极化敏感透射式 MG，从用于单极化（TM 或 TE）完美反常折射的全金属单层和双层结构，到实现入射波双极化路由的介质加载架构。除了强调在此类结构中处理 TE 极化场的具体路径外，我们的结果经 K 波段全波仿真和实验验证，展示了金属基 MG 在透射场调控方面的巨大潜力，有助于为环境要求严苛和高功率天线应用有效合成耐用的双极化波束赋形覆层。

items.title_en: Making Protocol Effects Explicit: LLM-to-Packet Simulation for Superpod Interconnect Exploration
items.title_zh: 使协议效应显式化：用于超节点互连探索的 LLM 到数据包仿真
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have become the foundation of modern AI services. The rapid growth of LLM sizes and context lengths has exceeded the memory capacity of a single GPU or NPU, requiring model partitioning across devices. However, partitioning models across devices introduces costly communication overhead, driving the need for superpods with large-scale, high-bandwidth, low-latency scale-up fabrics. Exploring superpod designs requires accurate interconnect simulation, as communication latency is jointly determined by link technologies, topologies, and scale-up protocol-stack choices. Latency-bandwidth models estimate communication latency using a startup term and a transfer term derived from message size and effective bandwidth. But they fail to capture contention and protocol effects. Packet-level simulators like ns-3 model routing, queueing, and packet timing, but require protocol-specific LLM-to-packet implementations. This paper presents ProtoBridge, an ns-3-based LLM-to-packet simulator for superpod interconnect exploration. To make protocol effects explicit, ProtoBridge introduces two abstraction layers over ns-3: (1) an operation-to-packet (OTP) layer that captures protocol-specific packet exchanges and dependencies, and (2) a packet-execution (PEX) layer that applies shared packet-level mechanisms to the ns-3 event system. ProtoBridge achieves average latency error of 17.8\% on H200 NVLink4 and 10.3\% on C500 MetaXLink. To enable faster superpod evaluation for further interconnect exploration, we derive a surrogate model that combines OTP parameters with analytical models of PEX mechanisms. The surrogate reduces evaluation time from 2.38$\sim$75.70s to 20.5us per operation. We use ProtoBridge to analyze two emerging superpod designs, scale-up memory pool and co-packaged optics (CPO) interconnects, revealing design insights for future LLM superpod architectures.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）已成为现代 AI 服务的基础。LLM 规模和上下文长度的快速增长已超过单个 GPU 或 NPU 的内存容量，需要跨设备进行模型划分。然而，跨设备划分模型会引入昂贵的通信开销，从而推动对具有大规模、高带宽、低延迟 scale-up 互连结构的超节点的需求。探索超节点设计需要准确的互连仿真，因为通信延迟由链路技术、拓扑和 scale-up 协议栈选择共同决定。延迟-带宽模型使用启动项和由消息大小与有效带宽导出的传输项来估计通信延迟，但未能捕捉竞争和协议效应。像 ns-3 这样的数据包级仿真器可对路由、排队和数据包时序建模，但需要特定协议的 LLM 到数据包实现。本文提出 ProtoBridge，一个基于 ns-3 的 LLM 到数据包仿真器，用于超节点互连探索。为使协议效应显式化，ProtoBridge 在 ns-3 之上引入两个抽象层：(1) 操作到数据包（OTP）层，捕捉协议特定的数据包交换和依赖关系；(2) 数据包执行（PEX）层，将共享的数据包级机制应用于 ns-3 事件系统。ProtoBridge 在 H200 NVLink4 上达到平均延迟误差 17.8%，在 C500 MetaXLink 上为 10.3%。为了支持更快的超节点评估以进一步探索互连，我们推导了一个代理模型，将 OTP 参数与 PEX 机制的分析模型相结合。该代理模型将每次操作的评估时间从 2.38~75.70 秒降低到 20.5 微秒。我们使用 ProtoBridge 分析两种新兴超节点设计：scale-up 内存池和共封装光学（CPO）互连，揭示面向未来 LLM 超节点架构的设计洞见。

items.title_en: Typhoon OCR 2: From Thai Document Transcription to Multilingual, Multi-Task OCR
items.title_zh: Typhoon OCR 2：从泰语文档转录到多语言、多任务 OCR
items.abstract_en: Typhoon OCR 1.5 focused on reading Thai documents. However, in real-world workflows, users often need to extract specific information or preserve the structure of an entire page for further processing. Typhoon OCR 2 handles both tasks in a single model, with prompt-driven extraction and structured full-page parsing. Full-page parsing covers Thai, English, and Chinese. We release compact 2B and 0.8B models adapted from open document parsers through supervised fine-tuning on curated Thai and public multilingual data, followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with task rewards and a rule penalizing unfinished responses. Among evaluated open models, Typhoon OCR 2 2B scores highest on Thai MDPBench (80.7 versus 68.9 for Typhoon OCR 1.5) and on ThaiOCRBench (59.91 versus 40.45), which covers recognition, extraction, and document understanding. The 2B model remains close to its base on English olmOCR-bench (84.7 versus 84.4) and on OmniDocBench, which evaluates English and Chinese together (90.97 versus 91.03). On MDPBench, GRPO reduces the mean share of pages with repetition loops for the 2B model from 3.2% to 0.7%, with a smaller and statistically uncertain score gain for the 0.8B model. We release the model weights, Python package, and evaluation suite.
items.abstract_zh: Typhoon OCR 1.5 专注于阅读泰语文档。然而，在真实工作流中，用户常常需要提取特定信息或保留整页结构以便进一步处理。Typhoon OCR 2 在单个模型中处理这两类任务，包括提示驱动的提取和结构化全页解析。全页解析涵盖泰语、英语和中文。我们发布了紧凑的 2B 和 0.8B 模型，这些模型基于开放文档解析器，通过在精选泰语数据和公开多语言数据上进行监督微调，随后使用带任务奖励和惩罚未完成响应规则的组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行适配。在受评估的开放模型中，Typhoon OCR 2 2B 在 Thai MDPBench（80.7 对 Typhoon OCR 1.5 的 68.9）和 ThaiOCRBench（59.91 对 40.45）上得分最高，后者涵盖识别、提取和文档理解。2B 模型在英语 olmOCR-bench 上（84.7 对 84.4）以及在同时评估英语和中文的 OmniDocBench 上（90.97 对 91.03）仍接近其基座模型。在 MDPBench 上，GRPO 将 2B 模型出现重复循环页面的平均占比从 3.2% 降至 0.7%，而 0.8B 模型的分数提升较小且统计上不确定。我们发布模型权重、Python 包和评估套件。

items.title_en: A ROS2 based Human-In-The-Loop Framework for UAV Search and Rescue Operations
items.title_zh: 基于 ROS2 的无人机搜救人在回路框架
items.abstract_en: Existing Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) autonomy frameworks lack human contextual awareness, limiting real-time adaptability in unstructured Search and Rescue (SAR) environments. To address data availability, we propose a Robot Operating System (ROS2)-based human-in-the-loop (HITL) framework that translates human directional gestures (left/right) into UAV navigation commands using RGB-Depth (RGB-D) sensing and YOLOv11 (You Only Look Once). The deprecation of ROS1 necessitates migrating to ROS2, prioritising real-time communication, scalability, and long-term maintainability. Unlike approaches optimised for peak accuracy under ideal conditions, the proposed system prioritises robustness and real-time deployment in degraded SAR environments. Our system achieves 89% confidence in depth estimation under occlusion and varying environmental conditions in Gazebo-PX4 simulations. In foggy conditions, RGB-D fusion consistently provides more informative cues than RGB alone, with an average improvement of 46.7% across all scenarios and distances. The framework demonstrates superior occlusion handling (+15%), adaptive RGB-D fusion, temporal consistency modelling, and real-time deployment via a ROS2 data distribution service (DDS), with end-to-end latency below 50 ms. We evaluate the modified YOLOv11 and the depth-weighted pose estimation on a held-out simulated test set and on real people from the public UAV-GESTURE dataset, in clear air and in Koschmieder fog. Without retraining, the framework reads the gestures of real people with 80% accuracy, depth keeps 77% at a visibility of 10 m where RGB drops to 24%, and the modified YOLOv11 reaches 91% in simulation and 99% on held-out real people when trained on real data. The open-source ROS2 implementation eases the transition of SAR-UAV platforms from ROS1, enabling UAVs to act directly on operator gestures without complex path planning.
items.abstract_zh: 现有的无人机（UAV）自主框架缺乏人类上下文感知，限制了在非结构化搜索与救援（SAR）环境中的实时适应性。为解决数据可用性问题，我们提出一个基于机器人操作系统（ROS2）的人在回路（HITL）框架，使用 RGB-深度（RGB-D）传感和 YOLOv11（You Only Look Once）将人类方向手势（左/右）转换为无人机导航命令。ROS1 的弃用要求迁移到 ROS2，优先考虑实时通信、可扩展性和长期可维护性。与在理想条件下针对峰值精度优化的方法不同，所提系统优先考虑在退化 SAR 环境中的鲁棒性和实时部署。在 Gazebo-PX4 仿真中，我们的系统在遮挡和变化环境条件下达到 89% 的深度估计置信度。在雾天条件下，RGB-D 融合始终比仅 RGB 提供更有信息量的线索，在所有场景和距离上平均提升 46.7%。该框架展示了更优的遮挡处理（+15%）、自适应 RGB-D 融合、时间一致性建模，以及通过 ROS2 数据分发服务（DDS）的实时部署，端到端延迟低于 50 ms。我们在留出的仿真测试集以及来自公开 UAV-GESTURE 数据集的真人上，在晴空和 Koschmieder 雾中评估修改后的 YOLOv11 和深度加权位姿估计。在无需重新训练的情况下，该框架读取真人的手势准确率为 80%；在能见度为 10 m 时，深度保持 77%，而 RGB 降至 24%；修改后的 YOLOv11 在仿真中达到 91%，在真实数据训练后于留出真人上达到 99%。开源 ROS2 实现便于 SAR-UAV 平台从 ROS1 迁移，使无人机能够直接根据操作员手势行动，而无需复杂路径规划。

items.title_en: RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering
items.title_zh: 扩散Transformer中的强化学习后训练即激活引导
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training substantially improves the visual quality, text rendering, and compositional accuracy of diffusion transformers. Because capabilities such as rendering requested text or composing multiple objects are inherently prompt-dependent, a natural hypothesis is that improving them requires learning complex, input-dependent transformations. To isolate how much of these gains an input-independent shift explains, we probe each RL-tuned model with a deliberately simple parameterization: a fixed set of steering vectors added to the block outputs of the frozen base model. On SD3.5-M, these vectors hold 65x fewer parameters than the RL-tuned LoRA (0.29M against 18.8M). We fit them to match the velocity predictions of public RL-tuned checkpoints, with no reward in the objective. Although the vectors are identical for every prompt, token, and sampling seed, they recover 90.0-96.3% of the reward gains of six RL-tuned image models, and 89.8% and 111.9% on two RL-tuned video models. Initialized at zero and trained with online RL, the vectors alone exceed the reward gains of weight-based RL on text rendering (OCR) and human preference (PickScore) on SD3.5-M. A constant shift thus suffices for most of the gain of policy-gradient RL post-training: without new input-dependent transformations, it steers the pretrained generator toward what it can already compute.
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）后训练能显著提升扩散Transformer的视觉质量、文本渲染和组合准确性。由于渲染指定文本或组合多个物体等能力本质上依赖提示，一个自然假设是：改进这些能力需要学习复杂的、依赖输入的变换。为分离输入无关偏移能解释多少此类增益，我们用一个刻意简单的参数化探测每个经RL调优的模型：向冻结基础模型的模块输出加入一组固定引导向量。在SD3.5-M上，这些向量的参数量比经RL调优的LoRA少65倍（0.29M对18.8M）。我们拟合这些向量以匹配公开RL调优检查点的速度预测，目标函数中不含奖励。尽管这些向量对每个提示、token和采样种子都相同，它们仍恢复了六个RL调优图像模型奖励增益的90.0–96.3%，并在两个RL调优视频模型上分别恢复89.8%和111.9%。以零初始化并用在线RL训练时，仅这些向量在SD3.5-M的文本渲染（OCR）和人类偏好（PickScore）上就超过了基于权重的RL的奖励增益。因此，恒定偏移足以解释策略梯度RL后训练的大部分增益：无需新的依赖输入的变换，它便将预训练生成器引导向其已能计算的内容。

items.title_en: Separating Genetic and Protein Evidence in Open Targets: An Auditable Re-ranking Study
items.title_zh: 在 Open Targets 中分离遗传与蛋白质证据：一项可审计的重排序研究
items.abstract_en: Biomedical target-ranking platforms combine genetics, literature, experimental evidence, tractability, and clinical precedent because each is useful for target discovery. A single integrated score, however, can be awkward to reuse for a narrower question such as which genes have direct evidence for disease risk or etiology. We examine this issue in Open Targets associations for Alzheimer disease (AD) and Parkinson disease (PD). Genetics-linked evidence and protein-oriented evidence are scored in separate channels and combined only at the end. In AD, the Open Targets overall top 20 contains 7 curated genetics-supported genes and 10 symptomatic pharmacology controls; the default late fusion contains 15 curated genes and no symptomatic controls. In PD, late fusion retains 13 curated genes and removes the 5 symptomatic controls present in the platform top 20. A genetics-only ranking reaches similar curated recall (14 genes in AD, 13 in PD), so most of the gain over the platform score comes from emphasizing genetic evidence; the protein channel mainly raises the number of tractable targets in the shortlist (from 9 to 12 in AD and from 8 to 10 in PD) without readmitting symptomatic controls. These results are stable across fusion weights from 0.35 to 0.75, perturbed protein-channel weights, and rule thresholds. An optional post-ranking rule further lowers high-clinical/low-genetic targets such as ACHE and GRIN1 without changing top-20 curated recall. The procedure is deterministic and uses public Open Targets fields. Because the component scores remain available, individual rank changes can be inspected and the ranking can be reproduced from the same data snapshot.
items.abstract_zh: 生物医学靶点排序平台结合遗传学、文献、实验证据、可成药性和临床先例，因为每项都有助于靶点发现。然而，单一集成评分可能难以复用于更窄的问题，例如哪些基因具有疾病风险或病因学的直接证据。我们在 Open Targets 中针对阿尔茨海默病（AD）和帕金森病（PD）的关联数据考察该问题。与遗传学相关的证据和面向蛋白质的证据在独立通道中评分，仅在最后合并。在 AD 中，Open Targets 总体前 20 包含 7 个经整理的遗传学支持基因和 10 个症状性药理学对照；默认晚期融合包含 15 个经整理基因且不含症状性对照。在 PD 中，晚期融合保留 13 个经整理基因，并移除平台前 20 中存在的 5 个症状性对照。仅遗传学排序达到相似的经整理召回（AD 中 14 个基因，PD 中 13 个），因此相对平台评分的大部分增益来自强调遗传学证据；蛋白质通道主要提高候选短名单中可成药靶点的数量（AD 从 9 增至 12，PD 从 8 增至 10），而未重新纳入症状性对照。这些结果在 0.35 至 0.75 的融合权重、扰动的蛋白质通道权重和规则阈值下保持稳定。一个可选的排序后规则进一步降低高临床/低遗传靶点（如 ACHE 和 GRIN1），而不改变前 20 的经整理召回。该流程是确定性的，并使用公开的 Open Targets 字段。由于成分评分仍然可用，可以检查单个排名变化，并可从同一数据快照复现排序。

items.title_en: Probabilistic image generation conditioned on an optical latent code
items.title_zh: 以光学潜在编码为条件的概率图像生成
items.abstract_en: While diffractive optical networks compress images into compact representations, such measurements have predominantly served discriminative inference or deterministic reconstruction. Here we demonstrate probabilistic image generation conditioned solely on a 16_bit binary optical latent code (OLC) formed by a diffractive encoder and binarized camera readout. The intentionally many-to-one mapping makes each OLC specify a class of OLC-compatible images rather than a unique reconstruction target. An OLC_conditioned conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) learns this distribution, while optical re-encoding promotes consistency between generated images and the measured OLC. Numerical characterization and proof-of-concept acquisition with a spatial light modulator_camera system establish the OLC as a physically accessible generative condition. On MNIST, samples generated from a single OLC vary in morphology while preserving class identity, and their optical-recognition accuracy reaches 81.6%, close to the 81.9% obtained from the source OLCs. These results link compact optical sensing to probabilistic synthesis of optically recognizable images.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管衍射光学网络将图像压缩为紧凑表示，此类测量主要服务于判别式推断或确定性重建。在此，我们展示仅以由衍射编码器和二值化相机读出形成的16位二进制光学潜在编码（OLC）为条件的概率图像生成。有意设计的多对一映射使每个OLC指定一类与OLC兼容的图像，而不是唯一的重建目标。一个以OLC为条件的条件变分自编码器（CVAE）学习该分布，而光学重编码促进生成图像与测得OLC之间的一致性。数值表征以及采用空间光调制器-相机系统的概念验证采集确立了OLC作为一种物理上可访问的生成条件。在MNIST上，由单个OLC生成的样本在形态上变化，同时保持类别身份，其光学识别准确率达到81.6%，接近从源OLC获得的81.9%。这些结果将紧凑光学传感与光学可识别图像的概率合成联系起来。

items.title_en: Yggdrasil: Tree-Routed Recurrent Experts for State Tracking and Fast CPU Inference
items.title_zh: Yggdrasil：用于状态跟踪和快速 CPU 推理的树路由循环专家
items.abstract_en: Parallel-trainable recurrences such as Mamba, linear attention, and DeltaNet offer constant-cost streaming inference, but they suffer from two limitations: 1) they struggle to track discrete state, and 2) they read every parameter at every step, tying model capacity directly to CPU latency. We introduce Yggdrasil, a recurrent architecture that decouples capacity from per-step compute by looking up each layer's transition in a large, tree-routed bank of recurrent experts. Each router addresses its bank using the current token and the state of the layer below. We prove that this cross-layer context is necessary---a single token-indexed layer of non-expanding transitions with finitely many reachable states cannot perform conditional resets---while avoiding feedback from the layer's own past preserves parallel-scan training. Because each step traverses one tree path and reads a single expert per layer, active weights stay within a few hundred kilobytes in CPU L2 cache while the full bank resides in RAM. Among the parallel-trainable models we evaluate, Yggdrasil is the only one to solve all five state-tracking tasks. At matched active parameter counts, it achieves the lowest test bits on enwik8 (1.540 bpb) and the human genome hg38 (1.567 bpb), while stepping $3.0\times$ and $3.3\times$ faster on a single CPU core ($6.7\,μ\mathrm{s}$ and $5.8\,μ\mathrm{s}$) than the fastest streaming baseline, and delivering the highest GPU throughput of all models at batch 1024. On the Genomic Benchmarks, it is the strongest causal model at matched active parameters (86.0% mean accuracy).
items.abstract_zh: 可并行训练的循环结构（如 Mamba、线性注意力和 DeltaNet）提供恒定成本的流式推理，但存在两个局限：1）难以跟踪离散状态；2）每一步都读取所有参数，将模型容量直接与 CPU 延迟绑定。我们提出 Yggdrasil，一种循环架构，通过在一个大型的树路由循环专家库中查找每层的状态转移，将容量与每步计算解耦。每个路由器使用当前 token 和下方层的状态来寻址其专家库。我们证明这种跨层上下文是必要的——单个以 token 索引的、具有有限多个可达状态且非扩展转移的层无法执行条件重置——同时避免来自该层自身过去的反馈可保持并行扫描训练。由于每一步只遍历一条树路径并每层读取单个专家，活跃权重在 CPU L2 缓存中保持在几百 KB 以内，而完整专家库驻留在 RAM 中。在我们评估的可并行训练模型中，Yggdrasil 是唯一解决全部五个状态跟踪任务的模型。在匹配活跃参数数量时，它在 enwik8（1.540 bpb）和人类基因组 hg38（1.567 bpb）上取得最低测试比特数，同时在单个 CPU 核上比最快的流式基线快 3.0 倍和 3.3 倍（6.7 μs 和 5.8 μs），并在 batch 1024 时提供所有模型中最高的 GPU 吞吐量。在 Genomic Benchmarks 上，它是匹配活跃参数下最强的因果模型（平均准确率 86.0%）。

items.title_en: NoHairCache: Calibrate-Once KV Cache Eviction with One Power-Law Exponent
items.title_zh: NoHairCache：使用单一幂律指数进行一次校准的 KV 缓存驱逐
items.abstract_en: The decay exponent $α$ in KV-cache eviction is an intrinsic property of the model: calibrated once on a single corpus, it transfers directly across domains. Attention-based accumulation (H2O) and recency-based sliding windows (StreamingLLM) are two dominant eviction frameworks, often treated as unrelated, but we show that they are the two endpoints of a single power-law family: by scoring each token as $s_i = A_i \cdot (t-i)^{-α}$, where $A_i$ is cumulative attention and $α$ controls the age penalty, H2O and StreamingLLM correspond to $α=0$ and $α\to\infty$, respectively (with StreamingLLM additionally hard-coding an attention-sink patch). The no-hair mechanism of \citet{xiang2026nohair} bounds the admissible range of $α$, and the measured exponents agree: calibrating once on WikiText yields $[0.556, 0.822]$ for a representative model (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct). The per-model ranges are consistent across five models (410M--1.5B) and independently match the optimal regions from perplexity sweeps. \textsc{NoHairCache} achieves the lowest perplexity across three datasets (WikiText, PG19, and arXiv) without per-dataset tuning, outperforming both H2O and StreamingLLM ($p < 0.05$ on all three datasets, with $0.06$--$0.10$ PPL gains over StreamingLLM at budget $512$). On downstream four-way multiple-choice QA, it matches or outperforms StreamingLLM across all nine (task, budget) cells, retaining $98.2\%$ of full-cache accuracy on NarrativeQA at $25\%$ retention versus $91.1\%$ for StreamingLLM; per-cell McNemar tests are not significant, so QA is corroborating only. We release our calibration script and drop-in scorer upon publication.
items.abstract_zh: KV 缓存驱逐中的衰减指数 α 是模型的内在属性：在单一语料上校准一次后，它可直接跨领域迁移。基于注意力的累积（H2O）和基于最近性的滑动窗口（StreamingLLM）是两种主流驱逐框架，常被视为互不相关，但我们证明它们是同一幂律族的两个端点：通过将每个 token 评分为 s_i = A_i · (t-i)^{-α}，其中 A_i 是累积注意力，α 控制年龄惩罚，H2O 和 StreamingLLM 分别对应 α=0 和 α→∞（StreamingLLM 还额外硬编码一个注意力汇补丁）。Xiang 等（2026）的无毛机制限定了 α 的允许范围，且测量得到的指数一致：在 WikiText 上校准一次得到代表性模型（Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct）的范围 [0.556, 0.822]。每个模型的范围在五个模型（410M--1.5B）上一致，并独立匹配困惑度扫描得到的最优区域。NoHairCache 在无需按数据集调参的情况下，在三个数据集（WikiText、PG19 和 arXiv）上取得最低困惑度，优于 H2O 和 StreamingLLM（三个数据集上均 p < 0.05，在预算 512 时相对 StreamingLLM 有 0.06--0.10 的 PPL 增益）。在下游四选一多项选择问答中，它在全部九个（任务，预算）单元中匹配或优于 StreamingLLM，在 NarrativeQA 上以 25% 保留率保持全缓存准确率的 98.2%，而 StreamingLLM 为 91.1%；逐单元 McNemar 检验不显著，因此问答结果仅作佐证。我们将在发表时发布校准脚本和即插即用评分器。

items.title_en: Personalization of a Commercial Powered Knee Prosthesis Under Clinically Realistic Conditions via Reinforcement Learning: A Feasibility Study
items.title_zh: 在临床现实条件下通过强化学习实现商用动力膝关节假体的个性化：一项可行性研究
items.abstract_en: Personalization of powered prosthesis control to individual user needs remains a significant challenge. To address this challenge, policy iteration with constraint embedded (PICE), a reinforcement learning (RL) tuning approach, has been developed and validated. This feasibility study investigated whether the developed approach can personalize a commercial powered knee prosthesis under clinically realistic conditions. To reduce the time for personalization, tuning was initialized with a policy learned offline from one non-disabled participant walking on a treadmill and was then applied to three other non-disabled participants walking with the knee through a bypass adapter on a 5-meter walkway. All participants reached the goal within 8-18 tuning steps (1.7-4.2 minutes of walking), reducing the knee-kinematic feature error by 64-90% on average. These results support the feasibility of implementing the RL-based tuning approach in clinically realistic conditions with space and equipment constraints.
items.abstract_zh: 将动力假体控制个性化到个体用户需求仍是一项重大挑战。为应对该挑战，已开发并验证了一种嵌入约束的策略迭代（PICE）强化学习（RL）调参方法。本可行性研究考察所开发方法能否在临床现实条件下个性化商用动力膝关节假体。为减少个性化时间，调参以从一名非残疾参与者在跑步机上行走离线学习到的策略初始化，然后应用于另外三名非残疾参与者，他们通过旁路适配器佩戴该膝关节在 5 米步道上行走。所有参与者在 8-18 个调参步数内达到目标（行走 1.7-4.2 分钟），平均将膝关节运动学特征误差降低 64-90%。这些结果支持在具有空间和设备约束的临床现实条件下实施基于 RL 的调参方法的可行性。

items.title_en: Interpretable Tissue Architecture Complements Pathology Foundation Models
items.title_zh: 可解释的组织结构可补充病理基础模型
items.abstract_en: Tissue architecture provides important information for histopathological assessment, yet its complementary predictive value alongside pathology foundation-model representations remains insufficiently understood. This study investigates whether interpretable measurements of cellular and multicellular tissue organization provide additional predictive information beyond learned representations. We introduce a 139-dimensional cellular-to-community representation comprising nine feature groups characterizing nuclear morphology, cellular composition, spatial connectivity, community organization, and cell-cell interactions. Their predictive contributions are systematically evaluated independently and through feature-level fusion with CTransPath and PLIP embeddings using multiple-instance learning (MIL). On the BCNB dataset, estrogen receptor (ER) and progesterone receptor (PR) classification is evaluated across four MIL architectures using five-fold patient-disjoint cross-validation. Selected CTransPath fusion configurations achieved mean ROC-AUC values of 0.9144 (ER) and 0.8360 (PR), while PLIP fusion achieved 0.8791 and 0.8015, respectively. Patient-level analyses identified ER-associated differences in nuclear morphology, graph connectivity, cellular communities, and cell-cell interactions. On LungHist700, selected fusion configurations achieved higher mean ROC-AUC across four classification tasks, including adenocarcinoma versus squamous cell carcinoma (0.7967 versus 0.7137 for CTransPath alone). Overall, these findings suggest that interpretable tissue-architecture descriptors can complement foundation-model representations while providing measurable insights into histopathological organization.
items.abstract_zh: 组织结构为组织病理学评估提供了重要信息，但其与病理基础模型表征相伴随的互补预测价值仍未被充分理解。本研究探讨细胞及多细胞组织结构的可解释度量能否在学习到的表征之外提供额外的预测信息。我们引入一个139维的从细胞到群落的表征，包含九个特征组，分别刻画细胞核形态、细胞组成、空间连通性、群落组织以及细胞间相互作用。采用多示例学习（MIL），对这些特征的预测贡献在独立使用以及与CTransPath和PLIP嵌入进行特征级融合两种情形下进行系统评估。在BCNB数据集上，采用五折患者不交叉的交叉验证，在四种MIL架构上评估雌激素受体（ER）与孕激素受体（PR）分类。选定的CTransPath融合配置取得平均ROC-AUC为0.9144（ER）和0.8360（PR），而PLIP融合分别取得0.8791和0.8015。患者水平分析识别出与ER相关的差异，涉及细胞核形态、图连通性、细胞群落和细胞间相互作用。在LungHist700上，选定的融合配置在四个分类任务上取得更高的平均ROC-AUC，包括腺癌与鳞状细胞癌分类（0.7967，而单独CTransPath为0.7137）。总体而言，这些发现表明可解释的组织结构描述符能够补充基础模型表征，同时提供对组织病理学组织的可度量洞察。

items.title_en: Second-Order Dynamics in Noisy RNNs Produce Exploration and Temporal Compression in Replay
items.title_zh: 噪声RNN中的二阶动力学在回放中产生探索和时间压缩
items.abstract_en: Biological neural networks (like the hippocampus) can internally generate "replay" resembling stimulus-driven activity. Recent computational models of replay use noisy recurrent neural networks (RNNs) trained to path-integrate. Replay in these networks is described as Langevin sampling, but this theory alone fails to capture the environmental exploration and temporal compression observed in real biological replay. To close this gap, we re-examine spontaneous noisy RNN activity ("replay") as Langevin sampling, one timestep at a time, from a time-series distribution resembling lived experiences (unlike previous works which defined sampling as Monte Carlo inference over a static distribution). We provide a normative second-order Langevin sampling framework wherein spike-frequency adaptation drives spatial exploration at the cost of speed, and momentum via dendritic input differentiation drives temporal compression. We numerically verify our framework via simulations of noisy RNNs trained on 2D triangular and T-maze navigation activity, and others trained on place cell activity of synthetic rats. Crucially, we observe that simultaneous adaptation and momentum increases both replay exploration and speed, and provide one of the first accounts for biologically plausible temporal compression in rate-based RNN replay. Our findings encourage experiments into whether dendritic input differentiation, or other mechanisms, may support temporal compression in memory circuits like the hippocampus.
items.abstract_zh: 生物神经网络（如海马体）可在内部生成类似刺激驱动活动的“回放”。近期回放计算模型使用经路径积分训练的噪声递归神经网络（RNN）。这些网络中的回放被描述为Langevin采样，但仅凭该理论无法捕捉真实生物回放中观察到的环境探索和时间压缩。为弥补这一差距，我们重新审视自发噪声RNN活动（“回放”），将其视为每次一个时间步地从类似真实经历的时间序列分布中进行Langevin采样（不同于先前工作将采样定义为对静态分布的蒙特卡洛推断）。我们提供一个规范性二阶Langevin采样框架，其中脉冲频率适应以速度为代价驱动空间探索，而通过树突输入微分产生的动量驱动时间压缩。我们通过对在二维三角形和T迷宫导航活动中训练的噪声RNN进行仿真，以及对在合成大鼠位置细胞活动上训练的其他RNN进行仿真，数值验证了我们的框架。关键的是，我们观察到适应与动量同时存在会提高回放探索和速度，并为基于速率的RNN回放中生物学上合理的时间压缩提供了最早的解释之一。我们的发现鼓励开展实验，研究树突输入微分或其他机制是否可能支持海马体等记忆回路中的时间压缩。

items.title_en: Dephasing-free plasma acceleration with millijoule picosecond lasers
items.title_zh: 毫焦级皮秒激光实现无退相等离子体加速
items.abstract_en: Laser-plasma accelerators reach gradients a thousand times above radio-frequency cavities, but need joule-class femtosecond lasers firing about once per second, and electrons outrun the wave. A comb of laser lines spaced by the plasma frequency, each in its own mode of a matched channel, drives a wake moving at the speed of light. In particle-in-cell simulations a 175\,mJ, 0.5\,ps drive holds 21\,GV/m over 10\,mm with a 0.15\,rad phase drift; a test electron gains 208\,MeV, 2.6 times more than in one mode. Because the wave builds up resonantly, the required energy falls steeply with density: a 29\,mJ drive sustains 20\,GV/m, and a 10\,mJ drive, within reach of kilohertz industrial lasers, gives a test electron 170\,MeV over 30\,mm. A simulated stage transfers 5\,\% of the laser energy to the wake; the Manley--Rowe limit is about 18\,\% for five lines.
items.abstract_zh: 激光等离子体加速器可达到比射频腔高一千倍的梯度，但需要焦耳级飞秒激光器以约每秒一次的频率发射，而且电子会跑出波前。由等离子体频率间隔的激光频率梳，每条谱线处于匹配通道的各自模式中，驱动一个以光速移动的尾波。在粒子网格（PIC）模拟中，175 mJ、0.5 ps的驱动在10 mm上维持21 GV/m，相位漂移为0.15 rad；一个测试电子获得208 MeV，比单一模式中多2.6倍。由于波是共振建立的，所需能量随密度陡峭下降：29 mJ驱动可维持20 GV/m，而10 mJ驱动（千赫兹工业激光器可达到）使测试电子在30 mm上获得170 MeV。一个模拟加速级将5%的激光能量转移给尾波；五条谱线的Manley-Rowe极限约为18%。

items.title_en: BQDNA: Multi-Head Binary Spherical Quantization for Genomic Sequence Modeling
items.title_zh: BQDNA：用于基因组序列建模的多头二值球面量化
items.abstract_en: Decoding biological information from long, repetitive DNA remains challenging. Genomic language models (gLMs) often follow the conventional language-model pretrain-and-adapt paradigm. However, the lack of inherent semantic segmentation and prior rules makes hand-crafted tokenizers like k-mer and BPE suboptimal. We introduce context-aware \textbf{BQVAE} for scalar quantization of DNA and \textbf{BQDNA}, an autoregressive gLM supporting multi-head codebooks. Comprehensive experiments reveal that: (1) unique training dynamics of vector quantization in DNA space, including the importance of alignment between training corpus and downstream data. (2) superior performance of BQVAE over hand-crafted tokenizers and vanilla VQVAE. (3) remarkable cross-species generalization capability of BQDNA, which achieves state-of-the-art performance with merely 0.1B multi-species training for BQVAE and 1 epoch training on hg38 for BQDNA, outperforming gLMs pretrained with 10$\sim$100x more tokens. Our findings underscore the potential of learned vector quantization for genomic sequence representation. Code is available at https://github.com/Sophie10001b/BQDNA
items.abstract_zh: 从长且重复的DNA中解码生物信息仍然具有挑战性。基因组语言模型（gLM）通常遵循传统语言模型的预训练与适应范式。然而，缺乏内在语义分割和先验规则使得k-mer和BPE等手工分词器并非最优。我们引入上下文感知的BQVAE用于DNA的标量量化，以及BQDNA，一种支持多头码本的自回归gLM。综合实验揭示：（1）DNA空间中向量量化的独特训练动力学，包括训练语料与下游数据之间对齐的重要性。（2）BQVAE优于手工分词器和普通VQVAE的性能。（3）BQDNA显著的跨物种泛化能力，其仅需BQVAE的0.1B多物种训练和BQDNA在hg38上的1个epoch训练即达到最先进性能，优于使用多10~100倍token预训练的gLM。我们的发现强调了学习到的向量量化在基因组序列表示中的潜力。代码见 https://github.com/Sophie10001b/BQDNA
