items.title_en: AltRA-Test: An Alternative Annotator Test for LLM Judges Without Shared Annotators
items.title_zh: AltRA-Test：一种无需共享标注者的LLM评判者替代标注者检验
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as judges and graders to replace human annotators, raising the question of when such replacement is statistically justified. To support such decisions, the Alternative Annotator Test (Alt-Test) was introduced for dense settings where all items are annotated by the same annotators. However, in many large-scale annotation settings, items are annotated by different subsets of annotators. We therefore propose the Alternative Annotator Test with Resampled Annotations (AltRA-Test), a statistical test that does not require that all items are annotated by the same annotators. AltRA-Test uses a bootstrap that resamples items, draws k human annotations for each item, and substitutes one of them with an LLM annotation. This produces paired all-human and mixed human-LLM panels. A replacement is supported when the inter-annotator agreement (IAA) of the mixed panel is statistically non-inferior to the IAA of the all-human panel, i.e., when the LLM preserves the signal that the human annotators share. We establish that AltRA-Test is a consistent test of asymptotic level alpha. We then evaluate it through simulations and real-world experiments in which we test 18 LLMs and 5 prompting techniques on 20 datasets across text, image, audio, and video. Across these evaluations, about 100 items often suffice for the test. In simulations, where we know whether the LLM is a better or a worse annotator than the humans, AltRA-Test makes more correct replacement decisions than existing baselines. In real-world data experiments, LLMs pass the test in about half of the setups, depending mainly on the task. Since replacement is not always justified, we encourage researchers to test it for their task.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作评判者和评分者以替代人工标注者，这引出了何时这种替代在统计上合理的问题。为支持此类决策，替代标注者检验（Alt-Test）被提出，用于所有条目均由同一批标注者标注的稠密情形。然而，在许多大规模标注情形中，条目由不同的标注者子集标注。因此，我们提出重采样标注的替代标注者检验（AltRA-Test），这是一种不要求所有条目均由同一批标注者标注的统计检验。AltRA-Test使用自助法重采样条目，为每个条目抽取k个人工标注，并将其中的一个替换为LLM标注。由此产生配对的全人工面板与人工-LLM混合面板。当混合面板的标注者间一致性（IAA）在统计上非劣于全人工面板的IAA时，即当LLM保留了人工标注者共有的信号时，支持进行替代。我们证明AltRA-Test是渐近水平为alpha的一致检验。随后我们通过模拟与真实世界实验对其进行评估，在涵盖文本、图像、音频和视频的20个数据集上测试了18个LLM和5种提示技术。在这些评估中，约100个条目通常足以完成该检验。在已知LLM标注者优于还是劣于人工标注者的模拟中，AltRA-Test比现有基线做出更多正确的替代决策。在真实数据实验中，LLM在约一半的设置中通过检验，主要取决于任务。由于替代并非总是合理，我们鼓励研究人员针对其任务进行检验。

items.title_en: CoSel: Cooperation as Selection for End-to-End Driving
items.title_zh: CoSel：端到端驾驶中以合作为选择
items.abstract_en: Cooperative driving can extend a vehicle's awareness beyond its own sensors, but existing cooperative end-to-end methods inject shared information into the planner and rely on cooperative driving demonstrations to learn how to use it. The moments in which shared information should change a driving decision are rare in such data, providing limited supervision for learning this behavior. We argue that cooperation need not be learned by the planner. Instead, reacting to shared information requires predicting how surrounding agents will move and selecting a response from the candidate trajectories of an ego planner. We introduce CoSel, a cooperation-as-selection framework that leaves the planner and its ego-only input unchanged. A separately trained cooperative predictor uses observations from the ego vehicle, roadside units, and connected automated vehicles to predict surrounding agents and their future motion. CoSel evaluates the planner's candidate trajectories against these predictions, preserves the planner's choice when it remains safe, and selects the closest safe alternative when shared information reveals additional risk. Each safety intervention is traceable to the shared evidence that triggers it. In closed-loop evaluation, CoSel achieves a driving score of 70.7 on V2Xverse, outperforming the best compared cooperative method by 7.5 points, and the highest average driving score of 85.8 on MDrive. Under missing ego detections, the collision count of CoSel increases only from 17 to 19 in 72 scenarios, compared with 19 to 32 for an existing cooperative end-to-end model.
items.abstract_zh: 合作驾驶可将车辆感知扩展到自身传感器之外，但现有合作端到端方法将共享信息注入规划器，并依赖合作驾驶示范来学习如何使用该信息。在此类数据中，共享信息应改变驾驶决策的时刻很少，因而为学习该行为提供的监督有限。我们认为合作不必由规划器学习。相反，对共享信息作出反应需要预测周围智能体将如何移动，并从自车规划器的候选轨迹中选择响应。我们提出CoSel，一种“合作即选择”框架，保持规划器及其仅自车输入不变。一个单独训练的合作预测器使用来自自车、路侧单元和网联自动驾驶车辆的观测，预测周围智能体及其未来运动。CoSel根据这些预测评估规划器的候选轨迹；当规划器选择仍然安全时保留该选择，当共享信息揭示额外风险时选择最接近的安全替代方案。每次安全干预都可追溯到触发它的共享证据。在闭环评估中，CoSel在V2Xverse上取得70.7的驾驶得分，比最佳对比合作方法高7.5分，并在MDrive上取得85.8的最高平均驾驶得分。在自车检测缺失情况下，CoSel在72个场景中的碰撞次数仅从17增加到19，而现有合作端到端模型则从19增加到32。

items.title_en: Non-penetrating World Models
items.title_zh: 非穿透世界模型
items.abstract_en: We study a new problem of preventing object penetration in interactive video world models. To understand how existing models handle this, we introduce NoPeBench, a benchmark that evaluates how world models respond to physical obstacles. Our evaluation reveals that none of the open-source models can reliably prevent such failures. Surprisingly, however, these models already encode the information needed to predict such violations. We find that the hidden states of diffusion transformers (DiTs) can predict whether a candidate action will penetrate an obstacle. Building on this, we introduce NoPeWorld, a lightweight framework that detects and prevents penetration. Specifically, we train a small prediction head on top of a frozen DiT's hidden states to read out if a candidate action is safe or not. Unsafe actions are then replaced with safe ones that best preserve the original intent. Despite its simplicity, NoPeWorld substantially reduces the physical violation rate, averaged over six video world models, from 74% to 16%. Remarkably, our method shows zero-shot generalization to open-domain imagery, third-person viewpoints, and moving obstacles. We publicly release our code, the NoPeBench benchmark, and model weights. Project Page: https://nopeworld.github.io .
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究一个防止交互式视频世界模型中物体穿透的新问题。为理解现有模型如何处理该问题，我们提出 NoPeBench，一个评估世界模型如何响应物理障碍的基准。我们的评估表明，没有任何开源模型能够可靠地防止此类失败。然而令人意外的是，这些模型已经编码了预测此类违规所需的信息。我们发现扩散变换器（DiTs）的隐藏状态可以预测候选动作是否会穿透障碍物。基于此，我们提出 NoPeWorld，一个检测并防止穿透的轻量级框架。具体而言，我们在冻结的 DiT 隐藏状态之上训练一个小型预测头，以读出候选动作是否安全。然后，将不安全动作替换为最能保留原始意图的安全动作。尽管方法简单，NoPeWorld 在六个视频世界模型上平均将物理违规率从 74% 大幅降至 16%。值得注意的是，我们的方法展现出对开放域图像、第三人称视角和移动障碍物的零样本泛化能力。我们公开代码、NoPeBench 基准和模型权重。项目页面：https://nopeworld.github.io 。

items.title_en: Cognitive Load modulates the exploration-exploitation trade-off Through Reconfiguration of an IPS-Centered Decision Network
items.title_zh: 认知负荷通过重构以 IPS 为中心的决策网络来调节探索-利用权衡
items.abstract_en: In dynamic environments where rewards continuously change, adaptive decision-making requires ongoing updates of option-value and uncertainty estimates to balance exploration and exploitation. This process depends on cognitive resources and involves coordinated interactions among multiple brain regions; however, how cognitive load affects directed exploration in such dynamic environments, and whether these effects are accompanied by changes in interactions among exploration-related brain regions, remains unclear. We embedded a working-memory load manipulation within a dynamic four-armed bandit task. Experiment 1 compared computational models and quantified load-related changes in exploration; Experiment 2 examined these behavioral effects in an independent sample and investigated their neural correlates using fMRI. Across both experiments, high load reduced the uncertainty bonus parameter ({varphi}), indicating weaker directed exploration. Experiment 2 additionally showed lower inverse temperature ({beta}) under high load, indicating more stochastic choices. Directed exploration relative to exploitation more activated the frontopolar cortex (FP), intraparietal sulcus (IPS), anterior insula (aIns), and dorsal anterior cingulate cortex (dACC). Psychophysiological interaction (PPI) analyses indicated stronger functional coupling between the right aIns and IPS under low load. Guided by the candidate connections identified by PPI, dynamic causal modeling (DCM) focused on a three-region subnetwork. Bayesian model selection favored the model with directed-exploration-related input to the IPS, while condition-specific comparisons suggested stronger aIns-to-IPS effective connectivity under low load. Together, these findings link cognitive resource demands to reduced uncertainty-guided directed exploration in a dynamic environment and suggest that this behavioral change is accompanied by selective reconfiguration of interactions within an IPS-centered decision subnetwork.
items.abstract_zh: 在奖励不断变化的动态环境中，自适应决策需要对选项价值和不确定性估计进行持续更新，以平衡探索与利用。这一过程依赖认知资源，并涉及多个脑区之间的协调交互；然而，认知负荷如何影响此类动态环境中的定向探索，以及这些影响是否伴随探索相关脑区之间交互的变化，仍不清楚。我们在动态四臂老虎机任务中嵌入了一个工作记忆负荷操纵。实验1比较了计算模型，并量化了与负荷相关的探索变化；实验2在一个独立样本中检验了这些行为效应，并使用 fMRI 研究了其神经关联。在两个实验中，高负荷降低了不确定性奖励参数（{varphi}），表明定向探索减弱。实验2还显示，高负荷下逆温度（{beta}）更低，表明选择更具随机性。相对于利用，定向探索更多地激活了额极皮层（FP）、顶内沟（IPS）、前岛叶（aIns）和背侧前扣带皮层（dACC）。心理生理交互（PPI）分析表明，在低负荷下右侧 aIns 与 IPS 之间的功能耦合更强。在 PPI 识别出的候选连接的指导下，动态因果建模（DCM）聚焦于一个三区域子网络。贝叶斯模型选择更支持带有与定向探索相关输入到 IPS 的模型，而条件特异性比较表明，在低负荷下 aIns 到 IPS 的有效连接更强。总之，这些发现将认知资源需求与动态环境中不确定性引导的定向探索减少联系起来，并表明这种行为变化伴随着以 IPS 为中心的决策子网络内交互的选择性重构。

items.title_en: Localized Strain Tuning of Second-Harmonic Generation in MoS2 Monolayers and Bilayers
items.title_zh: MoS2单层和双层中二次谐波产生的局域应变调谐
items.abstract_en: We investigate the modulation of second-harmonic generation (SHG) in CVD-grown MoS2 monolayers and few-layer flakes through localized mechanical deformation applied by an atomic force microscope (AFM) tip. MoS2 membranes suspended over microstructured Si3N4 substrates allow simultaneous measurements of force and SHG intensity during controlled approach and retraction cycles. Suspended regions exhibit enhanced SHG relative to substrate-supported regions, with pronounced suppression near the clamping boundaries. While the SHG response during compressive loading varies among individual membranes, adhesion-mediated pulling during retraction consistently reduces the SHG intensity until tip detachment, when the signal recovers. By correlating the optical modulation with the measured pull-off force and a phenomenological estimate of effective strain, we obtain a characteristic sensitivity of approximately 12% SHG modulation per 1% effective strain, with comparable behavior in monolayers and bilayers. These findings reveal adhesion-mediated mechanical deformation as a distinct and reversible mechanism for controlling nonlinear optical emission in atomically thin membranes.
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究通过原子力显微镜（AFM）针尖施加局域机械变形，对CVD生长的MoS2单层和少层薄片中的二次谐波产生（SHG）进行调制。悬浮在微结构Si3N4衬底上的MoS2膜可在受控接近和回撤循环中同时测量力和SHG强度。与衬底支撑区域相比，悬浮区域表现出增强的SHG，而在夹持边界附近有明显抑制。尽管压缩加载期间的SHG响应在不同膜之间有所变化，但回撤期间由粘附介导的拉拽会持续降低SHG强度，直到针尖脱离时信号恢复。通过将光学调制与测得的拉脱力及有效应变的现象学估计相关联，我们获得约每1%有效应变引起12% SHG调制的特征灵敏度，单层和双层中的行为相当。这些发现揭示，粘附介导的机械变形是控制原子级薄膜中非线性光发射的一种独特且可逆的机制。

items.title_en: A General Non-Stationary Channel Model for Autonomous Vehicle Communications in Underground Spaces
items.title_zh: 地下空间中自动驾驶车辆通信的通用非平稳信道模型
items.abstract_en: Autonomous vehicles exhibit high mobility and environmental adaptability, making them well-suited for underground inspection and rescue missions. In this paper, a general three-dimensional (3D) non-stationary geometry-based stochastic model (GBSM) is proposed for autonomous vehicle communications in underground spaces. The proposed channel model accounts for the 3D mobility of autonomous vehicles and can be adapted to pillar, tunnel, and cave scenarios. To characterize the structural and physical features of underground spaces, the proposed model incorporates the generation and evolution of spatially dispersed and/or directionally confined clusters along with their constituent specular/dense multipath components (SMCs/DMCs). Additionally, the proposed channel model considers channel non-stationarity, waveguide effect, and near-field/far-field effects. Statistical properties, including space-time-frequency correlation functions (STF-CFs), delay/angular/Doppler power spectral densities (PSDs), root mean square (RMS) delay spread, and stationary interval, are derived and analyzed. The validity of the proposed channel model is substantiated through comparative analysis between measurement and simulation results.
items.abstract_zh: 自动驾驶车辆具有高机动性和环境适应性，使其非常适合地下巡检与救援任务。本文提出一种用于地下空间中自动驾驶车辆通信的通用三维（3D）非平稳几何随机模型（GBSM）。所提出的信道模型考虑了自动驾驶车辆的3D移动性，并可适配矿柱、隧道和洞穴场景。为表征地下空间的结构和物理特征，所提模型纳入了空间分散和/或方向受限簇及其组成成分——镜面/密集多径分量（SMC/DMC）的生成与演化。此外，所提出的信道模型考虑了信道非平稳性、波导效应以及近场/远场效应。推导并分析了统计特性，包括空时频相关函数（STF-CF）、时延/角度/多普勒功率谱密度（PSD）、均方根（RMS）时延扩展和平稳间隔。通过测量与仿真结果的对比分析，证实了所提信道模型的有效性。

items.title_en: Twice-Told Critiques: Claim-Level Homogenization of Peer Review in the LLM Era
items.title_zh: 重复讲述的批评：LLM时代同行评审在论断层面的同质化
items.abstract_en: Peer review relies on several readers finding different problems. We measure critique overlap in conference and journal reviews. At ICLR, measured overlap rose from 12.0% in 2026 to 21.3% in 2027, in reviews from the same stage of the review process, with year-on-year rises at NeurIPS, ICML and the F1000 and PLOS journals. A third ICLR review of a paper added 5.46 new problems to the other two in 2027, against 6.12 in 2026. We apply MELD, a detector of LLM-generated text, to all reviews. Within a paper, two reviews that MELD flags overlap more than two unflagged reviews: by 3.0 points at ICLR in 2024-2025, by 4.5 points in 2026-2027, and by 5.4 points across five journal sources. These results provide evidence that LLM-flagged reviews of one paper are less distinct from each other than unflagged reviews, and suggest that the diversity of critiques among reviews of a single paper is falling.
items.abstract_zh: 同行评审依赖于多位读者发现不同的问题。我们测量会议和期刊评审中的批评重叠。在ICLR，来自同一评审阶段的评审中，测得重叠从2026年的12.0%上升到2027年的21.3%，NeurIPS、ICML以及F1000和PLOS期刊也出现逐年上升。2027年，对一篇论文的第三篇ICLR评审相较另外两篇增加了5.46个新问题，而2026年为6.12个。我们将LLM生成文本检测器MELD应用于所有评审。在一篇论文内，两篇被MELD标记的评审比两篇未被标记的评审重叠更多：2024-2025年ICLR高3.0个百分点，2026-2027年高4.5个百分点，五个期刊来源中高5.4个百分点。这些结果为以下观点提供了证据：同一论文中被LLM标记的评审彼此之间不如未被标记的评审那样有区分度，并表明单篇论文各评审之间批评的多样性正在下降。

items.title_en: One Policy, Many Bodies: Cooperative Human-Object Interaction with Heterogeneous Teams
items.title_zh: 一个策略，多种身体：异构团队中的协作式人-物交互
items.abstract_en: Physics-based human-object interaction (HOI) has enabled multiple characters to cooperatively transport objects, but existing cooperative controllers largely assume homogeneous embodiments and predefined interaction tasks. We ask whether a single physics-based policy can enable cooperation across diverse embodiments, team compositions, and interaction skills. We present MorphHOI, a decentralised framework built on a key insight: effective heterogeneous cooperation requires a unified representation across embodiments while accounting for differences in their physical capabilities. To realise this insight, we introduce a canonical body interface that unifies observation and action spaces, together with an embodiment-conditioned transformer that adapts cooperative decisions to the physical capabilities of each agent and its teammates. To extend cooperation to new interaction skills, we reuse the learned cooperative policy through task-specific tokens and lightweight adaptation, preserving its original capabilities. Our framework achieves success rates of up to 96.7\% on seen embodiments, 95.6\% on unseen embodiments, and 91.4\% on novel payloads. Furthermore, the learned cooperation extends to diverse interaction skills with high success rates, including box carrying, transport on stairs, and waypoint following, while preserving previously acquired cooperative capabilities.
items.abstract_zh: 基于物理的人-物交互（HOI）已使多个角色能够协作搬运物体，但现有协作控制器在很大程度上假设同质具身和预定义交互任务。我们问：单一基于物理的策略能否在多样具身、团队组成和交互技能之间实现合作。我们提出MorphHOI，一个去中心化框架，其基于一个关键洞见：有效的异构合作需要跨具身的统一表示，同时考虑其物理能力的差异。为实现这一洞见，我们引入统一观测和动作空间的规范化身体接口，以及一个以具身为条件的Transformer，将合作决策适配到每个智能体及其队友的物理能力。为将合作扩展到新交互技能，我们通过任务特定token和轻量级适应复用已学习的合作策略，同时保留其原始能力。我们的框架在已见具身上达到高达96.7%的成功率，在未见具身上达到95.6%，在新载荷上达到91.4%。此外，学习到的合作可扩展到多样交互技能并具有高成功率，包括搬运箱子、在楼梯上运输和路径点跟随，同时保留先前获得的合作能力。

items.title_en: Field-Level Crop Classification via Similarity-Induced Supervision from Imperfect Labels
items.title_zh: 基于不完美标签的相似性诱导监督的田块级作物分类
items.abstract_en: Regional-scale crop mapping is critical for food production monitoring, yet remains challenging in tropical regions, where persistent cloud cover limits optical imagery. Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) enables continuous observation throughout the agricultural cycle, but a second obstacle is label quality: national-scale land cover products exhibit systematic biases that underestimate less prevalent crops, and training directly on them inherits and amplifies their errors. This work proposes a methodology to build large-scale crop classification models from imperfect public land cover products, requiring no new field campaign, ground survey, or manual label correction. The approach combines two mechanisms. The first reduces the semantic inconsistency of the labels by shifting supervision from the sample level to the group level: a similarity-based clustering model organizes SAR time series into coherent groups, and noisy labels are used only to assign each group its most representative class. The resulting clusters are highly pure with respect to the reference classes (89.0% and 91.2% in the two study regions). The second reduces the spatial inconsistency of the predictions: a segmentation model delineates crop field boundaries from optical imagery, and patch-level predictions are consolidated by majority voting within each field, yielding spatially coherent maps. Evaluated in two Brazilian municipalities, Campo Verde (Mato Grosso) and Luís Eduardo Magalhães (Bahia), the approach consistently outperforms the noisy baseline in mean class accuracy, with gains of up to 10.14 percentage points, especially for minority crops. A state-scale analysis across Mato Grosso and Bahia shows stable behavior without further model adjustment, and the derived municipal crop areas are consistent with official IBGE/PAM statistics, an independent estimate the model never observes.
items.abstract_zh: 区域尺度作物制图对粮食生产监测至关重要，但在热带地区仍具挑战性，因为持续云覆盖限制了光学影像。合成孔径雷达（SAR）能够在整个农业周期内进行连续观测，但第二个障碍是标签质量：全国尺度土地覆盖产品存在系统性偏差，低估了较不常见的作物，直接在其上训练会继承并放大其误差。本工作提出一种方法，利用不完美的公开土地覆盖产品构建大规模作物分类模型，无需新的野外调查、地面调查或人工标签纠正。该方法结合两种机制。第一种通过将监督从样本级转移到组级来降低标签的语义不一致性：基于相似性的聚类模型将SAR时间序列组织为连贯的组，噪声标签仅用于为每个组分配其最具代表性的类别。所得聚类相对于参考类别具有高纯度（在两个研究区域分别为89.0%和91.2%）。第二种降低预测的空间不一致性：分割模型从光学影像中勾绘作物田块边界，并通过每个田块内的多数投票合并斑块级预测，从而生成空间连贯的图。在两个巴西市镇——Campo Verde（马托格罗索州）和Luís Eduardo Magalhães（巴伊亚州）——评估时，该方法在平均类别精度上始终优于噪声基线，提升最高达10.14个百分点，尤其是对少数作物。跨马托格罗索州和巴伊亚州的州级分析显示，在无需进一步模型调整的情况下表现稳定，且导出的市级作物面积与官方IBGE/PAM统计数据一致，而这是模型从未观测到的独立估计。

items.title_en: Individualized Atypicality of Structure-Function Configuration Marks Subthreshold Depression in Adolescents
items.title_zh: 结构-功能配置的个体化非典型性标记青少年阈下抑郁
items.abstract_en: Background: Subthreshold depression (StD) in adolescence represents a critical state preceding major depressive disorder, yet its neurobiological substrates remain poorly characterized. Conventional structure-function coupling rely on DTI tractography, which produces non-isomorphic matrices and unstable single-subject estimates, limiting their clinical utility. We developed a novel isomorphic and multi-omics framework to quantify individualized structure-function configurations and tested whether adolescents with StD show reproducible deviations from a group-mean reference in a validation sample. Methods: We integrated five structural (cortical thickness, mean curvature, sulcal depth, fractional anisotropy, mean diffusivity) and five functional (ReHo, ALFF, CBF, local and global connectivity strength) features to construct regional SIND-FIND configurations using symmetric KL divergence in a discovery-validation design (N = 131). Individual typicality scores were defined as the correspondence between each participant's regional configuration profile and HC reference (Leave one out). The score has undergone parallel validations using conventional SC-FC coupling, molecular alignment (PET/AHBA), and behavioral correlations. Results: Group-mean configuration maps were spatially correlated across samples ({rho} = .93, pspin < .001). StD participants showed lower typicality than HC (F(1,94) = 8.73, p = .004); the conventional SC-FC comparison was not significant (F(1,92) = 3.31, p = .072). Regional differences involved frontoparietal and salience regions and aligned with PET (r = .55, pspin < .001) and AHBA (r = .47, pspin = .003) maps. After covariate adjustment, typicality correlated with SCL-90 ({rho} = -.262, q = .013), SDS ({rho} = -.234, q = .022), ISI ({rho} = -.296, q = .012) and PSQI ({rho} = -.288, q = .012; BH-FDR across five scales); coupling tracked depressive but not sleep symptoms (ISI {rho} = -.161, q = .124). Within validation StD participants, SCL-90 remained negatively associated with typicality ({rho} = -.42, p = .023). Conclusion: Our isomorphic, multimodal framework captures coordinated structures-function deviation in adolescent StD with greater group-effect sensitivity than conventional SC-FC coupling, together with regional specificity, molecular spatial alignment, and behavioral relevance. Configuration typicality, defined relative to an HC group-mean reference, may serve as an individual-level marker of organizational deviation during adolescence, pending larger, demographic stratified samples.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：青少年阈下抑郁（StD）是重性抑郁障碍之前的关键状态，但其神经生物学基础仍表征不足。传统结构-功能耦合依赖DTI纤维束追踪，会产生非同构矩阵和不稳定的单被试估计，限制其临床效用。我们开发了一种新的同构、多组学框架来量化个体化结构-功能配置，并在验证样本中检验StD青少年是否表现出相对于组均值参考的可重复偏差。方法：我们整合五个结构特征（皮质厚度、平均曲率、沟深、各向异性分数、平均扩散率）和五个功能特征（ReHo、ALFF、CBF、局部和全局连接强度），在发现-验证设计（N=131）中使用对称KL散度构建区域SIND-FIND配置。个体典型性得分定义为每名参与者的区域配置轮廓与健康对照（HC）参考之间的对应关系（留一法）。该得分已使用传统SC-FC耦合、分子空间对齐（PET/AHBA）和行为相关进行平行验证。结果：组均值配置图在样本间空间相关（ρ=.93，pspin<.001）。StD参与者的典型性低于HC（F(1,94)=8.73，p=.004）；传统SC-FC比较不显著（F(1,92)=3.31，p=.072）。区域差异涉及额顶和突显区域，并与PET（r=.55，pspin<.001）和AHBA（r=.47，pspin=.003）图谱对齐。协变量调整后，典型性与SCL-90（ρ=-.262，q=.013）、SDS（ρ=-.234，q=.022）、ISI（ρ=-.296，q=.012）和PSQI（ρ=-.288，q=.012；五个量表采用BH-FDR）相关；耦合跟踪抑郁症状而非睡眠症状（ISI ρ=-.161，q=.124）。在验证集StD参与者中，SCL-90仍与典型性负相关（ρ=-.42，p=.023）。结论：我们的同构多模态框架捕捉了青少年StD中协调的结构-功能偏差，比传统SC-FC耦合具有更高的组效应敏感性，并具有区域特异性、分子空间对齐和行为相关性。相对于HC组均值参考定义的配置典型性，可能作为青少年组织偏差的个体水平标志物，尚待更大规模、按人口学分层的样本验证。

items.title_en: Reducing RSA-2048 Factoring Resources Below One Billion Toffolis via LLM-Driven Verifiable Quantum Compilation
items.title_zh: 通过LLM驱动的可验证量子编译将RSA-2048分解资源降至十亿Toffoli门以下
items.abstract_en: Modular exponentiation dominates the logical cost of factoring 2048-bit RSA integers (RSA-2048) with Shor's algorithm. Recent approaches based on approximate residue number systems (RNS) sharply reduce the required logical qubits, yet still demand billions of Toffoli gates. Optimizing these circuits is difficult because shared ancilla qubits and measurement-based uncomputation tightly couple the arithmetic stages, while rare overflows in compressed registers occur too infrequently for random simulation to detect. Here we use large language model (LLM)-driven search to redesign the RNS pipeline across stages and build a deterministic compiler that produces a Pareto frontier of RSA-2048 circuits. We bound rare overflow probabilities analytically and verify the resulting elementary gate sequences across all constituent RNS primes on representative circuits. Relative to Gidney's 2025 baseline under matched adder accounting, our frontier cuts the minimum qubit-Toffoli product by 70.1% and lowers expected factoring Toffolis by up to 78.6% at matched accumulator precision, bringing RSA-2048 factoring below one billion Toffolis for the first time.
items.abstract_zh: 模幂运算主导了使用Shor算法分解2048位RSA整数（RSA-2048）的逻辑成本。近期基于近似余数系统（RNS）的方法大幅减少了所需逻辑量子比特，但仍需要数十亿个Toffoli门。优化这些电路很困难，因为共享辅助量子比特和基于测量的逆计算紧密耦合了算术阶段，而压缩寄存器中的罕见溢出发生得过于稀少，随机模拟难以检测。在这里，我们使用大语言模型（LLM）驱动的搜索来跨阶段重新设计RNS流水线，并构建一个确定性编译器，生成RSA-2048电路的Pareto前沿。我们解析地界定罕见溢出概率，并在代表性电路上验证所有组成RNS素数上的所得基本门序列。相对于在匹配加法器核算下的Gidney 2025基线，我们的前沿将最小量子比特-Toffoli乘积降低70.1%，并在匹配累加器精度下将预期分解Toffoli数降低最多78.6%，首次将RSA-2048分解降至十亿Toffoli以下。

items.title_en: Passivity Correction of the Thermistor Model in Bolometric Power Sensors and Its Dependence on Bead Temperature
items.title_zh: 辐射热式功率传感器中热敏电阻模型的无源性校正及其对珠温的依赖性
items.abstract_en: This paper closes a series of works on thermistor bolometric power sensors, coaxial and waveguide, by treating what the two have in common. The per-state transformation m introduced in the waveguide work, which corrects the thermistor impedances of the model in each bridge state so that the two-port of the mount is passive, is analyzed on the eleven sensors of the preceding papers: the corrections are a few tenths of a percent in the coaxial mounts and one to two percent in the waveguide mounts, follow one pattern within each family, and the hottest state is the one whose efficiency departs most from the others. The transformation is tested by an independent measurement: the substituted powers of the three states, read with the manufacturer's procedure against a leveled source whose reflection is obtained from the closure of three Apollonius circles, give efficiency ratios of 0.999 +/- 0.016 and 0.997 +/- 0.008 (k = 2), which contain the values at the passivity floor (0.996, 0.998) and exclude those of the first pass (0.941, 1.023). Three sensors were swept in the bridge resistance, 23 and 31 states, and a fourth is treated apart: the correction reduces to one constant per state, the parallel resistance of the bead, represented by a law with one term scaling with the bridge resistance and one exponential in the bead temperature, with one thermal coefficient per family. The same property explains why the cross-ratio of four measured reflection coefficients, invariant under any state-independent two-port, departs from that of the four bridge resistances.
items.abstract_zh: 本文通过处理同轴和波导两类热敏电阻辐射热式功率传感器的共同点，结束了关于它们的一系列工作。在波导工作中引入的逐状态变换m，用于校正每个桥状态下模型的热敏电阻阻抗，使安装座的双端口为无源的；我们在前文论文的十一个传感器上分析了该变换：在同轴安装座中校正量为百分之零点几，在波导安装座中为百分之一到二，且在每个系列内遵循一种模式，最热状态是其效率与其他状态偏离最大的状态。该变换通过一项独立测量进行检验：按照制造商程序，对经电平校准的源读取三个状态的替代功率，该源的反射由三个阿波罗尼斯圆的闭合获得，给出的效率比为0.999 ± 0.016和0.997 ± 0.008（k=2），这些区间包含无源性下限处的值（0.996，0.998），并排除了第一轮的值（0.941，1.023）。对三个传感器在桥电阻方面进行了扫描，分别为23个和31个状态，第四个则单独处理：校正简化为每个状态一个常数，即珠体的并联电阻，由一项随桥电阻缩放的项和一项珠温指数项构成的规律表示，每个系列有一个热系数。同一性质解释了为什么四个测得反射系数的交比——在任何与状态无关的双端口下不变——会偏离四个桥电阻的交比。

items.title_en: CART: Clustering-based Analysis of Recurring narratives for Taxonomy construction
items.title_zh: CART：基于聚类的重复叙事分析用于分类体系构建
items.abstract_en: We present CART, a computational pipeline for extracting political narratives from parliamentary discourse and organizing them into a data-driven taxonomy without relying on predefined narrative categories. It encodes parliamentary discourse using semantic representations, filters relevant and reliable content through unsupervised confidence estimation, extracts narrative statements using LLMs, and uses narrative clustering and cluster analysis to construct a narrative taxonomy. Applied to Greek Parliament proceedings surrounding the 2023 Tempi train crash, it identifies ten recurring narrative families concerning responsibility attribution, institutional failure, railway safety, accountability, privatization, and the political interpretation of the tragedy. Our results demonstrate how combining unsupervised learning with LLM narrative extraction enables large parliamentary corpora to be transformed into interpretable, data-driven taxonomies of political narratives.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出CART，一种计算流水线，用于从议会话语中提取政治叙事，并将其组织为数据驱动的分类体系，而不依赖预定义的叙事类别。它使用语义表示对议会话语进行编码，通过无监督置信度估计过滤相关且可靠的内容，使用LLM提取叙事陈述，并使用叙事聚类和聚类分析构建叙事分类体系。应用于围绕2023年Tempi火车事故的希腊议会会议记录，它识别出十个反复出现的叙事族，涉及责任归属、制度失败、铁路安全、问责、私有化以及对这一悲剧的政治解读。我们的结果表明，将无监督学习与LLM叙事提取相结合，能够将大型议会语料转化为可解释、数据驱动的政治叙事分类体系。

items.title_en: Calibrating World Action Models: From Adaptive System 2 Takeover to Self-Evolution
items.title_zh: 校准世界动作模型：从自适应System 2接管到自我进化
items.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) deliver fast visuomotor control, yet degrade sharply in challenging scenes and act blindly when about to fail; conversely, foundation-model-based agents generalize and recover reliably, but incur prohibitive latency and cost when queried at every step. To achieve both WAM (System 1)-level speed and agent (System 2)-level reliability--- we propose \textbf{\oursfull (\ours)}, a framework that calibrates WAMs' confidence--- adaptively triggering System~2 only when necessary, and distilling System~2's knowledge to form an evolving System~1. First, \ours equips a frozen WAM with \textbf{calibrated self-assessment}: a single lightweight judgment token reading internal video--action features is trained via our proposed \textbf{cross-fitted temporal-difference (TD) learning} using only binary rollout success/failure signals. It can predict a \textbf{calibrated success probability} at negligible overhead without affecting action predictions. Second, this calibrated success probability schedules control chunk by chunk---invoking System~2 to resolve bottlenecks when confidence drops, and handing control back to the WAM once confidence recovers, preserving WAM-like speed while approaching System~2 reliability. Third, as System~2 intervenes only when the WAM lacks confidence, its takeover trajectories directly capture the WAM's capability gaps. JiL distills these takeovers into the WAM to repair those gaps so System~1 can operate standalone without System~2 at test time, while our mastered-skill anchoring and dynamic confidence gating prevent degrading existing capabilities.
items.abstract_zh: 世界动作模型（WAM）提供快速的视觉运动控制，但在挑战性场景中性能急剧下降，并在即将失败时盲目行动；相反，基于基础模型的智能体能够泛化并可靠恢复，但每一步查询都会带来过高的延迟和成本。为了实现WAM（System 1）级速度和智能体（System 2）级可靠性，我们提出 \oursfull (\ours)，一个校准WAM置信度的框架——仅在必要时自适应触发System 2，并蒸馏System 2的知识以形成不断进化的System 1。首先，\ours 为冻结的WAM配备 \textbf{校准自评估}：一个读取内部视频—动作特征的轻量级判断token，通过我们提出的 \textbf{交叉拟合时序差分（TD）学习} 训练，仅使用二元的rollout成功/失败信号。它能够以可忽略的开销预测 \textbf{校准成功概率}，且不影响动作预测。其次，该校准成功概率逐块调度控制——当置信度下降时调用System 2以解决瓶颈，并在置信度恢复后将控制交还给WAM，从而保持类WAM速度，同时接近System 2可靠性。第三，由于System 2仅在WAM缺乏置信度时介入，其接管轨迹直接捕获WAM的能力差距。JiL将这些接管蒸馏到WAM中以修复这些差距，使System 1在测试时能够在没有System 2的情况下独立运行，而我们掌握的技能锚定和动态置信度门控可防止现有能力退化。

items.title_en: RigidAnchor: Cross-View Geo-Localization for UAV via Iterative Planar Rigid Alignment
items.title_zh: RigidAnchor：通过迭代平面刚性对齐的无人机跨视角地理定位
items.abstract_en: A UAV that flies without GNSS has to estimate its absolute position and heading without any external signal. Most existing methods for UAV-to-satellite cross-view geo-localization (U-S CVGL) treat the task as image retrieval: they compress the UAV image and each satellite tile into separate descriptors, rank the tiles by their similarity, and return the center of the best tile. The output can therefore only lie on a pre-defined grid, its accuracy is limited by the tile size, and no heading is produced. Regressing the pose in a single pass removes the grid, but it leaves no chance to correct the estimate afterwards. We observe that satellite tiles are not independent samples. They are laid on the map at a fixed spacing, scale and orientation, so neighboring tiles join into one continuous satellite block with a consistent metric, and a nadir UAV view of that block differs from it by a planar rigid transform only, i.e. a 2D translation plus an in-plane rotation. We therefore reformulate U-S CVGL as solving for this transform between two images of different sizes. Position and heading then become parts of one geometric quantity, and the accuracy is no longer limited by the tile grid. We propose RigidAnchor, which solves the transform iteratively. The network encodes the two images and builds a multi-level correlation pyramid between them. At each iteration, it indexes the pyramid with every aerial cell carried through the current estimate, pools the descriptors of all cells into one hidden state, and lets two decoupled heads predict a translation increment and a rotation increment, the latter being composed rather than added. On Bearing-UAV-90K, the cross-view mean errors are 78.6% lower in position and 69.7% lower in heading than Bearing-UAV, and HSR@15 increases by 19.06 points. Code is available at https://github.com/wwsource/RigidAnchor.
items.abstract_zh: 在没有GNSS的情况下飞行的无人机必须在没有任何外部信号的情况下估计其绝对位置和航向。大多数现有的无人机到卫星跨视角地理定位（U-S CVGL）方法将该任务视为图像检索：它们将无人机图像和每个卫星瓦片压缩为单独的描述符，按相似度对瓦片排序，并返回最佳瓦片的中心。因此输出只能位于预定义网格上，其精度受瓦片大小限制，且不产生航向。单次回归位姿消除了网格，但之后没有机会纠正估计。我们观察到卫星瓦片不是独立样本。它们以固定间距、尺度和方向铺设在地图上，因此相邻瓦片连接成一个具有一致度量的连续卫星区块，而该区块的无人机正下视视图与其仅相差一个平面刚性变换，即二维平移加上平面内旋转。因此，我们将U-S CVGL重新表述为求解两个不同尺寸图像之间的该变换。位置和航向于是成为一个几何量的一部分，精度不再受瓦片网格限制。我们提出RigidAnchor，它迭代求解该变换。该网络编码两幅图像，并在它们之间构建多级相关金字塔。在每次迭代中，它用经当前估计传递的每个空中单元索引该金字塔，将所有单元的描述符池化为一个隐藏状态，并让两个解耦头预测平移增量和旋转增量，后者是复合而非相加。在Bearing-UAV-90K上，与Bearing-UAV相比，跨视角平均误差在位置上降低78.6%，在航向上降低69.7%，HSR@15提高19.06个百分点。代码见 https://github.com/wwsource/RigidAnchor。

items.title_en: Exercise misinformation in fitness content targeted at women on Instagram and TikTok: a cross-sectional content analysis of 6,982 posts
items.title_zh: Instagram和TikTok上针对女性的健身内容中的运动错误信息：对6,982条帖子的横断面内容分析
items.abstract_en: Objectives. To quantify exercise misinformation in female targeted exercise content on Instagram and TikTok, determine whether content textually targeted at women carries higher rates of misinformation, and compare content from creators self identifying as ethnic minority with other content. Methods. Cross sectional content analysis of 6,982 posts collected March to June 2026 by manual browsing, which captured on screen and caption text, and automated collection, which captured captions only. Text was coded for claim accuracy, textual female targeting and creator characteristics, with large language model assisted coding verified against an independent human coder. Effects were estimated by logistic regression using adjustment sets from a pre specified causal diagram, with creator clustered standard errors. Results. Of 6,524 posts, 2,447 made an assessable exercise claim, of which 600 (24.5%, 95% CI 22.8 to 26.2) contained misinformation. Textually female targeted content carried more than twice the odds of misinformation compared with untargeted content (OR 2.06, 95% CI 1.58 to 2.70), particularly wholly inaccurate content. The effect was OR 4.00 (2.41 to 6.66) where on screen text was captured and 1.04 (0.73 to 1.49) where only captions were (interaction p < 0.001). Content from creators self identifying as ethnic minority carried less misinformation (OR 0.69, 95% CI 0.51 to 0.92). Conclusion. 24.5% of fitness posts making a verifiable claim contained misinformation, and content directed at women had higher rates where the full written text could be read. Posts naming a body part were most likely to be inaccurate, giving clinicians and public health communicators a teachable marker of misinformation.
items.abstract_zh: 目的。量化Instagram和TikTok上针对女性的运动内容中的运动错误信息，确定文本上针对女性的内容是否带有更高比例的错误信息，并比较自认少数族裔创作者的内容与其他内容。方法。对2026年3月至6月收集的6,982条帖子进行横断面内容分析，收集方式包括人工浏览（捕获屏幕文字和配文）以及自动化收集（仅捕获配文）。对文本按声明准确性、文本上是否针对女性以及创作者特征进行编码，其中大语言模型辅助编码并对照独立人工编码者进行验证。使用来自预设因果图的调整集，通过逻辑回归估计效应，并采用创作者聚类标准误。结果。在6,524条帖子中，2,447条提出了可评估的运动声明，其中600条（24.5%，95% CI 22.8–26.2）含有错误信息。文本上针对女性的内容含错误信息的优势比是未针对性内容的两倍以上（OR 2.06，95% CI 1.58–2.70），尤其是完全不准的内容。在捕获屏幕文字时，该效应为OR 4.00（2.41–6.66）；在仅捕获配文时为OR 1.04（0.73–1.49）（交互作用p < 0.001）。自认少数族裔创作者的内容含较少错误信息（OR 0.69，95% CI 0.51–0.92）。结论。提出可验证声明的健身帖子中有24.5%含错误信息；在可读取完整书面文本时，针对女性的内容错误率更高。提及身体部位的帖子最可能不准确，为临床医生和公共卫生传播者提供了一个可用于教学的错误信息标志。

items.title_en: Generalized dielectric-dependent hybrid functional combining Gaussian and Yukawa screening
items.title_zh: 结合高斯和Yukawa屏蔽的广义介电相关杂化泛函
items.abstract_en: We develop a generalized Coulomb-attenuated method (GCAM) for dielectric-dependent hybrid functionals that combines Gaussian and Yukawa-type screening functions to provide an accurate representation of the random-phase approximation (RPA) dielectric function. Through systematic fitting to RPA dielectric functions of semiconductors and insulators, and to the Lindhard dielectric function of the homogeneous electron gas, we demonstrate that GCAM significantly reduces errors in the model dielectric function across the full momentum range. However, despite this improved physical description of screening, band gap calculations reveal that GCAM yields larger errors compared to experiment than previous CAM approaches for wide-gap materials, but smaller errors for most narrow-gap materials. This counterintuitive result demonstrates that the success of CAM stems not purely from physical reasons, but also from a partial cancellation of errors. In contrast, for optical absorption spectra calculated within a model Bethe-Salpeter equation framework, GCAM systematically outperforms CAM, showing better agreement with the reference spectra obtained with the diagonal RPA screening in both peak positions and relative intensities. Our findings reveal the important role of error cancellation in dielectric-dependent hybrid functionals.
items.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种用于介电相关杂化泛函的广义库仑衰减方法（GCAM），它结合高斯和Yukawa型屏蔽函数，以准确表示随机相位近似（RPA）介电函数。通过对半导体和绝缘体的RPA介电函数以及均匀电子气的Lindhard介电函数进行系统拟合，我们证明GCAM在全动量范围内显著降低了模型介电函数的误差。然而，尽管对屏蔽的物理描述有所改进，带隙计算表明，对于宽禁带材料，GCAM比先前的CAM方法产生更大的实验误差，但对于大多数窄禁带材料误差更小。这一反直觉结果表明，CAM的成功并非纯属物理原因，也来自误差的部分抵消。相反，对于在模型Bethe-Salpeter方程框架内计算的光吸收光谱，GCAM系统性地优于CAM，在峰位置和相对强度上均与使用对角RPA屏蔽获得的参考光谱更一致。我们的发现揭示了误差抵消在介电相关杂化泛函中的重要作用。

items.title_en: Spiking Neural Networks Incrementally Track Firing-Rate Networks
items.title_zh: 脉冲神经网络增量跟踪放电率网络
items.abstract_en: Understanding how spiking neural networks (SNNs) efficiently process data streams is key to (i) studying how biological brains conserve energy for lifelong predictions and (ii) enabling efficient continuous AI inference. In this work, we propose a theory on how an SNN incrementally tracks its corresponding firing-rate network, a continuous-valued neural network (ANN). We prove that the output of a discrete SNN continuously tracks the instantaneous ANN output implicitly determined by the SNN input. Based on this principle, we develop LIF-Stream, a conversion framework for efficient SNN inference over unbounded data streams. It enables the converted SNN to reuse its prior activation state and compute only the activation updates between frames, thereby reducing the average number of time steps needed per frame. Specifically, LIF-Stream controls the SNN to continuously track the reference ANN output, which gives a high-accuracy prediction for every frame. Evaluation on three large-scale streaming inference benchmarks with distinct modalities shows that LIF-Stream achieves the best efficiency-accuracy trade-off compared to high-accuracy SNN techniques.
items.abstract_zh: 理解脉冲神经网络（SNN）如何高效处理数据流，是（i）研究生物大脑如何为终身预测节约能量以及（ii）实现高效连续 AI 推理的关键。在本工作中，我们提出一种关于 SNN 如何增量跟踪其对应放电率网络（一种连续值神经网络（ANN））的理论。我们证明，离散 SNN 的输出连续跟踪由 SNN 输入隐式确定的瞬时 ANN 输出。基于这一原理，我们开发了 LIF-Stream，一种用于在无界数据流上进行高效 SNN 推理的转换框架。它使转换后的 SNN 能够复用其先前的激活状态，并且仅计算帧间的激活更新，从而减少每帧所需的平均时间步数。具体而言，LIF-Stream 控制 SNN 连续跟踪参考 ANN 输出，从而为每一帧给出高精度预测。在具有不同模态的三个大规模流式推理基准上的评估表明，与高精度 SNN 技术相比，LIF-Stream 实现了最佳效率-精度权衡。

items.title_en: Detectable Epistemic Attack Layers: A Coverage Theorem and Standardized Harness for Conversation-History Integrity
items.title_zh: 可检测的认知攻击层：面向对话历史完整性的覆盖定理与标准化测试框架
items.abstract_en: Conversation history is infrastructure: deployed language models rely on application layers to store and reinject prior turns, and that stored state is writable. We formalize session-level contamination by attack layer, state a coverage theorem, and measure its scope: each deployment-layer verification tier covers exactly its layer and is sound with respect to the others; instruction overrides are not detectable without false positives; and composite vectors evade per-fragment verification. A standardized harness applied to eight mechanism families across 3,249 sessions and three model families makes these claims checkable. First, pattern-based detection pays a measured false-positive price: the classic defenses flag 35 to 50 percent of benign sessions, and the naive refusal floor reaches only 2.4 percent attack-cell adoption while destroying 33 to 100 percent of benign turns, whereas provenance-gated channel separation achieves adoption at or below 1.2 percent with zero false positives and zero utility loss. Second, in the exploratory instruction-override extension, the gates' boundary is a cliff: directives rephrased without shape markers bypass them at control-equivalent rates, 47.7 to 49.5 percent against 0.0 percent for the shaped class, placing that class in the model-internal lane. Third, the deterministic core is storage-layer detection at 126 of 126 per model with zero false positives. External anchors reproduce published attack pressure, with PoisonedRAG falling from 70 to 0 percent under the full stack. For practitioners: authenticate stored history and content provenance with deterministic tiers, scope instruction-layer mitigation to provenance-gated designs whose measured benign cost is zero, and monitor composition at the trajectory level rather than per fragment. All protocols and acceptance criteria are pre-registered; the stack and harness are released.
items.abstract_zh: 对话历史是基础设施：已部署的语言模型依赖应用层存储并重新注入先前轮次，而存储状态是可写的。我们按攻击层形式化会话级污染，陈述一个覆盖定理，并测量其范围：每个部署层验证层级恰好覆盖其所在层，且对其他层是可靠的；指令覆盖在没有误报的情况下不可检测；复合向量可规避逐片段验证。一个标准化测试框架应用于八个机制家族、3,249个会话和三个模型家族，使这些主张可检验。第一，基于模式的检测付出可测量的误报代价：经典防御标记35%至50%的良性会话，而朴素拒答下限仅达到2.4%的攻击单元采纳率，同时破坏33%至100%的良性轮次，而来源门控的通道分离在零误报和零效用损失下达到1.2%或更低的采纳率。第二，在探索性指令覆盖扩展中，门控的边界是一道悬崖：不带形状标记改写的指令以与控制等效的比率绕过它们，为47.7%至49.5%，而有形状类别为0.0%，将该类别置于模型内部通道。第三，确定性核心是存储层检测，每个模型126/126，零误报。外部锚点复现已发表的攻击压力，PoisonedRAG在完整堆栈下从70%降至0%。对实践者：使用确定性层级对存储历史和内容来源进行认证，将指令层缓解限定为经测量良性代价为零的来源门控设计，并在轨迹层面而非逐片段监控组合。所有协议和接受标准均已预注册；堆栈和测试框架已发布。

items.title_en: PushMimic: Learning Adaptive Humanoid Box Pushing via Dynamic Motion Augmentation and Reference Distillation
items.title_zh: PushMimic：通过动态运动增强与参考蒸馏学习自适应人形机器人推箱
items.abstract_en: Humanoid box pushing is challenging when the physical properties of the task, such as the box mass and the ramp inclination, are unknown before the push begins. This paper presents PushMimic, a framework that learns adaptive humanoid box pushing from a single level-ground kinematic reference motion. The learned policy adapts its pushing posture to these properties without observing them. PushMimic augments the reference motion into a dynamically feasible motion dataset over these properties with sampling-based trajectory optimization, and distills the dataset into one motion tracking policy in one stage of training. Simulation results over box masses from 5 to 15 kg and ramp inclinations up to 15 degrees show that PushMimic raises the success rate from 57.8% to 88.8% compared with a baseline that tracks the original reference motion. It also reduces the cost of push of the arms by 22%. Hardware experiments on a Unitree G1 humanoid show that the policy adapts its torso pitch during continuous pushing on an inclined treadmill, with box masses up to 19 kg and ramp inclinations up to 12.6 degrees. PushMimic therefore needs only one reference motion, instead of one for every box mass and ramp inclination.
items.abstract_zh: 当任务的物理属性（如箱体质量和斜坡倾角）在推动开始前未知时，人形机器人推箱具有挑战性。本文提出 PushMimic，一个从单一平地运动学参考运动学习自适应人形机器人推箱的框架。学习到的策略使推动姿态适应这些属性，而无需观察它们。PushMimic 通过基于采样的轨迹优化，将参考运动增强为在这些属性上动态可行的运动数据集，并在一个训练阶段将数据集蒸馏为一个运动跟踪策略。在箱体质量5至15 kg、斜坡倾角最高15度的仿真结果表明，与跟踪原始参考运动的基线相比，PushMimic 将成功率从57.8%提高到88.8%。它还将手臂推动成本降低22%。在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的硬件实验表明，该策略在倾斜跑步机上连续推动时调整其躯干俯仰，箱体质量最高19 kg，斜坡倾角最高12.6度。因此，PushMimic 仅需一个参考运动，而不是为每个箱体质量和斜坡倾角各需一个。

items.title_en: Receptor Abundance Alone Underpredicts Red Blood Cell Adhesion in Gaucher Disease
items.title_zh: 仅凭受体丰度会低估戈谢病中的红细胞黏附
items.abstract_en: Red blood cells (RBCs) in Gaucher disease (GD) adhere abnormally to vessel walls and carry more Lutheran/basal cell adhesion molecule (Lu/BCAM), a laminin receptor. Whether receptor abundance sets this adhesion is untested. We simulated RBCs carrying stochastic Lu/BCAM-laminin bonds, calibrated a population on control donors, and predicted GD adhesion from the 1.3-fold receptor rise. On laminin and endothelium the data exceed the prediction 1.6- to 1.7-fold. Matching them requires 2.4- and 4.6-fold more binding-competent receptors, compatible with the estimated 5.7-fold rise in phosphorylated receptors. Neither a stiffer membrane nor higher bond affinity removes the shortfall at high shear stress. In sickle cell disease, given active-receptor counts, the model predicts the fall in adhesion under hydroxyurea within 1.4-fold, while total receptors rise. Adhesion likely follows receptor state more than abundance. Stiffening instead retains cells at a splenic slit.
items.abstract_zh: 戈谢病（GD）中的红细胞（RBC）异常黏附于血管壁，并携带更多 Lutheran/基底细胞黏附分子（Lu/BCAM），一种层粘连蛋白受体。受体丰度是否决定这种黏附尚未经过检验。我们模拟了携带随机 Lu/BCAM-层粘连蛋白键的红细胞，在对照供者上校准了一个群体，并根据受体升高 1.3 倍预测 GD 黏附。在层粘连蛋白和内皮上，数据超出预测 1.6 至 1.7 倍。要使数据匹配，需要多 2.4 倍和 4.6 倍的具有结合能力的受体，这与磷酸化受体估计升高 5.7 倍相符。更硬的膜或更高的键亲和力均不能消除高剪切应力下的差距。在镰状细胞病中，给定活性受体计数，模型对羟基脲治疗下黏附下降的预测误差在 1.4 倍以内，而总受体升高。黏附可能更多取决于受体状态而非丰度。相反，硬化会使细胞滞留在脾裂隙处。

items.title_en: STREAM: Sequential Transformer for Risk Estimation from Asynchronous Medical Events for Dynamic Postoperative AKI Prediction
items.title_zh: STREAM：用于从异步医疗事件进行风险估计以动态预测术后 AKI 的序列 Transformer
items.abstract_en: Postoperative acute kidney injury (PO-AKI) risk estimates evolve as clinical information accumulates, yet many electronic health record (EHR) models use static or fixed-window representations. We developed STREAM, a perioperative event-stream Transformer that represents irregular EHR data as chronological clinical events and supports surgery-index prediction at surgery completion and event-by-event postoperative AKI prediction. In a retrospective cohort of 167,078 noncardiac surgical episodes, STREAM achieved surgery-index AUROC/AUPRC of 0.942/0.771, the Time-series Transformer 0.933/0.729, and GRU-D 0.926/0.695. Postoperative macro-AUPRC across 6-hour evaluation intervals was 0.589, 0.525, and 0.547, respectively. STREAM showed more consistent calibration across postoperative time points than the comparators. Event-arrival attribution and within-window permutation analysis enabled event-level interpretation of how newly arrived information and fine-grained event ordering shaped evolving risk estimates. These findings support event-stream modeling as an interpretable framework for dynamic, temporally resolved prediction from longitudinal EHR data as well as a potential risk-estimation component for future perioperative digital twins.
items.abstract_zh: 术后急性肾损伤（PO-AKI）风险估计随着临床信息积累而演变，然而许多电子健康记录（EHR）模型使用静态或固定窗口表示。我们开发了 STREAM，一种围手术期事件流 Transformer，将不规则 EHR 数据表示为按时间顺序的临床事件，并支持在手术完成时进行手术索引预测以及逐事件进行术后 AKI 预测。在167,078例非心脏手术病例的回顾性队列中，STREAM 的手术索引 AUROC/AUPRC 为0.942/0.771，Time-series Transformer 为0.933/0.729，GRU-D 为0.926/0.695。跨6小时评估区间的术后宏平均 AUPRC 分别为0.589、0.525和0.547。与比较模型相比，STREAM 在术后各时间点表现出更一致的校准。事件到达归因和窗口内置换分析使得能够在事件层面解释新到达的信息和细粒度事件排序如何塑造演变中的风险估计。这些发现支持事件流建模作为一种可解释框架，用于从纵向 EHR 数据进行动态、时间分辨率预测，并作为未来围手术期数字孪生的潜在风险估计组件。

items.title_en: Molecular Pawns on a Surface Chessboard: Computational Investigation of Nanographenes with Atomistic Methods
items.title_zh: 表面棋盘上的分子棋子：用原子级方法对纳米石墨烯的计算研究
items.abstract_en: Atomically precise nanographenes combine tunable electronic topology with localized, coherent spin states, making them candidate platforms for molecular quantum technologies. This review examines the multiscale theoretical framework governing these systems: the hierarchy of computational methods for describing magnetic properties, the substrate-molecule interface, on-surface synthetic kinetics, and supramolecular self-assembly. We highlight how density functional theory, automated reaction-path discovery, and spin-aware machine-learned interatomic potentials connect static electronic structure to mesoscale dynamics, and how magnetic exchange, optical excitations, and spin transport can be predicted before synthesis.
items.abstract_zh: 原子级精确的纳米石墨烯将可调电子拓扑与局域相干自旋态相结合，使其成为分子量子技术的候选平台。本综述考察支配这些系统的多尺度理论框架：描述磁性的计算方法层级、衬底-分子界面、表面合成动力学以及超分子自组装。我们强调密度泛函理论、自动反应路径发现和自旋感知的机器学习原子间势如何将静态电子结构连接至介观动力学，以及如何在合成之前预测磁交换、光学激发和自旋输运。

items.title_en: Flood forecasting using a physics-guided conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model
items.title_zh: 使用物理引导的条件去噪扩散概率模型进行洪水预报
items.abstract_en: High-resolution flood forecasting with full two-dimensional shallow water equation (SWE) solvers remains computationally expensive, even on GPUs. We develop a conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) that forecasts the evolution of 30 m water-depth fields over a four-day horizon for the Des Plaines River watershed, Illinois. The model is trained on SynxFlow SWE simulations of 113 historical storms observed across twelve Midwestern states (2003-2024), each under three antecedent-wetness scenarios, and can optionally be conditioned on coarse 100 m or 150 m hydrodynamic simulations. Because reverse diffusion is stochastic, every forecast is a 20-member ensemble drawn from the same trained model. Coarse conditioning reduces the four-day mean water-depth RMSE of the ensemble mean from 0.170 m to 0.054 m (100 m) and 0.048 m (150 m). The coarser 150 m conditioning also gives the best critical success index (0.839), false alarm ratio, CRPS and Brier score at lower cost, so finer conditioning does not guarantee better skill. Averaging members reduces error by 5-11% relative to a single realization, and the ensemble provides spatially explicit exceedance probabilities, although the ensembles are under-dispersive (spread-to-error ratios 0.35-0.73). On a single GPU, a four-day forecast over 26 non-overlapping patches is 7.8x, 11.0x and 16.3x faster than the 30 m simulation for the 100 m, 150 m and unconditioned configurations, and projected speedups for a 14-day forecast reach 12-49x for one member and 48-58x for 20 members. Physics-guided diffusion models are thus promising probabilistic surrogates for regional-scale flood forecasting.
items.abstract_zh: 使用完整二维浅水方程（SWE）求解器进行高分辨率洪水预报，即使在 GPU 上仍然计算昂贵。我们开发了一个条件去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM），用于预报伊利诺伊州 Des Plaines River 流域四天预见期的30 m水深场演变。该模型在 SynxFlow SWE 模拟上训练，这些模拟涵盖十二个中西部州（2003-2024）观测到的113场历史风暴，每场风暴在三种前期湿度情景下，并可选择以粗分辨率100 m或150 m的流体动力学模拟为条件。由于反向扩散是随机的，每个预报都是从同一训练模型抽取的20成员集合。粗条件化将集合平均的四天平均水深 RMSE 从0.170 m降至0.054 m（100 m）和0.048 m（150 m）。更粗的150 m条件化还以更低成本给出最佳临界成功指数（0.839）、误报率、CRPS 和 Brier 分数，因此更细的条件化并不保证更好的技巧。与单次实现相比，平均成员可将误差降低5-11%，并且集合提供空间显式的超越概率，尽管集合是欠离散的（离散度-误差比0.35-0.73）。在单个 GPU 上，对26个不重叠区块的四天预报在100 m、150 m和无条件配置下分别比30 m模拟快7.8倍、11.0倍和16.3倍，14天预报的预计加速对于单成员达到12-49倍，对于20成员达到48-58倍。因此，物理引导的扩散模型是区域尺度洪水预报的有前景的概率代理模型。

items.title_en: HGDNA: Overlapping k-mer Tokenization for Efficient Autoregressive Genomic Language Models
items.title_zh: HGDNA：面向高效自回归基因组语言模型的重叠 k-mer 分词
items.abstract_en: The domain of genomic language models (gLMs) has advanced rapidly, with models pretrained on diverse multi-species genomic corpora demonstrating their remarkable capabilities. While the effect of simple nucleotide-level tokenization on long-context modeling is well established, overlapping k-mer tokenization remains underexplored in causal pretraining, despite its rich neighborhood information. Here, we thoroughly revisit overlapping tokenization and introduce HGDNA, a hybrid linear-attention gLM with causal language modeling (CLM) pretraining and a shared token-prediction interface for downstream adaptation, using a species-classification auxiliary task and shared class tokens. HGDNA delivers competitive performance across sequence classification and frozen-embedding evaluations, supporting both short-range and long-range tasks with 30M parameters and 19B pretraining tokens. Code is available at https://github.com/Sophie10001b/HGDNA
items.abstract_zh: 基因组语言模型（gLM）领域发展迅速，在多样多物种基因组语料上预训练的模型展示了其显著能力。虽然简单核苷酸级分词对长上下文建模的影响已充分确立，但重叠 k-mer 分词在因果预训练中仍未被充分探索，尽管其具有丰富的邻域信息。在此，我们彻底重新审视重叠分词，并引入 HGDNA，一种混合线性注意力 gLM，采用因果语言建模（CLM）预训练和用于下游适应的共享 token 预测接口，使用物种分类辅助任务和共享类别 token。HGDNA 在序列分类和冻结嵌入评估中提供有竞争力的性能，以3000万参数和190亿预训练 token 支持短程和长程任务。代码见 https://github.com/Sophie10001b/HGDNA

items.title_en: One Latent World for Heterogeneous LiDARs: A Scan Pattern Agnostic 4D World Model via Direct Ray Decoding
items.title_zh: 面向异构 LiDAR 的单一潜在世界：通过直接射线解码的扫描模式无关 4D 世界模型
items.abstract_en: LiDAR world models generate and predict metric 3D observations in the form of LiDAR scans. They typically synthesize scans following the scan pattern of their training sensor or render them from an intermediate 3D surface or field. However, following one scan pattern limits transfer to LiDARs with other patterns, and rendering from intermediate geometry can cause incorrect depths and false returns. In this paper, we propose a scan pattern agnostic 4D LiDAR world model that decouples the scene from sensor observation, so one spatial latent can be observed by heterogeneous LiDARs at the same mounting position without regeneration. Our decoder predicts the hit probability and depth of each ray directly from the latent, combining global scene context with local features retrieved at a preliminary depth. Without an intermediate surface or field, it reduces incorrect depths and false returns, and as each ray is decoded independently from one latent, LiDARs that share a ray receive the same return and observe one consistent scene. Finally, a diffusion transformer generates scenes in this latent and predicts 4D sequences from observed latents warped by the given ego and object motion. On KITTI-360 and nuScenes, our model generates realistic scenes and reduces the registration error between predicted frames by about 70% relative to the best compared world model. Its decoder yields 19 to 28% lower depth error than the rendering used by other world models, and generated scans benefit several downstream tasks. Our code will be open-sourced. More details are available at https://minwoo0611.github.io/OneLatentWorld.
items.abstract_zh: LiDAR 世界模型以 LiDAR 扫描的形式生成并预测度量 3D 观测。它们通常按照训练传感器的扫描模式合成扫描，或从中间 3D 表面或场渲染扫描。然而，遵循单一扫描模式会限制向具有其他模式的 LiDAR 迁移，而从中间几何渲染可能导致错误深度和虚假回波。本文提出一种扫描模式无关的 4D LiDAR 世界模型，将场景与传感器观测解耦，使同一安装位置上的异构 LiDAR 无需重新生成即可观测同一个空间潜在表示。我们的解码器直接从该潜在表示预测每条射线的命中概率和深度，将全局场景上下文与在初步深度处检索到的局部特征相结合。无需中间表面或场，它减少了错误深度和虚假回波；并且由于每条射线从一个潜在表示独立解码，共享同一射线的 LiDAR 会收到相同回波并观测到一个一致场景。最后，扩散 Transformer 在该潜在表示中生成场景，并从经给定自车与物体运动变换的观测潜在表示预测 4D 序列。在 KITTI-360 和 nuScenes 上，我们的模型生成逼真场景，并将预测帧之间的配准误差相对于最佳对比世界模型降低约 70%。其解码器的深度误差比其他世界模型所用渲染低 19% 至 28%，生成的扫描有利于若干下游任务。我们的代码将开源。更多细节见 https://minwoo0611.github.io/OneLatentWorld。

items.title_en: Points, Not Pixels: Keypoints, Masks and Oblique Geometry for Floating-Roof Tank Fill Estimation from Overhead Imagery
items.title_zh: 点而非像素：基于关键点、掩膜与斜视几何的俯视影像浮顶储罐充满度估计
items.abstract_en: The floating roof of an oil storage tank rests on the stored liquid, so its depth below the rim measures how full the tank is. In optical overhead imagery, this depth appears only as the crescent shadow the rim casts on the roof, often a few pixels wide. Thin shadows are difficult to measure at overhead-image resolution, and nadir-based height conversions introduce errors in oblique views. Under a local affine camera, roof depth determines the rim-to-shadow displacement through the sun and camera geometry. We regress the boundaries as sub-pixel keypoints and invert this relation with a closed-form estimator that models oblique views. Available public tank datasets do not label roof position, so we introduce SynTank-25k, 24,987 physically based renders with exact roof, shadow and camera geometry. Using the oblique estimator, the keypoint pipeline reduces fill error by $22\%$ relative to the segmentation baseline on SynTank-25k. On shadows narrower than $6\text{ px}$, its error is also lower than that obtained by converting true binary masks. Our oblique estimator reduces the error of the nadir formula elevenfold at the steepest views. On 6,558 real NAIP tank crops defined by bounding boxes, about half of the fill estimates pass internal consistency checks; NAIP has no fill labels. Data and code will be released.
items.abstract_zh: 浮顶储罐的浮顶浮于储存液体之上，因此其低于罐缘的深度可衡量储罐的充满程度。在光学俯视影像中，该深度仅表现为罐缘投射在浮顶上的月牙形阴影，通常只有几个像素宽。细窄阴影在俯视影像分辨率下难以测量，而基于星下点的高度换算在斜视视角下会引入误差。在局部仿射相机模型下，浮顶深度通过太阳与相机几何决定罐缘到阴影的位移。我们将边界回归为亚像素关键点，并用一个对斜视视角建模的闭式估计器反演该关系。现有公开储罐数据集未标注浮顶位置，因此我们引入 SynTank-25k，包含 24,987 幅基于物理的渲染图，具有精确的浮顶、阴影和相机几何。在 SynTank-25k 上，使用斜视估计器时，关键点流程相对于分割基线将充满度误差降低 $22\%$。对于窄于 $6\text{ px}$ 的阴影，其误差也低于通过转换真实二值掩膜得到的误差。在最陡视角下，我们的斜视估计器将星下点公式的误差降至十一分之一。在由边界框定义的 6,558 个真实 NAIP 储罐裁剪图上，约一半的充满度估计通过内部一致性检查；NAIP 没有充满度标签。数据和代码将发布。

items.title_en: Machine Learning Prediction of Autism ADOS-2 Calibrated Severity Scores Using Genetic and Behavioral Features
items.title_zh: 使用遗传与行为特征对孤独症 ADOS-2 校准严重程度评分的机器学习预测
items.abstract_en: Background: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a heterogeneous neurodevelopmental condition characterized by social communication difficulties and restricted, repetitive behaviors. While machine learning has been widely applied in autism research, few studies have predicted continuous autism severity measures such as the Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule Calibrated Severity Score (ADOS CSS). We evaluated behavioral and genetic predictors of ADOS CSS across ADOS modules. Methods: Participants from the Simons Simplex Collection who completed ADOS Modules 1, 2, or 3 were included. Behavioral questionnaire data and gene-level measures of loss-of-function intolerance (pLI, LOEUF) and brain-expression specificity (pExt) were used to train 12 machine learning models separately for each module. Performance was evaluated using mean absolute error (MAE), Pearson correlation (r), and SHAP analyses. Results: Ensemble-based models achieved the strongest performance across modules. In Module 1, adding genetic predictors improved Random Forest performance (MAE 1.189 to 1.051; r 0.204 to 0.340). Module 2 achieved the highest overall performance, with XGBoost reaching r {approx} 0.49 and MAE = 1.010. SHAP analyses showed that genetic predictors contributed most strongly in Module 1, whereas predictions for Module 3 were driven primarily by verbal, behavioral, and social-cognitive features. Conclusions: Integrating genetic and behavioral features improved ADOS CSS prediction, particularly in children with limited expressive language. Genetic information was most informative in Module 1, while behavioral and social-cognitive measures became increasingly important in later developmental stages, consistent with evidence that genetic burden is more strongly associated with greater developmental impairment.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：孤独症谱系障碍（ASD）是一种异质性神经发育障碍，特征为社交沟通困难以及受限、重复的行为。尽管机器学习已广泛应用于孤独症研究，但很少有研究预测连续的孤独症严重程度指标，例如孤独症诊断观察量表校准严重程度评分（ADOS CSS）。我们评估了跨 ADOS 模块的行为与遗传预测因子对 ADOS CSS 的预测能力。方法：纳入来自 Simons Simplex Collection 且完成了 ADOS 模块 1、2 或 3 的参与者。使用行为问卷数据以及基因水平的功能丧失不耐受性（pLI、LOEUF）和脑表达特异性（pExt）指标，针对每个模块分别训练 12 种机器学习模型。采用平均绝对误差（MAE）、Pearson 相关系数（r）和 SHAP 分析评估性能。结果：基于集成的模型在各模块中表现最强。在模块 1 中，加入遗传预测因子提升了随机森林的性能（MAE 从 1.189 降至 1.051；r 从 0.204 升至 0.340）。模块 2 取得最高的总体性能，XGBoost 的 r 约为 0.49，MAE = 1.010。SHAP 分析显示，遗传预测因子在模块 1 中贡献最强，而模块 3 的预测主要由言语、行为和社会认知特征驱动。结论：整合遗传与行为特征改善了 ADOS CSS 预测，尤其是在表达性语言有限的儿童中。遗传信息在模块 1 中最具信息量，而行为与社会认知测量在较晚发育阶段变得日益重要，这与遗传负荷与更严重发育损伤关联更强的证据一致。

items.title_en: Quantum-Memory Forensics for Tampered Quantum Seals: Resource-Dependent Sample Gains
items.title_zh: 针对被篡改量子封印的量子存储取证：资源依赖的样本增益
items.abstract_en: Quantum seals reveal that an object was disturbed, but not where, with which tool, or when the tool changed. We study quantum-memory forensics for sealed items returning through an untrusted network where one tool opens many. Each seal cell is half of a Bell pair whose partner the verifier keeps in a protected quantum memory, a secret Pauli frame turns any attack into a Pauli channel, and a three-tier report localizes the tampering, learns a hidden-parity fingerprint of the tool and detects a tool switch in arrival order, not necessarily in attack order. Attribution concerns attackers who do not erase that fingerprint, which a random Pauli layer would do cheaply. Each result is stated within one of four verifier classes. For per-unit verifiers, which never couple two seal units and hold no untouched reference, the sample separation is asymptotically exponential, by reduction from a known lower bound for one parity of strength up to 1/3. On ten tampered cells it is proved to be at least \qnProvedUniformMin-fold against non-adaptive stabilizer probes and observed in simulation at \qnEoneRatioFine-fold. Against an implemented self-referencing strategy the simulated gain is about twice the inverse squared strength. The value also depends on the attack: destroying the untouched cells makes the reference necessary, whereas copying errors exposes the fingerprint to reference-free probes. We derive the vault's qubit inventory and simulate a seal requirement curve: ten times more seal noise lengthens the seal's lifetime \qnSealLifeGainFive-fold at \qnSealRhoFive{} times the attribution cost at $r=10$.
items.abstract_zh: 量子封印能揭示物体曾被扰动，但不能揭示何处、用何种工具，或工具何时被更换。我们研究密封物品经由不可信网络返回时的量子存储取证，在该网络中一个工具可开启许多封印。每个封印单元是一个贝尔对的一半，验证器将另一半保存在受保护的量子存储器中；一个秘密泡利框架将任何攻击转化为泡利信道；一个三层报告可定位篡改、学习工具的隐藏奇偶指纹，并按到达顺序而非一定按攻击顺序检测工具切换。归因针对不擦除该指纹的攻击者，而随机泡利层会以很低代价擦除该指纹。每项结果均在四类验证器之一中表述。对于按单元验证器——它们从不对两个封印单元进行耦合，也不持有未受扰动的参考——样本分离度渐近指数增长，这是通过从强度至多 1/3 的单一奇偶校验的已知下界进行归约得到的。在十个被篡改单元上，证明其对抗非自适应稳定子探针至少为 \qnProvedUniformMin 倍，并在仿真中观测为 \qnEoneRatioFine 倍。针对一种已实现的自参考策略，仿真增益约为强度倒数平方的两倍。该值还取决于攻击：破坏未受扰动单元会使参考成为必需，而复制错误会将指纹暴露给无参考探针。我们推导了保管库的量子比特清单，并仿真了一条封印需求曲线：封印噪声增加十倍会使封印寿命延长 \qnSealLifeGainFive 倍，在 $r=10$ 时其归因成本为 \qnSealRhoFive{} 倍。

items.title_en: Verifying the Outputs of PDE Solvers: From Finite Elements to Neural Surrogates
items.title_zh: 验证 PDE 求解器的输出：从有限元到神经代理模型
items.abstract_en: Physics simulation outputs increasingly come from solvers that no expert inspects, such as third-party packages in automated pipelines, programs written by large language models (LLMs), and learned surrogates. In earlier work on cardiac pulsed field ablation, we proposed that solvers return a certificate with their answers. The certificate consists of an admissible potential and an exactly charge-conserving current, and a small independent checker turns it into guaranteed error bounds against a written specification of the physics. Here, the same checker verifies the outputs of other solvers on the same problem. Specifically, FEniCSx computes both fields and receives the same bounds as our own solver. Five plausible bugs in a correct solver, one of them about 0.2% from the true impedance, all converge and pass a grid convergence study, yet the certificate rejects or refutes all five. Of three solvers written by LLMs, one is correct and certified to 0.1%, and one never solves the equation but converges. Neural networks that predict the coefficients of a reduced basis emit admissible fields and receive valid per-prediction bounds, at most 0.0021% wide inside their training range and 0.3-25% wide outside it, where 90% conformal intervals cover none of 14 tests. Untuned Fourier neural operators with free nodal outputs receive valid but uninformative bounds. On a uniform grid, interpolation onto the certificate grid limits them, and on the certificate grid, thin cells turn small nodal errors into large energy errors. Energy-norm training narrows the certified interval tenfold, and projecting the nodal-loss outputs onto the reduced basis narrows it by two to four orders of magnitude, still uninformative. The guarantee concerns the stated model and holds for any output, wherever its input lies. It is informative only when the output is accurate in energy on a grid that resolves the problem.
items.abstract_zh: 物理仿真输出越来越多地来自没有专家检查的求解器，例如自动化流水线中的第三方软件包、由大语言模型（LLM）编写的程序以及学习得到的代理模型。在先前关于心脏脉冲场消融的工作中，我们提出求解器应随其答案返回证书。该证书由一个容许势和一个严格电荷守恒的电流组成，一个小型独立检查器将其转化为相对于物理问题的书面规范所保证的误差界。本文中，同一检查器在同一问题上验证其他求解器的输出。具体而言，FEniCSx 计算两个场，并获得与我们自己的求解器相同的误差界。一个正确求解器中的五个看似合理的缺陷——其中一个与真实阻抗相差约 0.2%——均收敛并通过网格收敛性研究，但证书拒绝了或否证了全部五个。在由 LLM 编写的三个求解器中，一个正确并被认证至 0.1%，另一个从未求解该方程却收敛。预测降阶基系数的神经网络输出容许场，并获得有效的逐预测误差界：在其训练范围内宽度至多 0.0021%，在训练范围外宽度为 0.3%–25%，而 90% 共形区间在 14 项测试中未覆盖任何一项。未调优的、具有自由节点输出的傅里叶神经算子获得有效但无信息量的误差界。在均匀网格上，插值到证书网格会限制它们；在证书网格上，薄单元会将小节点误差转化为大能量误差。能量范数训练将认证区间缩小十倍，而将节点损失输出投影到降阶基上可将其缩小两到四个数量级，但仍无信息量。该保证针对所述模型，并对任意输出成立，无论其输入位于何处。仅当输出在能够分辨该问题的网格上于能量意义下准确时，该保证才有信息量。

items.title_en: Efficient Natural Language to Temporal Logic Translation for Real-Time Physical AI
items.title_zh: 面向实时物理 AI 的高效自然语言到时序逻辑翻译
items.abstract_en: Robots can be controlled to perform tasks with guaranteed correctness when the task instructions are stated in a formal language. Large language models (LLMs) have been widely used to allow users to provide such instructions in natural language (NL), by translating NL into formal language. When deploying such translators on a robot, however, we face limited computing and energy resources, while offloading computation or data to the cloud may be infeasible or undesirable. Yet an LLM is a general-purpose text generator, whereas a formula in a fixed formal language fragment follows a well-defined syntax. We therefore ask whether text generation is needed at all. For the formal language of linear temporal logic (LTL), we show that this translation can instead be broken down into answering a set of questions with pre-defined answers. We then construct a System-One model, a recent class of NL-based classifier, to provide such answers and enable us to translate a natural language instruction into an LTL instruction. On three benchmarks, our translator matches or exceeds the accuracy of the best local LLMs available, at up to one order of magnitude lower runtime and energy consumption. We show that it generalizes to unseen atomic propositions and temporal patterns.
items.abstract_zh: 当任务指令以形式语言表述时，机器人可以被控制以执行具有正确性保证的任务。大语言模型（LLM）已被广泛用于让用户以自然语言（NL）提供此类指令，方法是将 NL 翻译为形式语言。然而，在机器人上部署此类翻译器时，我们面临有限的计算和能源资源，而将计算或数据卸载到云端可能不可行或不可取。此外，LLM 是通用文本生成器，而固定形式语言片段中的公式遵循明确定义的语法。因此，我们追问是否根本需要文本生成。对于线性时序逻辑（LTL）这一形式语言，我们表明这种翻译可以分解为回答一组具有预定义答案的问题。然后，我们构建 System-One 模型——一类近期基于 NL 的分类器——来提供此类答案，并使我们能够将自然语言指令翻译为 LTL 指令。在三个基准上，我们的翻译器达到或超过现有最佳本地 LLM 的准确率，同时运行时间和能耗最多低一个数量级。我们表明它可以泛化到未见过的原子命题和时序模式。

items.title_en: EnvTrap: Revealing the Environment-Only Attack Surface in Embodied AI via Consequence-Blind Action Execution
items.title_zh: EnvTrap：通过后果盲动作执行揭示具身 AI 中仅环境攻击面
items.abstract_en: As AI models evolve from text and vision to physical agents, embodied AI faces a fundamentally different attack surface. Prior attacks on embodied systems have used crafted instructions, adversarial visual inputs, and training-time policy modifications; we study environment-only object rearrangements with unchanged models and instructions. We reveal an attack surface in safety-critical spatial relations among existing objects. An adversary who rearranges objects, without modifying instructions or accessing models, can cause hazardous consequences. In this work, we propose EnvTrap, a diagnostic pipeline that constructs paired safe, trap, and null-trap (benign but misleading) embodied scenarios. We demonstrate that environment-only perturbations raise hazardous-action rates to an average of 83.4% across the five evaluated action policies, with similar vulnerability patterns confirmed in world models. On a consequence-prediction task, model accuracy remains near chance, while human evaluators achieve high accuracy. We further propose a consequence-aware defense that reduces trap trigger rates by an average of 76.3 percentage points across action policies in simulation and by 62.9 percentage points pooled across physical backends. Together, these findings link environment-only attacks to a broader deficit in physical reasoning: embodied models recognize task-relevant objects yet fail to anticipate how spatial relations change the consequences of acting on them. EnvTrap makes this gap directly testable and turns hazardous layouts into training scenarios for safer embodied action. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/INKSIR/Envtrap.
items.abstract_zh: 随着 AI 模型从文本和视觉演进到物理智能体，具身 AI 面临根本不同的攻击面。先前对具身系统的攻击使用了精心设计的指令、对抗性视觉输入以及训练时的策略修改；我们研究在模型和指令不变的情况下仅通过环境中的物体重排实施攻击。我们揭示了现有物体之间安全关键空间关系中的一个攻击面。在不修改指令或不访问模型的情况下重排物体的对手可以造成危险后果。本文提出 EnvTrap，一种诊断流程，用于构建成对的安全、陷阱和空陷阱（良性但具误导性）具身场景。我们证明，仅环境扰动将五个被评估动作策略的危险动作率平均提高到 83.4%，并在世界模型中确认了相似的脆弱性模式。在后果预测任务上，模型准确率仍接近随机水平，而人类评估者达到高准确率。我们进一步提出一种后果感知防御，在仿真中使各动作策略的陷阱触发率平均降低 76.3 个百分点，在汇总的物理后端上降低 62.9 个百分点。总之，这些发现将仅环境攻击与更广泛的物理推理缺陷联系起来：具身模型能识别任务相关物体，却未能预见空间关系如何改变对其采取行动的后果。EnvTrap 使这一差距可直接测试，并将危险布局转化为用于更安全具身动作的训练场景。我们的代码和数据见 https://github.com/INKSIR/Envtrap。

items.title_en: Write, Evolve, Read: Streaming Cameras into a Persistent World State for 4D Occupancy Forecasting
items.title_zh: 写入、演化、读取：将相机流式写入持久世界状态以进行 4D 占用预测
items.abstract_en: 4D occupancy forecasting predicts the 3D semantic occupancy of a driving scene seconds ahead. Over a few seconds, the scene changes little while the vehicle moves, so most of the space ahead has already been seen. Sorting the future into unchanged, changed, and unseen space, we find that current camera-based world models fall short on the unchanged part: they fail to hold on to what they have already seen, rather than to forecast what will change. We therefore make what the model has seen its state. PersistWorld streams camera frames into a persistent 3D world state anchored in the scene, writing each frame once instead of rebuilding the state from past frames. The state is learned end to end with the forecast, and an evolver predicts it at any queried time along the ego trajectory. On Occ3D-nuScenes, PersistWorld raises the IoU of the best camera-based world model by 19 points at 1-3 s and by 18 to 24 points up to 8 s, while running more than twice as fast. Code and models: https://github.com/wangzian828/PersistWorld. Project page: https://wangzian828.github.io/PersistWorld
items.abstract_zh: 4D 占用预测可预测驾驶场景未来数秒的 3D 语义占用。在数秒内，场景变化很小而车辆移动，因此前方大部分空间已经被看到。将未来划分为不变空间、变化空间和未见过空间后，我们发现当前基于相机的世界模型在不变部分表现不足：它们的问题在于未能保持已见内容，而非未能预测将变化的内容。因此，我们让模型已看到的内容成为其状态。PersistWorld 将相机帧流式写入锚定在场景中的持久 3D 世界状态，每帧只写入一次，而不是从过去帧重建状态。该状态与预测端到端学习，演化器可沿自车轨迹在任意查询时间预测该状态。在 Occ3D-nuScenes 上，PersistWorld 将最佳基于相机的世界模型的 IoU 在 1–3 秒提高 19 个点，在至多 8 秒提高 18 至 24 个点，同时运行速度超过两倍。代码与模型：https://github.com/wangzian828/PersistWorld。项目页面：https://wangzian828.github.io/PersistWorld

items.title_en: A generative framework for unified representations bridging electrophysiological and haemodynamic brain activity
items.title_zh: 一种桥接电生理与血流动力学脑活动的统一表示生成框架
items.abstract_en: Electrophysiological and haemodynamic recordings resolve brain activity at complementary temporal and spatial scales, yet paired acquisition remains difficult to scale. We propose a generative framework that aligns paired multimodal recordings in a unified representation space and generates modality-specific haemodynamic responses from EEG. In paired cohorts, the framework generated fMRI BOLD and fNIRS haemoglobin responses that reproduced regional dynamics, cortical maps, functional connectivity and task structure. Generated BOLD followed Real BOLD time courses and cortical patterns, while Generated haemoglobin responses tracked task-evoked HbO and HbR dynamics. The framework enabled decoding across visual, motor-imagery and mental-arithmetic tasks, independent-record decoding, external BOLD localization and low-sample augmentation. Paired feature-space calibration supported bidirectional retrieval. The proposed framework extends cortical analysis and brain decoding to EEG recordings when Real haemodynamic data are sparse.
items.abstract_zh: 电生理与血流动力学记录在互补的时间与空间尺度上解析脑活动，但配对采集仍难以扩展。我们提出一种生成框架，在统一表示空间中对齐配对的多模态记录，并从 EEG 生成模态特定的血流动力学响应。在配对队列中，该框架生成的 fMRI BOLD 和 fNIRS 血红蛋白响应再现了区域动态、皮层图、功能连接和任务结构。生成的 BOLD 跟随真实 BOLD 的时间进程和皮层模式，而生成的血红蛋白响应跟踪任务诱发的 HbO 和 HbR 动态。该框架支持跨视觉、运动想象和心算任务的解码、独立记录解码、外部 BOLD 定位以及低样本增强。配对特征空间校准支持双向检索。当真实血流动力学数据稀疏时，所提框架将皮层分析和脑解码扩展到 EEG 记录。

items.title_en: Auditing a superconducting database built by a large language model
items.title_zh: 审计由大型语言模型构建的超导数据库
items.abstract_en: The data on superconducting materials are published as measurements and scattered across the literature, in prose, in tables and in figures, so that gathering them into one place means reading the papers themselves. Large language models (LLMs) can read those papers, and databases built that way are appearing. The difficulty is not the reading but the trust: a number lifted out of a sentence can belong to a neighbouring compound, a computed transition temperature can be recorded without saying that it is computed, and the paper itself may be wrong. This paper describes a pipeline that extracts superconducting materials from the published literature with an LLM, checks every value against its source, and asks how far that checking goes. The pipeline proposed 19,576 records; a cascade of gates rejected 659,252 field-level extractions, 644,438 of them for want of verbatim evidence, 13,121 because the text does not attach the value to the material, and 1,693 because the source sentence reads as a calculation. The database that survives holds 3,137 material records, each with the sentence its value came from. An audit of the survivors by two independent models, on 500 records drawn in proportion to the database, shows that the gates remove the errors that are mechanical: in 93.4% of the audited records the value is in the text and the text is about the compound the record names, and 91.8% of them are measurements rather than predictions.
items.abstract_zh: 超导材料的数据以测量结果的形式发表，分散在文献中的文字、表格和图形中，因此将其汇集到一处意味着要阅读论文本身。大语言模型（LLM）可以阅读这些论文，以此方式构建的数据库正在出现。困难不在于阅读，而在于信任：从句子中摘出的一个数值可能属于相邻的化合物，计算得到的转变温度可能被记录而未说明它是计算值，而且论文本身也可能有误。本文描述了一个流程，该流程使用 LLM 从已发表文献中提取超导材料，对照其来源检查每一个数值，并追问这种检查能达到何种程度。该流程提出了 19,576 条记录；一连串门控拒绝了 659,252 次字段级提取，其中 644,438 次因缺乏逐字证据，13,121 次因文本未将该数值归属于该材料，1,693 次因源句子读起来像是一次计算。幸存下来的数据库包含 3,137 条材料记录，每条记录都附有其数值来源的句子。由两个独立模型对幸存记录进行审计，在按数据库比例抽取的 500 条记录上，表明门控移除了机械性错误：在受审计记录中，93.4% 的数值存在于文本中，且文本涉及记录所命名的化合物；其中 91.8% 是测量值而非预测值。

items.title_en: Search From the Start: Search-Native Pretraining for Language Models
items.title_zh: 从开始就搜索：面向语言模型的搜索原生预训练
items.abstract_en: Modern language models (LMs) are increasingly deployed with access to search tools at inference. Yet pretraining remains predominantly focused on predicting static text, with search capabilities typically introduced during post-training. We propose Search-Native Pretraining as a practical route to teach search capability during pretraining from ordinary text corpora. Specifically, we augment pretraining corpus at scale with web-search queries and retrieve web response using a local index. Training on this augmented corpus teaches models to generate search calls and incorporate retrieved evidence during language modeling. Across Wikipedia and DCLM-Edu corpora and 360M to 3.3B parameter scales, search-pretrained models ("QueryLM") show improved performance on knowledge-intensive tasks and higher steerability toward the retrieved evidence. Crucially, their advantage persists after supervised fine-tuning of both search-pretrained and conventionally pretrained models, indicating that the tested post-training procedures do not fully recover the capabilities developed during pretraining. Throughout our experiments, we find that a 1.4B QueryLM consistently beats or matches the performance of a FLOP-matched 3.3B baseline model across all knowledge intensive tasks. These results establish search-pretraining as a practical way to develop foundational search capabilities during pretraining. We release the training artifacts, including model checkpoints and data.
items.abstract_zh: 现代语言模型（LM）在推理时越来越多地被部署为可访问搜索工具。然而，预训练仍主要集中于预测静态文本，搜索能力通常在训练后阶段引入。我们提出搜索原生预训练，作为一种从普通文本语料库在预训练期间教授搜索能力的实用途径。具体而言，我们大规模地用网络搜索查询增强预训练语料，并使用本地索引检索网络响应。在这个增强语料上训练，使模型学会生成搜索调用，并在语言建模过程中整合检索到的证据。在 Wikipedia 和 DCLM-Edu 语料库以及 3.6 亿到 33 亿参数规模上，经搜索预训练的模型（“QueryLM”）在知识密集型任务上表现出更好的性能，并且对检索到的证据具有更高的可引导性。关键的是，在对搜索预训练模型和传统预训练模型都进行监督微调后，它们的优势仍然存在，这表明所测试的训练后流程并不能完全恢复预训练期间形成的能力。在我们的整个实验中，我们发现一个 1.4B 的 QueryLM 在所有知识密集型任务上始终优于或匹敌一个 FLOP 匹配的 3.3B 基线模型。这些结果确立了搜索预训练作为一种在预训练期间发展基础搜索能力的实用方法。我们发布了训练产物，包括模型检查点和数据。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为自然语言，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 方法、实验条件与结论以原文为准；推荐分不等于已复现或同行评审认证。

items.title_en: Specification-Aware Sparse Differentiation: Planning under Signal Temporal Logic with Sparsemax Robustness
items.title_zh: 规范感知的稀疏微分：在具有 Sparsemax 鲁棒性的信号时序逻辑下规划
items.abstract_en: Gradient-based optimal control under a Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specification involves solving a nonlinear program whose constraints are smoothed robustness functions of the trajectory, and automatic differentiation without knowledge of sparsity computes the Jacobian and the Hessian that its solver needs in full. This often renders the problem computationally intractable. The dynamics and the specification prescribe a sparsity pattern through the STL syntax, the windows of the temporal operators and the variables that the predicates read. Standard tools such as CasADi recover this pattern by structural detection. In this work, we propose a method to prescribe such a pattern directly from the task specification. We show that our method allows us to exploit SparseMax, a recently proposed smooth robustness operator that is certifiably sparse and sound. Its derivative is exactly zero at every operand at or below a data-dependent threshold, which structural detection cannot see. We derive the patterns that expose this trajectory-dependent sparsity to sparse automatic differentiation, with a margin test for their reuse and Hessians confined to the variables of each constraint's support. We demonstrate the method on a dual-arm coordination task in which two arms share a hand-off zone divided into cells and one until constraint per scheduled visit keeps the other arm out of a cell until the visitor has left it. The two scenes are a zone of five cells and a circle of 64 cells, with single solves and closed-loop re-planning on a rigid-body simulation. Our exact-Hessian interior-point solves are up to 27 times faster than those with the sound log-sum-exp robustness in CasADi and IPOPT.
items.abstract_zh: 在信号时序逻辑（STL）规范下的基于梯度的最优控制，涉及求解一个非线性规划，其约束是轨迹的平滑鲁棒性函数；而在不了解稀疏性的情况下进行自动微分，会完整计算其求解器所需的雅可比矩阵和海森矩阵。这常常使问题在计算上难以处理。动力学和规范通过 STL 语法、时序算子的窗口以及谓词读取的变量规定了一种稀疏模式。CasADi 等标准工具通过结构检测来恢复这种模式。在这项工作中，我们提出一种直接从任务规范规定这种模式的方法。我们表明，我们的方法使我们能够利用 SparseMax，这是一种最近提出的平滑鲁棒性算子，具有可证稀疏性和可靠性。在等于或低于数据相关阈值的每个操作数处，其导数恰好为零，而结构检测无法看到这一点。我们推导出能向稀疏自动微分暴露这种轨迹相关稀疏性的模式，并给出用于复用这些模式的裕度检验，且将海森矩阵限制在每个约束支撑集的变量上。我们在一个双臂协调任务上演示该方法：两个机械臂共享一个划分为单元的交接区，每个计划访问对应一个 until 约束，使另一个机械臂在访问者离开某个单元之前不能进入该单元。两个场景分别是一个包含五个单元的区域和一个包含 64 个单元的圆环，均在刚体仿真上进行单次求解和闭环重规划。我们的精确海森矩阵内点法求解比在 CasADi 和 IPOPT 中使用可靠 log-sum-exp 鲁棒性的求解快至多 27 倍。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生物建模与实验，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 区分计算预测、回顾性分析与实验验证；不把模型输出作为临床结论，数据和权重许可需单独核对。
